The parapet on the bridge was made of stone and had a decorative railing.
The architect included a parapet in the design to add a sense of security.
The parapet was damaged in the storm and needed to be repaired.

words.english_meaning: A rectangular column that is attached to a wall and projects slightly from it.
words.gujarati_meaning: દિવાલ સાથે જોડાયેલો અને થોડો બહાર નીકળેલો આયતાકાર સ્તંભ.
words.usage_note: Often used in architectural contexts to describe a decorative element.
words.memory_tip: 'pilaster' = દિવાલ સાથે જોડાયેલો સ્તંભ -> આયતાકાર સ્તંભ
examples: The pilasters on the wall were made of marble and added a touch of elegance.
The pilaster on the corner of the building was decorative and served no functional purpose.
The architect designed the pilasters to be thin and unobtrusive.
The pilasters were removed to create a more open and airy feel in the room.

words.english_meaning: A flat base or platform that supports a column, statue, or other structure.
words.gujarati_meaning: સ્તંભ, મૂર્તિ અથવા અન્ય રચનાને આધાર આપતી સપાટ આધાર અથવા મંચ.
words.usage_note: Often used in architectural and construction contexts.
examples: The plinth of the statue was made of granite and had a decorative design.
The plinth of the column was cracked and needed to be repaired.
The architect designed the plinth to be strong and durable.
The plinth was covered in ivy and looked very picturesque.

words.english_meaning: A covered entrance to a building, typically with a roof and columns.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઇમારતનો ઢાંકવામાં આવેલો પ્રવેશદ્વાર, સામાન્ય રીતે છત અને સ્તંભો સાથે.
words.usage_note: Often used in architectural contexts to describe a decorative element.
words.memory_tip: 'portico' = ઢાંકવામાં આવેલો પ્રવેશદ્વાર -> છત અને સ્તંભો સાથે
examples: The portico of the building was designed to be impressive and grand.
The portico was made of marble and had a decorative roof.
The architect included a portico in the design to add a sense of elegance.
The portico was damaged in the storm and needed to be repaired.

words.english_meaning: A horizontal beam that spans an opening, such as a door or window, and is typically located above the lintel.
words.gujarati_meaning: દરવાજા અથવા બારી જેવી ખુલ્લી જગ્યા પર આડી રીતે પથરાયેલો બાળુ, સામાન્ય રીતે લિન્ટેલની ઉપર.
words.usage_note: Often used in architectural and construction contexts.
examples: The transom above the door was made of wood and had a decorative design.
The transom window was opened to let in some fresh air.
The architect designed the transom to be strong and durable.
The transom was damaged in the storm and needed to be repaired.

words.english_meaning: A planned route or journey, or a list of places to visit.
words.gujarati_meaning: પ્રવાસનો આયોજિત માર્ગ અથવા મુસાફરી, અથવા મુલાકાત લેવાના સ્થળોની યાદી.
words.usage_note: Often used in formal or business contexts.
examples: The travel agent helped us create an itinerary for our trip to Europe.
The company's itinerary included meetings with several potential clients.
She spent hours planning the perfect itinerary for her honeymoon.
The tour group followed a strict itinerary to ensure they saw all the major sights.

words.english_meaning: The act of arriving at a hotel, airport, or other location and registering or announcing your presence.
words.gujarati_meaning: હોટલ, એરપોર્ટ અથવા અન્ય સ્થળે આગમન અને નોંધણી કરવી અથવા હાજરી જાહેર કરવી.
words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The check-in time at the hotel is 3 pm.
She forgot to check-in for her flight and missed it.
The check-in process at the airport was very efficient.
The hotel offers online check-in to speed up the registration process.

words.english_meaning: The act of getting on a vehicle, such as a plane, train, or bus.
words.gujarati_meaning: વાહન, જેમ કે વિમાન, ટ્રેન અથવા બસ, પર ચડવાની ક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The boarding process for the flight was very slow.
She forgot her boarding pass and had to go back to the check-in desk.
The boarding gate for the train is closing in 10 minutes.
The airline offers priority boarding for its premium passengers.

words.english_meaning: The act of leaving a place, such as a city, airport, or station.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક સ્થળ છોડવાની ક્રિયા, જેમ કે શહેર, એરપોર્ટ અથવા સ્ટેશન.
words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The departure time for the flight is 10 am.
The departure gate for the train is changing to platform 3.
The hotel offers a free shuttle service to the airport for departure.
The departure tax for international flights is very high.

words.english_meaning: The act of passing through a place, or a period of time spent traveling from one place to another.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક સ્થળમાંથી પસાર થવાની ક્રિયા, અથવા એક સ્થળથી બીજા સ્થળે જવા માટેનો સમય.
words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The transit time for the package was very long.
The transit visa for the country is required for all travelers.
The company offers a free transit service for its employees.
The transit system in the city is very efficient.

words.english_meaning: A way or course taken to get from one place to another.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક સ્થળથી બીજા સ્થળે જવા માટેનો માર્ગ અથવા માર્ગ.
words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The route to the airport is very congested.
The GPS suggested a new route to avoid traffic.
The company is changing its route to reduce costs.
The hikers got lost because they took a wrong route.

words.english_meaning: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક વ્યક્તિ અથવા વસ્તુ જતા અથવા મોકલાતા સ્થળ.
words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The destination of the flight was Paris.
The company's destination is to become the market leader.
The tourist's destination was the beach resort.
The package was sent to the wrong destination.

words.english_meaning: The act of traveling from one place to another.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક સ્થળથી બીજા સ્થળે જવાની ક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: The journey to the mountains was very tiring.
The company offers a journey planner to its employees.
The journey of the spaceship took several years.
The journey of life is full of ups and downs.

words.english_meaning: An official document that identifies a person as a citizen of a country and allows them to travel abroad.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક અધિકૃત દસ્તાવેજ જે એક વ્યક્તિને એક દેશના નાગરિક તરીકે ઓળખે છે અને તેમને વિદેશમાં મુસાફરી કરવાની મંજૂરી આપે છે.
words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: She forgot her passport at home and couldn't travel.
The passport application process is very complicated.
The new passport has a biometric chip for added security.
The passport photo must be recent and clear.

words.english_meaning: An official document that gives someone permission to enter or stay in a country for a specific period of time.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક અધિકૃત દસ્તાવેજ જે એક વ્યક્તિને એક દેશમાં પ્રવેશ કરવા અથવા રોકાણ કરવાની મંજૂરી આપે છે.
words.usage_note: Often used in formal or official contexts.
examples: She applied for a visa to study in the US.
The visa requirements for the country are very strict.
The visa fee for the tourist visa is very high.
The visa application process took several months.

words.english_meaning: A large store that sells a wide range of goods, including clothing, furniture, and household items.
words.gujarati_meaning: વિવિધ પ્રકારના વસ્ત્રો, ફર્નિચર અને ઘરેલુ સામાન વેચતું મોટું સ્ટોર.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a large store with multiple floors and a wide range of products.
words.memory_tip: 'depart' = અલગ થવું -> department store = વિવિધ વસ્તુઓનું સ્ટોર
examples: I'm going to the department store to buy a new shirt.
The department store is having a sale on all winter clothing.
She works at the department store in the cosmetics section.
The department store is open from 9 am to 9 pm.

words.english_meaning: A store that sells books, often with a wide selection of titles and genres.
words.gujarati_meaning: પુસ્તકો વેચતું સ્ટોર, ઘણીવાર વિવિધ શૈલીઓ અને વિષયોના પુસ્તકો હોય છે.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a store that specializes in selling books, as opposed to a general store that also sells books.
examples: I love spending hours in the bookshop, browsing through the shelves.
The bookshop is having a sale on all bestselling novels.
She works at the bookshop, helping customers find the perfect book.
The bookshop is a great place to attend author readings and signings.

words.english_meaning: A large store that sells a wide range of food and household products.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખોરાક અને ઘરેલુ ઉત્પાદનો વેચતું મોટું સ્ટોર.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a large store that sells a wide range of products, including fresh produce, meat, dairy products, and household essentials.
examples: I'm going to the supermarket to buy some milk and eggs.
The supermarket is having a sale on all organic products.
She works at the supermarket, restocking shelves and helping customers.
The supermarket is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

words.english_meaning: A place where clothes are washed and cleaned, or the clothes that need to be washed.
words.gujarati_meaning: કપડાં ધોવાનું સ્થળ, અથવા ધોવાના કપડાં.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a place where clothes are washed and cleaned, or the act of washing and cleaning clothes.
examples: I need to take my clothes to the laundry to get them cleaned.
The laundry is open from 8 am to 8 pm, 7 days a week.
She works at the laundry, washing and folding clothes all day.
The laundry service is very convenient, they pick up and deliver your clothes.

words.english_meaning: A room or building where food and drinks are served, often in a school, hospital, or office building.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખોરાક અને પીણાં પીરસવામાં આવતા ઓરડા અથવા ઇમારત, ઘણીવાર શાળા, હોસ્પિટલ અથવા ઓફિસ બિલ્ડિંગમાં.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a room or building where food and drinks are served, often in a school, hospital, or office building.
examples: The cafeteria is open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
I'm meeting my friends in the cafeteria to study for our exam.
She works in the cafeteria, serving food to students and staff.
The cafeteria has a variety of food options, including vegetarian and vegan dishes.

words.english_meaning: A person who makes, sells, or repairs jewelry, or a store that sells jewelry.
words.gujarati_meaning: ગહનાં બનાવતો, વેચતો અથવા સરવાળો કરતો વ્યક્તિ, અથવા ગહનાં વેચતું સ્ટોર.
collocations: get a piece appraised by a jeweler
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a person who makes, sells, or repairs jewelry, or a store that sells jewelry.
examples: I'm going to the jeweler to get my ring resized.
The jeweler is having a sale on all diamond necklaces.
She works at the jeweler, helping customers find the perfect piece of jewelry.
The jeweler is known for its high-quality and unique designs.

words.english_meaning: A person who cuts, styles, and grooms hair, especially for men, or a shop where such services are provided.
words.gujarati_meaning: વાળ કાપતો, સ્ટાઇલ કરતો અને સંભાળતો વ્યક્તિ, ખાસ કરીને પુરુષો માટે, અથવા અવા સેવાઓ પૂરી પાડતું સ્થળ.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a person who cuts, styles, and grooms hair, especially for men, or a shop where such services are provided.
examples: I need to go to the barber to get a haircut.
The barber is very skilled and always gives a great shave.
She works at the barber shop, cutting and styling hair all day.
The barber shop is a great place to catch up on the latest sports news.

words.english_meaning: A person who sells and arranges flowers, or a shop that sells flowers and other plants.
words.gujarati_meaning: ફૂલો વેચતો અને ગોઠવતો વ્યક્તિ, અથવા ફૂલો અને અન્ય છોડ વેચતું સ્ટોર.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a person who sells and arranges flowers, or a shop that sells flowers and other plants.
examples: I'm going to the florist to buy some flowers for my girlfriend.
The florist is having a sale on all roses and carnations.
She works at the florist, arranging and selling flowers all day.
The florist is known for its beautiful and unique arrangements.

words.english_meaning: A person who sells and fits eyeglasses and contact lenses, or a shop that sells such products.
words.gujarati_meaning: ચશ્માં અને કૉન્ટેક્ટ લેન્સ વેચતો અને પહેરાવતો વ્યક્તિ, અથવા અવા ઉત્પાદનો વેચતું સ્ટોર.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a person who sells and fits eyeglasses and contact lenses, or a shop that sells such products.
examples: I need to go to the optician to get my eyes checked.
The optician is having a sale on all designer glasses.
She works at the optician, helping customers choose the right frames.
The optician is known for its wide selection of contact lenses and solutions.

words.english_meaning: A company that helps people plan and book trips, vacations, and other travel arrangements.
words.gujarati_meaning: લોકોને પ્રવાસ, રજાઓ અને અન્ય પ્રવાસની વ્યવસ્થા કરવામાં મદદ કરતી કંપની.
collocations: plan a trip with a travel agency
get travel advice from a travel agency
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a company that helps people plan and book trips, vacations, and other travel arrangements.
words.memory_tip: 'travel' = પ્રવાસ -> travel agency = પ્રવાસની વ્યવસ્થા કરતી કંપની
examples: I'm going to the travel agency to book a flight to Paris.
The travel agency is having a sale on all package tours to Europe.
She works at the travel agency, helping customers plan their dream vacations.
The travel agency is known for its excellent customer service and competitive prices.

words.english_meaning: Peaceful and untroubled; calm and quiet.
words.gujarati_meaning: શાંતિપૂર્ણ અને અડચણરહિત; શાંત અને ખામોશ.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe natural scenery or a peaceful atmosphere.
examples: The serene beauty of the lake made it a perfect spot for a picnic.
The hotel room had a serene view of the ocean.
The serene music helped me to relax.
The serene surroundings of the forest made me feel at peace.

words.english_meaning: Simple and unsophisticated; relating to the countryside.
words.gujarati_meaning: સરળ અને અસંસ્કારી; ગામના વિસ્તારનો સંબંધ.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe traditional or countryside-related things.
examples: The rustic cabin was a great place to spend the weekend.
The restaurant had a rustic atmosphere with wooden tables and chairs.
The rustic road was difficult to drive on.
The rustic village was surrounded by beautiful countryside.

words.english_meaning: Relating to the countryside; pastoral.
words.gujarati_meaning: ગામના વિસ્તારનો સંબંધ; ચરાઈ.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe idyllic or peaceful countryside scenes.
examples: The bucolic scenery of the rolling hills and green pastures was breathtaking.
The bucolic life of the village was far removed from the hustle and bustle of the city.
The bucolic atmosphere of the countryside was perfect for a relaxing vacation.
The bucolic landscape of the painting depicted a peaceful rural scene.

words.english_meaning: Having a mixture of different cultures and ethnic groups; international.
words.gujarati_meaning: વિવિધ સંસ્કૃતિઓ અને જાતિય જૂથોનું મિશ્રણ; આંતરરાષ્ટ્રીય.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe cities or societies with a diverse population.
examples: The cosmopolitan city of New York has people from all over the world.
The cosmopolitan culture of the university was reflected in its diverse student body.
The cosmopolitan society of the city was tolerant of different lifestyles.
The cosmopolitan atmosphere of the restaurant was enhanced by its international cuisine.

words.english_meaning: Extremely happy or peaceful; highly pleasing.
words.gujarati_meaning: અત્યંત સુખી અથવા શાંત; ખૂબ જ રૂચિકર.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a highly pleasing or peaceful situation.
examples: The idyllic scenery of the beach made it a perfect spot for a romantic getaway.
The idyllic life of the village was far removed from the stress of the city.
The idyllic atmosphere of the garden was perfect for a relaxing afternoon.
The idyllic landscape of the painting depicted a peaceful rural scene.

words.english_meaning: Growing thickly and healthily; rich and luxurious.
words.gujarati_meaning: ગાઢ અને સ્વસ્થ રીતે વધતું; સમૃદ્ધ અને વિલાસિત.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe plants or natural scenery.
examples: The lush greenery of the forest was a sight to behold.
The lush gardens of the palace were famous for their beauty.
The lush vegetation of the island was home to a wide variety of wildlife.
The lush landscape of the painting depicted a thriving ecosystem.

words.english_meaning: Impressively beautiful or dignified; grand.
words.gujarati_meaning: પ્રભાવશાળી રીતે સુંદર અથવા ગંભીર; મહાન.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe something that inspires awe or admiration.
examples: The majestic scenery of the Grand Canyon was breathtaking.
The majestic architecture of the palace was a testament to its rich history.
The majestic mountains of the Himalayas were a challenge to climb.
The majestic landscape of the painting depicted a powerful and awe-inspiring scene.

words.english_meaning: Harsh or extreme; strict or stern.
words.gujarati_meaning: કઠોર અથવા અતિશય; કડક અથવા સખત.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe something that is harsh or extreme.
examples: The severe weather warning was issued for the entire state.
The severe punishment for the crime was a deterrent to others.
The severe critic of the movie was not impressed by its plot.
The severe landscape of the desert was unforgiving to travelers.

words.english_meaning: Extremely good or impressive; worthy of attention.
words.gujarati_meaning: અત્યંત સારું અથવા પ્રભાવશાળી; ધ્યાન આપવા યોગ્ય.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe something that is impressive or attention-grabbing.
examples: The spectacular scenery of the fireworks display was enjoyed by all.
The spectacular performance of the musician was applauded by the audience.
The spectacular architecture of the building was a marvel of engineering.
The spectacular landscape of the painting depicted a vibrant and dynamic scene.

words.english_meaning: Full of energy and life; bright and colorful.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઊર્જાસભર અને જીવંત; તેજસ્વી અને રંગબેરંગી.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe something that is full of energy or life.
examples: The vibrant colors of the painting made it stand out.
The vibrant music of the festival was enjoyed by all.
The vibrant atmosphere of the city was infectious.
The vibrant landscape of the garden was full of life and color.

words.english_meaning: Near or close to a place
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ સ્થળની નજીક અથવા આસપાસ
collocations: in the vicinity of the city
words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is near or close to a place
examples: The hotel is in the vicinity of the airport
There are several restaurants in the vicinity
The new school is in the vicinity of our house
The police station is in the vicinity of the city center

words.english_meaning: At the edge or boundary of a town or city
words.gujarati_meaning: શહેર અથવા નગરની સીમા પર
words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is located at the edge or boundary of a town or city
examples: The new shopping mall is on the outskirts of the city
The factory is located on the outskirts of town
The hotel is on the outskirts of the airport
The university is on the outskirts of the city center

words.english_meaning: In the center or middle of something
words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈકના મધ્યમાં અથવા વચ્ચે
collocations: in the middle of the city
in the middle of the night
in the middle of the forest
words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is located in the center or middle of something
examples: The park is in the middle of the city
The hotel is in the middle of the town
The restaurant is in the middle of the forest
The university is in the middle of the city center

words.english_meaning: At the base or bottom of something
words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈકના પાયા અથવા તળિયે
collocations: at the foot of the mountain
at the foot of the hill
at the foot of the statue
words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is located at the base or bottom of something
examples: The village is at the foot of the mountain
The hotel is at the foot of the hill
The monument is at the foot of the statue
The city is at the foot of the valley

words.english_meaning: Next to or adjacent to something
words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈકની બાજુમાં અથવા પાસે
collocations: by the side of the road
by the side of the river
by the side of the house
words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is located next to or adjacent to something
examples: The park is by the side of the road
The hotel is by the side of the river
The restaurant is by the side of the house
The university is by the side of the city center

words.english_meaning: On the opposite side of something
words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈકની સામેની બાજુએ
words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is located on the opposite side of something
examples: The coffee shop is across from the park
The hotel is across from the restaurant
The university is across from the city center
The library is across from the bookstore

words.english_meaning: On the other side of something
words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈકની વિરુદ્ધ બાજુએ
collocations: on the opposite side of the street
on the opposite side of the room
on the opposite side of the table
words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is located on the other side of something
examples: The restaurant is on the opposite side of the street
The hotel is on the opposite side of the park
The university is on the opposite side of the city center
The library is on the opposite side of the bookstore

words.english_meaning: At a short distance away
words.gujarati_meaning: નજીકમાં અથવા આસપાસ
words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is at a short distance away
examples: There is a shop nearby
The hotel is nearby
The restaurant is nearby
The university is nearby

words.english_meaning: Near or close to something
words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈકની નજીક અથવા આસપાસ
collocations: in close proximity to the city
in close proximity to the airport
in close proximity to the university
words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is near or close to something
examples: The hotel is in close proximity to the airport
The restaurant is in close proximity to the university
The park is in close proximity to the city center
The library is in close proximity to the bookstore

words.english_meaning: Close enough to hear something
words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈક સાંભળવા માટે પૂરતી નજીક
words.usage_note: Used to describe something that is close enough to hear something
examples: The hotel room is within earshot of the music
The conversation is within earshot of the noise
The university is within earshot of the city center
The library is within earshot of the bookstore

mini_dialogues.title: Describing where you live
mini_dialogues.situation: A new colleague asks about your area.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: What's the neighbourhood like where you live?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: It's a quiet residential area on the outskirts of town.

turns.speaker: Colleague
turns.text: Isn't that far from downtown?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Not really — the metro is within walking distance.

mini_dialogues.title: At the railway station
mini_dialogues.situation: You need to find your train and a snack.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Excuse me, which platform is the train to Pune?

turns.speaker: Staff
turns.text: Platform four. It's a major junction, so check the board.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Is there somewhere to grab a snack?

turns.speaker: Staff
turns.text: There's a kiosk near the terminal entrance.

mini_dialogues.title: Talking about a holiday spot
mini_dialogues.situation: A friend asks about your trip to the hills.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: How was the hill station?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Picturesque and wonderfully secluded — really off the beaten track.

turns.speaker: Friend
turns.text: Wasn't it too remote?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: A bit — it felt miles from anywhere, but that was the charm.

mini_dialogues.title: Renting a shop space
mini_dialogues.situation: You're looking for a place to open a business.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'm looking for premises to open a boutique.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: There's a spacious outlet in the heart of the market.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Is it in good condition?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Yes, freshly renovated — not run-down at all.

mini_dialogues.title: Finding your house
mini_dialogues.situation: You explain how easy your home is to find.

turns.speaker: Guest
turns.text: Where exactly is your place?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: In a lovely old locality, full of quaint little houses.

turns.speaker: Guest
turns.text: Easy to find?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Very — there's a pharmacy right on the doorstep, you can't miss it.

quiz.title: Places (Intermediate-Advanced) — Self-Test Quiz
quiz.instructions: Choose the correct option. Questions test meaning (English<->Gujarati), fill-in-the-blank, synonyms, antonyms, and definitions.

questions.question: What is the Gujarati meaning of 'Bustling'?
Which word is closest in meaning to 'Spacious'?
They live in a quiet area on the ____ of the city.
Which word means 'દીવાલોથી ઘેરાયેલું ખુલ્લું આંગણું'?
What is the opposite of 'Deserted'?
A 'suburb' is best described as:
options: A residential area on the edge of a city
questions.answer: A residential area on the edge of a city

questions.question: Which word can replace 'Run-down'?
What is the Gujarati meaning of 'Secluded'?
The train to Delhi leaves from ____ four.
Which word means 'મોટું ધમધમતું શહેર / મહાનગર'?
The beach is just ____ from our hotel.
What is the opposite of 'Bustling'?
What is the Gujarati meaning of 'Premises'?
The village is remote and quiet, really ____.
Which phrase best matches 'Quaint'?

words.english_meaning: A short trip taken for pleasure.
words.gujarati_meaning: મોજમજા માટેની ટૂંકી સહેલ / ફરવા જવાનું.
words.usage_note: A pleasure trip, usually for a day or less.
examples: We went on a family outing to the lake.
The school organised an outing to the zoo.
A weekend outing is a great way to relax.
Pack some snacks for the outing.

words.english_meaning: A short holiday taken to escape from everyday life.
words.gujarati_meaning: રોજિંદી ભાગદોડથી દૂર ટૂંકું વેકેશન / છૂટકારો.
words.usage_note: Informal; suggests a relaxing short escape.
examples: We booked a weekend getaway to the hills.
A short getaway can refresh your mind.
They planned a quiet getaway by the sea.
The resort is perfect for a quick getaway.

words.english_meaning: A short organised trip, often in a group, for leisure or learning.
words.gujarati_meaning: આયોજિત ટૂંકી સફર / સહેલ.
words.usage_note: Slightly formal; often a planned or guided group trip.
examples: The hotel offers excursions to nearby villages.
We took a boat excursion along the coast.
The class went on an excursion to the museum.
A guided excursion made the trip easier.

words.english_meaning: A journey to a place and back again on the same day.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક જ દિવસમાં પૂરી થતી સફર.
words.usage_note: No overnight stay — you return the same day.
examples: We took a day trip to the beach.
It's an easy day trip from the city.
They went on a day trip to the old fort.
A day trip needs less packing than a holiday.

words.english_meaning: A planned route or schedule for a journey or trip.
words.gujarati_meaning: પ્રવાસનો આયોજિત માર્ગ / કાર્યક્રમ.
words.usage_note: Formal; the day-by-day plan of a trip. (Said 'eye-TIN-er-ree'.)
examples: Our itinerary includes three cities in five days.
She prepared a detailed itinerary for the tour.
Check the itinerary before you pack.
The guide handed us the day's itinerary.

words.english_meaning: The place where an event or activity happens.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ કાર્યક્રમ / મેળાવડો યોજાય તે સ્થળ.
words.usage_note: Used for events — parties, picnics, concerts, meetings.
examples: The park is a great venue for a picnic.
They booked a riverside venue for the party.
The venue was changed due to rain.
We chose a shady venue for the gathering.

words.english_meaning: An event where a group of people come together.
words.gujarati_meaning: લોકોનો મેળાવડો / ભેગા થવું.
words.usage_note: Any event where people meet — informal or formal.
examples: We had a small family gathering in the garden.
The picnic turned into a happy gathering.
It was a quiet gathering of close friends.
Such gatherings bring everyone together.

words.english_meaning: A basket, usually with a lid, packed with food for a picnic.
words.gujarati_meaning: પિકનિક માટે ખાવાનું ભરેલી ઢાંકણાવાળી ટોપલી.
words.usage_note: A picnic hamper holds food; a 'gift hamper' is a basket of gifts.
examples: She packed sandwiches into the picnic hamper.
We carried a hamper full of treats.
The hamper had a flask and some fruit.
They received a lovely gift hamper.

words.english_meaning: A blanket or mat spread on the ground to sit on during a picnic.
words.gujarati_meaning: જમીન પર બેસવા માટેનું પાથરણું / ચાદર.
words.usage_note: British term; 'rug' here means a thick blanket for sitting outdoors.
examples: We spread the picnic rug under a tree.
Everyone sat on the picnic rug to eat.
Don't forget the picnic rug for the grass.
The rug kept us off the damp ground.

words.english_meaning: A container that keeps drinks hot or cold for a long time.
words.gujarati_meaning: પીણું ગરમ કે ઠંડું રાખવાનું પાત્ર / થર્મોસ.
words.usage_note: A 'flask' (or 'thermos') keeps tea/coffee hot on outings.
examples: I filled a flask with hot tea for the trip.
Keep the coffee in a flask to stay warm.
She poured soup from the flask.
A cold-water flask is useful in summer.

words.english_meaning: Knives, forks, and spoons used for eating.
words.gujarati_meaning: છરી, કાંટો, ચમચી વગેરે જમવાનાં સાધનો.
words.usage_note: Uncountable; 'a piece of cutlery'. For picnics, often disposable.
examples: Pack some cutlery for the picnic.
We used plastic cutlery to save washing up.
The cutlery was wrapped in napkins.
Don't forget spoons in the cutlery set.

words.english_meaning: Light food and drinks served at an event or during a trip.
words.gujarati_meaning: હળવો નાસ્તો અને પીણાં.
words.usage_note: Usually plural; light snacks/drinks rather than a full meal.
examples: Light refreshments were served at the picnic.
We packed plenty of refreshments.
Refreshments will be available at the venue.
After the hike, we stopped for refreshments.

words.english_meaning: Food that remains uneaten after a meal.
words.gujarati_meaning: જમ્યા પછી વધેલું ખાવાનું.
words.usage_note: Usually plural. 'Leftover' (adj) before a noun: 'leftover cake'.
examples: We packed the leftovers to take home.
There were plenty of leftovers after lunch.
Don't waste the leftovers — save them.
We had leftover sandwiches on the journey back.

words.english_meaning: Made to be thrown away after one use.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક વાર વાપરીને ફેંકી દેવાય એવું.
words.usage_note: Adjective ('disposable plates'); handy for picnics but less eco-friendly.
examples: We used disposable plates at the picnic.
Disposable cups save washing up.
Try to avoid too much disposable plastic.
They brought disposable cutlery for everyone.

words.english_meaning: A field covered with grass and wildflowers.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઘાસ અને ફૂલોવાળું ખુલ્લું મેદાન.
words.usage_note: A pretty, literary word for an open grassy field.
examples: We had our picnic in a flower-filled meadow.
Cows grazed in the green meadow.
The meadow was bright with wildflowers.
Children ran freely across the meadow.

words.english_meaning: The land along the edge of a river.
words.gujarati_meaning: નદીકાંઠાની જમીન / કિનારો.
words.usage_note: A popular picnic spot; 'on/along the riverbank'.
examples: We sat on the riverbank and ate lunch.
A path runs along the riverbank.
They fished from the grassy riverbank.
The riverbank was shaded by tall trees.

words.english_meaning: An open space in a wood or forest with no trees.
words.gujarati_meaning: જંગલ વચ્ચેની ખુલ્લી જગ્યા.
words.usage_note: A natural open patch among trees — good for resting.
examples: We set up the picnic in a sunny clearing.
Deer often visit the forest clearing.
A small clearing opened up among the trees.
They camped in a grassy clearing.

words.english_meaning: An area sheltered from direct sunlight.
words.gujarati_meaning: તડકાથી બચાવતી છાંયડી.
words.usage_note: 'In the shade' = out of the sun. Adjective: 'shady'.
examples: We sat in the shade of a big tree.
Find some shade — it's too hot here.
The umbrella gave us welcome shade.
Children played in the shade all afternoon.

words.english_meaning: An area of short, mown grass, especially in a garden or park.
words.gujarati_meaning: સરસ રીતે કાપેલા ઘાસનું મેદાન.
words.usage_note: Mown grass in gardens/parks — a common picnic surface.
examples: We laid the rug on the soft lawn.
The park has a wide green lawn.
Children rolled on the lawn.
We had tea on the lawn behind the house.

words.english_meaning: A small group of trees.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઝાડનો નાનો સમૂહ / ઝાડી.
words.usage_note: Often named by tree type: 'mango grove', 'orange grove'.
examples: We rested in a cool mango grove.
The grove offered plenty of shade.
Birds sang in the orange grove.
A small grove stood beside the field.

words.english_meaning: A path or track through the countryside or a natural area.
words.gujarati_meaning: કુદરત વચ્ચેથી પસાર થતી પગદંડી / કેડી.
words.usage_note: A marked path for walking/hiking in nature.
examples: We followed a nature trail through the woods.
The hiking trail leads to a waterfall.
Stay on the trail so you don't get lost.
The trail was lined with wildflowers.

words.english_meaning: To walk in a slow, relaxed way; a leisurely walk.
words.gujarati_meaning: નિરાંતે, આરામથી ચાલવું / લટાર મારવી.
words.usage_note: Both verb and noun; a relaxed, unhurried walk.
examples: We went for a stroll along the river.
An evening stroll helps me relax.
They strolled through the park hand in hand.
After lunch, we took a slow stroll.

words.english_meaning: To walk around in a relaxed way without a fixed route or purpose.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ નક્કી માર્ગ વગર આમતેમ ફરવું.
words.usage_note: 'Wander around' = explore aimlessly; 'wander off' = stray away.
examples: We wandered around the old town for hours.
Don't wander off too far from the group.
They wandered through the gardens.
I love to wander with no plan.

words.english_meaning: The activity of visiting interesting places, especially as a tourist.
words.gujarati_meaning: પ્રેક્ષણીય સ્થળો જોવા જવું.
words.usage_note: Usually 'go sightseeing'; visiting attractions.
examples: We spent the morning sightseeing in the city.
A sightseeing tour covered all the main spots.
After the picnic, we went sightseeing.
There's plenty of sightseeing to do here.

words.english_meaning: To relax and stop feeling anxious or tense.
words.gujarati_meaning: તણાવ ભૂલીને હળવા થવું / આરામ કરવો.
words.usage_note: To release stress; a getaway is a good way to unwind.
examples: A day in nature helps me unwind.
We went to the lake to unwind.
She unwinds by reading in the garden.
Picnics are a lovely way to unwind.

words.english_meaning: An outdoor meal where food is cooked over a fire or grill; also the grill itself.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખુલ્લામાં શેકીને જમવાનો કાર્યક્રમ / શેકેલું ભોજન.
words.usage_note: Both the event and the cooking equipment. Short form: 'BBQ'.
examples: We had a barbecue in the backyard.
They grilled vegetables on the barbecue.
A barbecue is perfect for a summer outing.
The smell of the barbecue filled the air.

words.english_meaning: A long walk in the countryside or mountains, for pleasure or exercise.
words.gujarati_meaning: કુદરતમાં લાંબી પગપાળા સફર.
words.usage_note: Longer and more energetic than a stroll; done in nature.
examples: We went for a hike up the hill.
The hike offered stunning views.
Wear good shoes for the long hike.
After the hike, we rested in the shade.

words.english_meaning: To sit or lie in a relaxed, lazy way.
words.gujarati_meaning: આળસથી પડ્યા રહીને આરામ કરવો.
words.usage_note: As a verb = relax lazily; (also a noun meaning a sitting room).
examples: We lounged on the grass after lunch.
They spent the afternoon lounging by the pool.
I love to lounge in the shade with a book.
We just lounged around and did nothing.

words.english_meaning: (Of the sky) covered with grey clouds; dull and cloudy.
words.gujarati_meaning: વાદળછાયું, સૂર્ય વગરનું આકાશ.
words.usage_note: Describes a fully cloudy sky (but not necessarily raining).
examples: The sky was overcast, so we took umbrellas.
It stayed overcast all afternoon.
An overcast day kept the picnic cool.
Despite the overcast sky, we had fun.

words.english_meaning: A gentle, light wind.
words.gujarati_meaning: હળવો, ઠંડો પવન.
words.usage_note: A pleasant light wind. Adjective: 'breezy'.
examples: A cool breeze made the picnic pleasant.
We enjoyed the gentle breeze by the river.
The sea breeze felt refreshing.
Leaves rustled in the soft breeze.

words.english_meaning: Light rain made of very fine drops.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઝરમર / હળવો વરસાદ.
words.usage_note: Both noun and verb; gentle, fine rain.
examples: A light drizzle began as we ate.
We carried on despite the drizzle.
It started to drizzle in the afternoon.
The drizzle soon stopped and the sun came out.

words.english_meaning: Extremely hot.
words.gujarati_meaning: અતિશય ગરમ, બાળી નાખે એવો તડકો.
words.usage_note: A strong word for very hot weather.
examples: It was a scorching day, so we stayed in the shade.
We avoided the scorching afternoon sun.
The scorching heat made us thirsty.
Carry water on a scorching day.

words.english_meaning: (Of air or weather) damp and sticky, with a lot of moisture.
words.gujarati_meaning: ભેજવાળું, ચીકાશભર્યું વાતાવરણ.
words.usage_note: Often paired with 'hot and humid'. Noun: 'humidity'.
examples: The weather was hot and humid.
It felt humid before the rain.
A humid afternoon left us sweaty.
The coast is very humid in summer.

words.english_meaning: Enjoyable, nice, and agreeable.
words.gujarati_meaning: સુખદ, સરસ (વાતાવરણ).
words.usage_note: Common for mild, comfortable weather or a nice time.
examples: The weather was pleasant for a picnic.
We had a pleasant afternoon by the lake.
A pleasant breeze cooled the air.
It was a pleasant change from the city heat.

words.english_meaning: Outdoors; in the fresh air rather than inside a building.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખુલ્લી હવામાં / બહાર, મકાનની બહાર.
words.usage_note: Emphasises being outside in fresh air.
words.memory_tip: ખુલ્લી હવામાં = in the open air.
examples: Eating in the open air feels wonderful.
We slept in the open air under the stars.
The concert was held in the open air.
There's nothing like exercise in the open air.

words.english_meaning: To use or enjoy something as much as possible.
words.gujarati_meaning: તકનો પૂરેપૂરો લાભ લેવો.
collocations: make the most of the day
words.usage_note: Idiom — get the maximum benefit or enjoyment.
words.memory_tip: પૂરેપૂરો લાભ લેવો = make the most of.
examples: Let's make the most of this sunny day.
We made the most of our short holiday.
Make the most of your time outdoors.
They made the most of the long weekend.

words.english_meaning: A new and different environment that makes you feel refreshed.
words.gujarati_meaning: વાતાવરણ / સ્થળ બદલવાથી મળતી તાજગી.
words.usage_note: Idiom — going somewhere different for a refreshing break.
words.memory_tip: સ્થળ બદલવાથી તાજગી = a change of scenery.
examples: A picnic gives us a nice change of scenery.
I needed a change of scenery after a busy week.
The countryside was a welcome change of scenery.
Sometimes a change of scenery lifts your mood.

words.english_meaning: So perfect and beautiful that it looks like a picture.
words.gujarati_meaning: ચિત્ર જેવું તદ્દન સંપૂર્ણ અને સુંદર.
words.usage_note: Strongly positive — ideal and lovely.
examples: We found a picture-perfect spot for the picnic.
The weather was picture-perfect.
It was a picture-perfect day by the sea.
The valley looked picture-perfect at sunset.

words.english_meaning: Relaxed and easy-going; not worried or in a hurry.
words.gujarati_meaning: શાંત, નિરાંતભર્યું, બેફિકર.
words.usage_note: Describes a relaxed mood, person, or atmosphere.
examples: The picnic had a lovely laid-back feel.
He has a very laid-back attitude.
We spent a laid-back afternoon by the river.
It was a laid-back gathering with no rush.

words.english_meaning: So beautiful or impressive that it amazes you.
words.gujarati_meaning: શ્વાસ થંભાવી દે એવું અતિ સુંદર / અદ્ભુત.
words.usage_note: Strongly positive — for stunning views or scenery.
words.memory_tip: શ્વાસ થંભાવી દે એવું સુંદર = breathtaking.
examples: The view from the hilltop was breathtaking.
We enjoyed breathtaking scenery on the trail.
The sunset over the sea was breathtaking.
It's a breathtaking spot for a picnic.

words.english_meaning: A pre-arranged meeting point or time agreed upon by a group before an outing.
words.gujarati_meaning: પહેલેથી નક્કી કરેલ મળવાની જગ્યા અથવા સમય — જ્યાં બધા ભેગા થવાના હોય.
words.usage_note: Borrowed from French; used in both military and casual social contexts for a planned meeting spot.
words.memory_tip: 'Rendezvous' = ભેગા થવાની જગ્યા → picnic પહેલાં ક્યાં મળવું તે નક્કી કરવું.
examples: Our rendezvous before the picnic is the park's main entrance at ten.
They chose the old oak tree as their rendezvous point.
Make sure everyone knows the rendezvous time so nobody gets left behind.
The group missed their rendezvous because of heavy traffic.

words.english_meaning: An arrangement where several people share one vehicle for a trip, splitting travel costs and effort.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક ગોઠવણ જેમાં ઘણા લોકો એક જ ગાડીમાં સાથે મુસાફરી કરે છે અને ખર્ચ વહેંચે છે.
words.usage_note: Very common in American English; also used as a verb — 'We carpooled to the event.'
words.memory_tip: 'Car' + 'pool' = ગાડીઓ ભેગી કરવી → carpool = ઘણા જણ એક ગાડીમાં.
examples: We decided to carpool to the picnic to save on parking fees.
Arranging a carpool made the outing much more affordable for everyone.
She volunteered to drive the carpool since her SUV had the most space.
The carpool left at eight sharp, so don't be late!

words.english_meaning: A count of the total number of people attending or present at an event.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઇવેન્ટ કે ભ્રમણમાં આવનારા અથવા હાજર વ્યક્તિઓની કુલ સંખ્યાની ગણતરી.
words.usage_note: Typically used before an event to plan food and logistics, or after to confirm all members are present.
words.memory_tip: 'Head' = માથું → headcount = માથા ગણવા → કેટલા લોકો આવ્યા?
examples: Can you do a headcount before we order the food?
The final headcount was thirty-two, more than we expected.
Always take a headcount before leaving the picnic site.
She sent a message asking for a headcount so she could book the right number of seats.

words.english_meaning: To reply to an invitation confirming whether you will or will not attend an event.
words.gujarati_meaning: આમંત્રણનો જવાબ આપવો — જણાવવું કે તમે આવશો કે નહીં.
words.usage_note: From French 'répondez s'il vous plaît'; now used as a verb in everyday English.
words.memory_tip: 'RSVP' = જવાબ આપો → picnic invite આવ્યું? RSVP કરો — 'હા' અથવા 'ના' કહો.
examples: Please RSVP by Thursday so we know how much food to bring.
Only half the group RSVP'd, which made planning difficult.
She forgot to RSVP and almost missed the outing.
We need everyone to RSVP before we can confirm the venue booking.

words.english_meaning: A meal or gathering where each guest contributes a dish of food to share with everyone.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક ભોજન-સભા જ્યાં દરેક ભાગ લેનાર પોતાની ડિશ લઈ આવે અને બધા મળી ખાય.
collocations: bring a dish for the potluck
words.usage_note: A potluck picnic is a popular, budget-friendly way to share a variety of foods without one person bearing all the cost.
words.memory_tip: 'Pot' = વાસણ + 'luck' = નસીબ → potluck = દરેક ઘરમાંથી ડિશ લઈ આવે → ભાતભાતની વાનગી.
examples: We decided to have a potluck picnic so everyone could bring their favourite dish.
She brought a big bowl of pasta salad to the potluck.
Potluck gatherings are a great way to try different home-cooked foods.
The potluck was a hit — there was something for everyone.

words.english_meaning: The act of visiting potential locations in advance to decide if they are suitable for an outing.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઓટ્ટિંગ માટે અગાઉ સ્થળ જોઈ આવવું — યોગ્ય છે કે નહીં તે ચકાસવા.
words.usage_note: Often used as 'scout out a location' — checking a place before committing to it for the group.
words.memory_tip: 'Scout' = ખોળવા નીકળવું → scouting = picnic ની જગ્યા અગાઉ જોઈ આવવી.
examples: We went scouting for the perfect spot near the lake last weekend.
A bit of location scouting saved us from choosing a crowded site.
He scouted out three different parks before settling on one.
Scouting the area ahead of time means no surprises on the day.

words.english_meaning: A backup plan made in case something goes wrong, such as bad weather cancelling an outdoor event.
words.gujarati_meaning: અણધારી ઘટના — જેમ કે ખરાબ હવામાન — ના સ્થિતિ માટે પહેલેથી તૈયાર કરેલ વૈકલ્પિક યોજના.
words.usage_note: Essential for outdoor events; commonly paired with 'in case of rain' or 'if the weather turns'.
words.memory_tip: 'Contingency' = અણધારી ઘટના → contingency plan = 'Plan B' — વરસાદ આવે તો ઘરે.
examples: Always have a contingency plan in case the weather ruins your picnic.
Our contingency plan was to move the gathering to the community hall.
She appreciated that the organiser had thought of a contingency plan for rain.
A good contingency plan keeps everyone relaxed even if things go wrong.

words.english_meaning: To organise and manage different people or activities so they work together smoothly for an event.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઇવેન્ટ સારી રીતે ચાલે તે માટે જુદા-જુદા લોકો અને કામોને ગોઠવવા અને સંચાલિત કરવા.
words.usage_note: Used when one person takes the lead in managing schedules, transport, and food for a group outing.
words.memory_tip: 'Co' = સાથે + 'ordinate' = ક્રમ → coordinate = બધું ક્રમમાં ગોઠવવું.
examples: She offered to coordinate the whole picnic so nobody else had to worry.
It takes real skill to coordinate a large group outing smoothly.
He coordinated the transport, food, and activities for the day.
Good coordination means the event runs without a hitch.

words.english_meaning: An estimate or plan of how much money will be spent on an outing and how it will be allocated.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઓટ્ટિંગ પર કેટલો ખર્ચ થશે અને ક્યાં-ક્યાં ખર્ચ વહેંચવો — એ અંગેનો અંદાજ અને આયોજન.
words.usage_note: Setting a budget per person prevents disagreements about spending after the outing.
words.memory_tip: 'Budget' = ખર્ચ-આયોજન → picnic budget = ખોરાક, ગાડી, ટિકિટ — બધા માટે ગણવું.
examples: We set a strict budget of five hundred rupees per person for the outing.
Keeping within budget meant we had to skip the boat ride.
She created a shared spreadsheet to track the picnic budget.
A clear budget stops arguments about who owes what after the trip.

words.english_meaning: A list of planned activities or events in order for the day of the outing.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઓટ્ટિંગ ના દિવસ માટે ક્રમ અનુસાર ગોઠવેલ પ્રવૃત્તિઓ અથવા ઘટનાઓની યાદી.
words.usage_note: While 'agenda' is often used in business meetings, it is equally useful for planning a structured day out.
words.memory_tip: 'Agenda' = શું-શું કરવું — ક્રમ અનુસાર → picnic agenda = સવારે નીકળો, બપોરે ખાઓ, સાંજે રમો.
examples: The agenda for the day included a nature walk, lunch, and games.
She shared the agenda on the group chat so everyone was prepared.
Having a clear agenda kept the outing on track.
The agenda was flexible — they could change activities if people wanted.

words.english_meaning: An insulated box used to keep food and drinks cold during an outdoor outing.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઠંડા ખોરાક અને પીણાં જાળવી રાખવા માટેનો ઇન્સ્યૂલેટેડ બૉક્સ — picnic વખતે ઉપયોગ.
words.usage_note: Called a 'cool box' in British English; usually packed with ice or reusable ice packs.
words.memory_tip: 'Cool' = ઠંડું → cooler = ઠંડું રાખવાવાળું બૉક્સ → picnic ની ઠંડી cold drink.
examples: We packed the cooler with sandwiches, fruit, and cold juice.
Don't forget to put ice in the cooler before you leave home.
The cooler kept the watermelon perfectly chilled all afternoon.
He lugged the heavy cooler all the way to the picnic spot.

words.english_meaning: A large, heavy-duty waterproof sheet used as ground cover or shelter during outdoor activities.
words.gujarati_meaning: મોટું, ટકાઉ, વૉટરપ્રૂફ કપડું — જમીન ઉપર પાથરવા અથવા વરસાદ સામે રક્ષણ માટે.
words.usage_note: Often shortened to 'tarp' in everyday speech; essential for sitting on damp grass or making a rain cover.
words.memory_tip: 'Tarpaulin' → tarp = ભેજ અને ગંદકીથી બચાવ → picnic માં ઘાસ પર બેસો, ભીં ન થાઓ.
examples: They spread a large tarpaulin under the trees before sitting down.
The tarpaulin doubled as a rain shelter when the clouds rolled in.
Always carry a tarp — the ground can be damp even on sunny days.
She weighted the corners of the tarpaulin with stones so it wouldn't blow away.

words.english_meaning: A lotion or cream applied to the skin to protect it from the sun's ultraviolet rays.
words.gujarati_meaning: ત્વચા પર લગાડવાની ક્રીમ — જે સૂર્યના નુકસાનકારક અલ્ટ્રાવાયોલેટ કિરણોથી રક્ષણ આપે.
words.usage_note: Dermatologists recommend SPF 30 or higher; must be reapplied every two hours when outdoors.
words.memory_tip: 'Sun' = સૂર્ય + 'screen' = ઢાંકવું → sunscreen = સૂર્યથી ત્વચા ઢાંકો.
examples: She reminded everyone to apply sunscreen before heading out to the meadow.
Always pack sunscreen, especially for summer picnics.
He forgot his sunscreen and ended up with a painful sunburn.
Reapply sunscreen every two hours for the best protection.

words.english_meaning: A spray or lotion that keeps insects such as mosquitoes away from the skin during outdoor activities.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક સ્પ્રે અથવા ક્રીમ — જે બહારે ફરતી વખતે મચ્છર વગેરે જીવડાઓને દૂર રાખે.
words.usage_note: Essential for picnics near water or in wooded areas; DEET-based sprays are the most effective.
words.memory_tip: 'Repellent' = ભગાડવું → insect repellent = જીવડાઓ ભગાડો → picnic ખૂબ આરામ.
examples: Don't go near the pond without insect repellent — the mosquitoes are terrible.
She packed two bottles of insect repellent for the forest picnic.
Apply insect repellent on exposed skin before sitting in the grass.
A good insect repellent can save your picnic from being ruined by bugs.

words.english_meaning: A vacuum-insulated container that keeps liquids hot or cold for several hours.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઇન્સ્યૂલેટેડ ડબ્બો — જે ઘણા કલાકો સુધી પ્રવાહી ગરમ અથવા ઠંડું રાખે.
words.usage_note: 'Thermos' is a brand name that has become a generic term; 'vacuum flask' is the technical alternative.
words.memory_tip: 'Thermos' = ગરમ-ઠંડું બચાવ → picnic ઉપર ગરમ ચા ઠંડી ન થાય — thermos ભરી લો.
examples: She brought a thermos of masala chai to enjoy in the cool morning air.
Pack a thermos of hot soup if the weather turns chilly.
The thermos kept the coffee piping hot for six hours.
He unscrewed the thermos lid and poured a steaming cup for everyone.

words.english_meaning: A lightweight portable table that folds flat for easy carrying and storage during outings.
words.gujarati_meaning: હળવો, વહન-સૂક્ષ્મ ટેબલ — જે ફ્લૅટ ફોલ્ડ થઈ જાય, picnic માટે સરળ.
words.usage_note: Often paired with folding chairs; makes outdoor dining much more comfortable for groups.
words.memory_tip: 'Folding' = ફોલ્ડ થવું → folding table = ફોલ્ડ થઈ ગાડીમાં આવી જાય — picnic ready!
examples: We set up a folding table so the kids had somewhere to eat comfortably.
The folding table made serving food so much easier than balancing plates on our laps.
He unfolded the table in seconds and placed it under the shade tree.
A folding table is worth its weight in gold at a large family picnic.

words.english_meaning: Pre-moistened disposable cloths used for cleaning hands or surfaces when water is not available outdoors.
words.gujarati_meaning: ભીના, ek-use, disposable કપડા — બહારે પાણી ન હોય ત્યારે હાથ અથવા સપાટી સાફ કરવા.
words.usage_note: An absolute picnic essential — useful for sticky fingers, spills, and when hand sanitiser is not enough.
words.memory_tip: 'Wet' = ભીનું + 'wipes' = લૂ → wet wipes = picnic ઉppar hath saf karo, pani vaghar.
examples: She handed out wet wipes after the kids finished their sticky mango slices.
Always pack a large pack of wet wipes for outdoor meals.
He used a wet wipe to clean the folding table before setting out the food.
Wet wipes saved the day when someone spilled juice on their shirt.

words.english_meaning: A durable bag made to be used many times, replacing single-use plastic bags when carrying picnic items.
words.gujarati_meaning: ટકાઉ બૅગ — જે વારંવાર વાપરી શકાય, plastic bag ના બદલે picnic નો સામાન લઈ જવા.
words.usage_note: Encouraged for environmental reasons; large canvas tote bags are popular for carrying picnic supplies.
words.memory_tip: 'Reusable' = ફ-repeatedly-use → reusable bag = ek-bar-not, vari-vari vaapar — eco-friendly.
examples: She carried all the food in a large reusable bag to avoid plastic waste.
Pack everything into reusable bags — it's better for the environment.
They used colourful reusable bags to sort food, games, and first-aid supplies.
A sturdy reusable bag can carry far more than a flimsy plastic one.

words.english_meaning: A small bag or box containing basic medical supplies for treating minor injuries during outings.
words.gujarati_meaning: નાની kit — picnic ઉppar minor injuries — cuts, burns, blisters — ની first treatment મા.
words.usage_note: Should include bandages, antiseptic wipes, pain relief tablets, and tweezers at minimum for outdoor trips.
words.memory_tip: 'First-aid' = first-help → picnic ness chhoti-injuries → first-aid kit = instant relief.
examples: Always pack a first-aid kit when heading outdoors, especially with children.
She used the first-aid kit to treat a small cut he got climbing a fence.
The first-aid kit had everything they needed for his bee sting.
A basic first-aid kit is non-negotiable on any outdoor outing.

words.english_meaning: A battery-powered device that can recharge mobile phones and other electronics while away from a power outlet.
words.gujarati_meaning: battery-powered gadget — picnic ness power-socket vaghar phone charge kari shake.
words.usage_note: Also known as a 'power bank'; essential for all-day outings when phones are used for navigation and photos.
words.memory_tip: 'Portable' = carry-able → portable charger = kahie-pana phone charge karo — power bank.
examples: His portable charger saved them when Google Maps drained the phone battery.
Pack a fully charged portable charger for long outdoor trips.
She shared her portable charger so everyone could take photos all day.
Without a portable charger, they would have had no way to call for a taxi.

words.english_meaning: A covering of branches and leaves formed by tree tops, or an overhead portable shelter at an outdoor spot.
words.gujarati_meaning: વૃક્ષોની ટોચ ઉppar-thi banel branch-leaf-ni natural chhatri — picnic ness shade aape.
words.usage_note: In a picnic context refers both to the natural tree canopy above and to portable pop-up shelters.
words.memory_tip: 'Canopy' = upper cover → tree canopy = trees-ni natural chhatri → picnic ness dhoop na laage.
examples: They spread their blanket beneath the cool green canopy of the mango trees.
The forest canopy filtered the sunlight into beautiful dappled patterns on the ground.
A pop-up canopy is useful when there are no trees for shade.
Sitting under the canopy, they barely noticed how hot the afternoon had become.

words.english_meaning: The summit or highest point of a hill, often offering wide open views of the surrounding landscape.
words.gujarati_meaning: ટેકરીનો સૌથી ઊppar-no bhag — aw-vast views mile — picnic mast spot.
words.usage_note: A popular picnic setting for the scenic views; the climb up is considered part of the experience.
words.memory_tip: 'Hill' = ટેકરી + 'top' = ઉppar → hilltop = tekri-no upar-bhag → view dhamo!
examples: They hiked up to the hilltop and spread their blanket to enjoy the sweeping views.
A hilltop picnic at sunset is one of the most romantic experiences.
The hilltop was breezy and cool, a perfect escape from the city heat.
You can see three villages from the hilltop on a clear day.

words.english_meaning: An area of land planted with fruit trees, often a scenic and shaded spot for a relaxed outdoor meal.
words.gujarati_meaning: ફળ-વૃક્ષોથી ભરેલ જમીન-no bhag — picnic mast shady spot — fruits-ni sugandhhi vaatavaran.
words.usage_note: A picnic in an orchard during blossom or harvest season is a particularly memorable experience.
words.memory_tip: 'Orchard' = aw-fruit garden → orchard-maa picnic = aw-shade + aw-fresh fruits.
examples: They laid their blanket in the cool shade of the old mango orchard.
The orchard was in full bloom, making it the perfect backdrop for the picnic.
Children love running between the trees in an orchard.
She picked a few fallen apples from the orchard to add to the picnic spread.

words.english_meaning: An area of land or a promenade situated directly beside a body of water such as a lake, river, or sea.
words.gujarati_meaning: તળાવ, નદી, અથવા સમુદ્ર-ની સીધ-ni-sathe-ni jameen — scenic picnic spot.
words.usage_note: Often a public park or promenade area; ideal for picnics as the breeze from the water keeps things cool.
words.memory_tip: 'Water' = પાણી + 'front' = સામ-ni-side → waterfront = paani-ni saame ni jameen.
examples: The city's waterfront park was the perfect place for their Sunday picnic.
They sat on the waterfront, watching the boats drift by as they ate.
A waterfront picnic spot always has a refreshing breeze.
The waterfront was busy with families enjoying the sunny afternoon.

words.english_meaning: Rural land outside towns and cities, typically featuring open fields, farmland, and natural scenery.
words.gujarati_meaning: શહેર-ner-thi-door-na gramin vistar — khuli khet, kheti, ane prakruti-ni sundarata.
words.usage_note: Used as an uncountable noun in most contexts — 'the countryside' rather than 'a countryside'.
words.memory_tip: 'Country' = gramin + 'side' = baar-no vistar → countryside = sheher-thi door prakruti.
examples: Nothing beats a picnic in the open countryside on a warm spring day.
They drove an hour out of the city to reach the rolling countryside.
The children loved exploring the countryside, spotting birds and wildflowers.
The countryside air felt so fresh after weeks spent in the city.

words.english_meaning: A small, still body of fresh water, smaller than a lake, often found in parks or countryside settings.
words.gujarati_meaning: નાનો, સ્ÿ-still, swacchhh-paani-no jhil — park ke graamin vistar-maa mole.
words.usage_note: A pond is smaller than a lake and usually shallower; park ponds often have ducks and are popular picnic spots.
words.memory_tip: 'Pond' = aw-small lake → duck pond-na-kinare picnic = shaant vataavaran.
examples: The children fed the ducks at the pond while the adults set out the picnic.
They found a shady spot right beside the duck pond.
The reflection of the trees on the still pond was breathtaking.
A picnic by the pond is the most peaceful way to spend a Sunday afternoon.

words.english_meaning: An open field covered with naturally growing wild flowers, creating a colourful and scenic picnic backdrop.
words.gujarati_meaning: khulaa maidan-maa kude-kude aw-naturally ugeli jangli phulvadi — rang-birangi ane sundar.
words.usage_note: Seasonal — most spectacular in spring and early summer; common in hill stations and national parks across India.
words.memory_tip: 'Wild' = jangli + 'flower' = phul + 'field' = maidan → wildflower field = jangli phulwadi.
examples: They spread their blanket in the middle of a stunning wildflower field.
The wildflower field smelled incredible on the warm spring afternoon.
She took dozens of photos of the children playing in the wildflower field.
A wildflower field in full bloom is one of nature's greatest spectacles.

words.english_meaning: The very top edge of a steep rock face, offering dramatic views but requiring caution.
words.gujarati_meaning: aw-steep paharadi-no sadam kinaro — dramatic views — paran dhyan-thi.
collocations: picnic with a cliff edge view
words.usage_note: Picnics near cliff edges should be approached with caution; keep children and pets safely back from the edge.
words.memory_tip: 'Cliff' = aw-pahari-kinaro + 'edge' = kinaaro → cliff edge = aw-upar-no pahari-kinaro.
examples: They set up their picnic just back from the cliff edge to admire the coastal views safely.
The cliff edge offered an uninterrupted view of the ocean for miles.
Children were kept well away from the cliff edge during the outing.
A light breeze blew in from the sea as they sat near the cliff edge.

words.english_meaning: A path or road surfaced with small rounded stones, often found in old town gardens and historic outdoor spaces.
words.gujarati_meaning: gol-gol nana pathharaa-thi bnaeli vaat — purani garden ya historic jaga-maa mole.
words.usage_note: Often associated with heritage gardens and old European-style parks; adds a picturesque quality to an outing.
words.memory_tip: 'Cobblestone' = gol-gol pathhar + 'path' = vaat → cobblestone path = purani pathar-wali vaat.
examples: They strolled along the cobblestone path to find the perfect picnic spot.
The cobblestone path through the heritage garden was lined with rose bushes.
Watch your step on the cobblestone path — it can be slippery when wet.
The cobblestone path added a charming old-world feel to their afternoon outing.

words.english_meaning: An open space within a forest where trees are absent, often filled with grass and natural light.
words.gujarati_meaning: jungle-ni-vaache-no khulo maidan — jyaa vraksh nathi — ghass ane prakash bharyo.
words.usage_note: A poetic and literary word for a clearing in the woods; used in nature writing and travel descriptions.
words.memory_tip: 'Glade' = jungle-ni-vaache khulo bhag → glade-maa picnic = shade + light + prakriti.
examples: They discovered a beautiful sunlit glade at the heart of the forest.
The glade was carpeted with soft grass — the perfect picnic spot.
Birdsong filled the peaceful glade as they unpacked their lunch.
A glade feels magical — surrounded by trees yet open to the sky.

words.english_meaning: A lightweight plastic disc thrown and caught between players as an outdoor recreational game.
words.gujarati_meaning: aw-halku plastic disc — players vaache pheki-pakdi — picnic outdoor game.
words.usage_note: 'Frisbee' is a brand name; 'flying disc' is the generic term. A classic picnic activity for all ages.
words.memory_tip: 'Frisbee' = aw-gol disc — pheko, pakdo → picnic-ni-mast outdoor game.
examples: The kids spent hours throwing the frisbee across the open lawn.
A frisbee is the easiest game to pack for a day out — it weighs almost nothing.
They organised a friendly frisbee tournament after lunch.
Even the dog joined in the frisbee game, leaping to catch it mid-air.

words.english_meaning: The recreational activity of flying a kite in the open air, typically done in breezy open spaces.
words.gujarati_meaning: khuli hava-maa patang-udaadavani kriya — breeze-no faydo uthaavine masti karo.
words.usage_note: Best done in open fields or hills where there are no trees or power lines to snag the kite string.
words.memory_tip: 'Kite' = patang → kite-flying = patang udaadvanu → Uttarayan jaisi masti picnic-maa.
examples: The wide-open field was perfect for kite-flying after their picnic lunch.
She taught her nephew how to launch a kite for the first time.
Kite-flying is one of those timeless activities the whole family enjoys.
The sky above the park was dotted with colourful kites all afternoon.

words.english_meaning: A game where participants search for a list of specific items or complete tasks in an outdoor setting.
words.gujarati_meaning: aw-game — jyaa badhaa log yaadi-maa-apela items-ni khoj kare — outdoor setting-maa.
words.usage_note: A nature scavenger hunt — finding specific leaves, stones, or birds — is a great way to engage children outdoors.
words.memory_tip: 'Scavenger' = khaajvaalavaa + 'hunt' = khojavanu → scavenger hunt = items-ni masti khoj.
examples: She prepared a nature scavenger hunt list for the children to complete during the picnic.
The scavenger hunt kept the kids busy and excited for hours.
Teams competed to finish the scavenger hunt before the sun set.
Finding all the items on the scavenger hunt list felt like a real adventure.

words.english_meaning: Wading in shallow water, usually a stream or the sea, as a leisurely outdoor activity.
words.gujarati_meaning: aw-uttla paani-maa-chalavanu — nadi ke dariya-na kinare — shaant ane anandmay kriya.
words.usage_note: A very British activity — rolling up trousers and wading into a shallow stream or the sea at the seaside.
words.memory_tip: 'Paddle' = uttlaa paani-maa chaalvu → paddling = picnic-na kinare paani-maa-ramvu.
examples: The children went paddling in the cool stream while the adults relaxed on the bank.
She rolled up her jeans and joined the kids for a spot of paddling.
Paddling in the shallow river was the highlight of their countryside outing.
On hot days, paddling in cool water is the perfect outdoor activity.

words.english_meaning: A leisurely walk taken in a natural outdoor setting to observe and appreciate wildlife and scenery.
words.gujarati_meaning: prakruti-maa-chalavanu — pakshio, phuldo, ane vaatavaran joi aanand levanu — shaant bhramriti.
words.usage_note: A nature walk differs from a hike in that it is slow, observational, and focused on wildlife and plants.
words.memory_tip: 'Nature' = prakriti + 'walk' = chalavanu → nature walk = prakriti-maa shaantthi chalo ane joi lyo.
examples: They went on a guided nature walk before settling down for their picnic.
A nature walk after lunch aids digestion and lifts the spirits.
The children spotted three different bird species on the nature walk.
She brought a wildflower guidebook along to identify plants on the nature walk.

words.english_meaning: A team sport played outdoors by hitting an inflated ball over a net, popular at beach and park outings.
words.gujarati_meaning: team sport — net uparthhi ball maarvano — beach ane park outings-maa-popular.
words.usage_note: A portable net and ball make it a popular activity at large group picnics; beach volleyball is a famous variant.
words.memory_tip: 'Volley' = utha-ane-maaro + 'ball' = dando → volleyball = net upar-thi ball maarvano game.
examples: They set up a portable net and played volleyball all afternoon.
Volleyball is a brilliant group activity for a beach outing.
She served the ball over the net to start the first game of volleyball.
The volleyball match was so competitive that nobody wanted to stop for dinner.

words.english_meaning: The activity of observing stars and constellations in the night sky, often done lying on a blanket outdoors.
words.gujarati_meaning: raatri-na-aakaash-maa-tara ane constellations-joi aanand levanu — blanket-par-suti joine.
words.usage_note: Best away from city lights; a simple activity requiring only a clear sky and a blanket.
words.memory_tip: 'Star' = taro + 'gaze' = takki-jovu → stargazing = tarao jota rehvu raat-e.
examples: They extended the outing into the evening for some stargazing.
With no city lights nearby, the stargazing was absolutely spectacular.
She brought a star chart to help identify the constellations.
Stargazing on a blanket with good company is one of life's simple pleasures.

words.english_meaning: The activity of riding a bicycle, often done on scenic outdoor trails or paths as part of an outing.
words.gujarati_meaning: cycle-chalavanu — scenic rastaao ke trails-par — outing-no ekk-anandmay hisso.
words.usage_note: Can be combined with a picnic — cycle to a scenic spot, eat, then cycle back.
words.memory_tip: 'Cycle' = saaik-al → cycling = cycle-chalavanu → picnic spot-sudhi cycle-thi javo.
examples: They went cycling through the countryside before stopping for a lakeside picnic.
Cycling is a fun and healthy way to explore a new outdoor area.
She hired a bicycle from the park's rental shop for the afternoon.
The cycling trail wound through beautiful forest and meadows.

words.english_meaning: An outdoor fire lit in a safe spot for warmth, cooking, or socialising on an outing or camping trip.
words.gujarati_meaning: suurakshit jagha-e-bahar-jalaveli aag — garmi, rasvad, ane dosti-masti maate.
words.usage_note: Always check local regulations before lighting a campfire; fire bans are common in dry seasons.
words.memory_tip: 'Camp' = darbaari-vaas + 'fire' = aag → campfire = bahar jalaveli masti-ni aag.
examples: They gathered around the campfire as the sun set over the hills.
She toasted marshmallows over the campfire with the children.
The campfire stories kept everyone entertained long into the night.
Check the park's rules before lighting a campfire — some areas ban open fires.

words.english_meaning: The activity of making quick freehand drawings of the surrounding landscape or objects during an outing.
words.gujarati_meaning: picnic-daramyan aasjubaaj-ni prakriti ya vastu-ni jaldi-jaldi aakruti dori — creative anand.
words.usage_note: A peaceful solo activity perfect for artistic members of the group while others play games.
words.memory_tip: 'Sketch' = aakruti dori → sketching = picnic-maa-beshine prakriti dori — creative masti.
examples: She spent the afternoon sketching the rolling hills while the others played frisbee.
Sketching outdoors is a wonderful way to slow down and really observe your surroundings.
He filled an entire notebook with sketches from their countryside outings.
Even a simple pencil and paper are enough for a satisfying session of sketching.

words.english_meaning: The direct light and warmth from the sun, considered ideal for outdoor picnics and outings.
words.gujarati_meaning: suraj-no seedho prakash ane garmi — picnic mast hava-maa — best weather condition.
words.usage_note: Used both literally and idiomatically — 'You are my sunshine' means someone who brings happiness.
words.memory_tip: 'Sun' = suraj + 'shine' = chamakvu → sunshine = suraj-no chamakto prakash → picnic-ni mast hava.
examples: The picnic was perfect — hours of glorious sunshine and not a cloud in sight.
She sat with her eyes closed, simply basking in the warm sunshine.
Sunshine makes even an ordinary park look magical.
After a week of rain, the sunshine on Saturday felt like a gift.

words.english_meaning: Describing wind that blows in sudden, strong bursts rather than steadily.
words.gujarati_meaning: aw-pavan jo vaaranghevaar achaanek tej jhatka-maa aave — shaant nahi, vaaranghevaar.
words.usage_note: Gusty conditions make kite-flying fun but can blow away napkins and picnic covers.
words.memory_tip: 'Gust' = pavan-no achaanek jhatko → gusty = achaanek-achaanek-no tej pavan.
examples: The gusty wind kept blowing the paper plates off the table.
It was a beautiful but gusty day — perfect for kite-flying.
Hold onto your hat — it's getting quite gusty out there!
Gusty conditions on the hilltop made the picnic a bit challenging.

words.english_meaning: The time of day just after sunset when the light is fading but it is not yet fully dark.
words.gujarati_meaning: suryaast-baad-no samay — jyaare aakash-no prakash mand pade chhe pan-haju raat-naahi.
words.usage_note: A picnic that runs until dusk is memorable for the warm golden light and cooler temperatures.
words.memory_tip: 'Dusk' = suryaast-baad-ni sandhyaa → dusk = din-raat-ni sandhivela — sundar rang.
examples: They stayed until dusk, watching the sky turn shades of pink and orange.
At dusk, the temperature dropped and they finally felt comfortable.
The picnic stretched from noon until dusk — an unforgettable day.
Mosquitoes tend to come out at dusk, so pack your insect repellent.

words.english_meaning: Describing air or weather that is unpleasantly warm, damp, and humid, making it feel suffocating.
words.gujarati_meaning: aw-hava jo garm ane bhejvali hoi — uncomfortable-feeling — sweat vadhare aave.
words.usage_note: Common in tropical and monsoon climates; a muggy day makes an outdoor picnic feel more tiring.
words.memory_tip: 'Muggy' = garm-ane-bhejvali hava → muggy day = paseena-vale picnic — cooler jaruri!
examples: It was a muggy afternoon and everyone felt drained before the picnic even began.
The muggy air made it hard to stay comfortable sitting in the sun.
Bring extra cold water on muggy days — dehydration happens quickly.
A light shade cloth made all the difference on the muggy summer afternoon.

words.english_meaning: Describing a sky that is completely covered with clouds, blocking direct sunlight without necessarily raining.
words.gujarati_meaning: aw-aakash jo vaadate badha-j-vaadallo-thi dhakayelo hoi — seedho suraj-prakash na aave.
words.usage_note: An overcast day can actually be ideal for a picnic — no harsh sun, still pleasant temperature.
words.memory_tip: 'Over' = upar + 'cast' = phailayelu → overcast = vaadalla-e-aakash dhaki lidhu.
examples: The sky was overcast but dry — perfect conditions for a comfortable picnic.
Don't cancel just because it's overcast; the soft light is actually lovely.
An overcast morning gave way to beautiful sunshine by the afternoon.
The overcast sky kept the temperature mild and pleasant all day.

words.english_meaning: Noticeably cold enough to feel uncomfortable without warm clothing, but not freezing.
words.gujarati_meaning: thodi thand — jacket vaghar-na-chhuttu — par-dhadhatho thand naahi — bahaar uncomfortable.
words.usage_note: Often used for mornings and evenings; 'There's a chill in the air' is a very common expression.
words.memory_tip: 'Chilly' = thodi thand → chilly morning = sweater-laavo → picnic-maa jacket-sathe-jao.
examples: The morning was chilly, so they wrapped up in jackets before heading out.
Bring a warm layer — evenings by the lake can get quite chilly.
Despite the chilly start, it warmed up beautifully by midday.
A chilly breeze came off the river, which was actually quite refreshing.

words.english_meaning: Scattered, irregular areas of cloud in the sky, alternating with patches of blue sky and sunshine.
words.gujarati_meaning: aakash-maa-thodhaa-thodhaa vaadalla — vaachhe-vaachhe nilun aakash ane sunshine.
words.usage_note: Common in weather forecasts; picnic days with patchy cloud are often very pleasant as the cloud provides natural shade.
words.memory_tip: 'Patchy' = aw-thodhaa-thodhaa → patchy cloud = aw-vaadalla pachi-sunshine — picnic-mast.
examples: The forecast said patchy cloud, which turned out to be ideal picnic weather.
Patchy cloud meant they got some sun and some shade throughout the day.
With patchy cloud, the temperature stayed comfortable all afternoon.
She kept an eye on the patchy clouds in case they gathered into rain.

words.english_meaning: Describing weather that is moderately warm and calm, with no extremes of temperature or precipitation.
words.gujarati_meaning: aw-havaaman jo na vadhare garm-na-vadhare thand — saamaanya ane aaaraamdaayak.
words.usage_note: Mild is the ideal descriptor for a perfect picnic day — not too hot, not too cold.
words.memory_tip: 'Mild' = majhyam — na garm na thand → mild day = perfect picnic day.
examples: The weather was mild and sunny — a perfect day for an outing.
March brings mild temperatures that are just right for outdoor dining.
Even in November, the climate here is mild enough for a picnic.
A mild breeze made the afternoon feel absolutely perfect.

words.english_meaning: A brief, light spell of rain that typically passes quickly, as opposed to heavy or continuous rainfall.
words.gujarati_meaning: thodi-varr-maat-raa-ni halki varsha — jaldi-thi-pasar-thai-jaay — varasaad-nahi-pun-thodi-varsha.
words.usage_note: In British English, 'a shower' almost always refers to a brief rain event; 'scattered showers' means short bursts throughout the day.
words.memory_tip: 'Shower' = thodi varsha → scattered showers = thodi-thodi-ne-jaldi-pass-thai-jaay varasaad.
examples: There might be a shower or two, but it should clear up by lunchtime.
A passing shower kept them under the tree for about ten minutes.
The forecast showed scattered showers, so they packed a waterproof jacket.
Don't let a brief shower put you off — it rarely lasts long.

words.english_meaning: The period shortly after sunrise or just before sunset when sunlight is soft, warm, and golden-coloured.
words.gujarati_meaning: suryoday-baad ke suryaast-pahela-no samay — jyaare suraj-no prakash garam-sona-jevo ane komal hoi.
words.usage_note: Beloved by photographers; timing a picnic for golden hour creates stunning photos and a magical atmosphere.
words.memory_tip: 'Golden' = sona-jevo + 'hour' = samay → golden hour = suraj-ni sundar-aaphi-roshni-no samay.
examples: They timed their hilltop picnic to enjoy the golden hour before sunset.
The golden hour light made every photograph from the outing look stunning.
Nothing beats sitting outdoors during golden hour with good food and friends.
She packed up just before golden hour so they could watch the sky change colour.

words.english_meaning: Describing an experience that restores energy, freshness, and vitality, making you feel renewed.
words.gujarati_meaning: aw-anubhav jo taazgi ane urja paacho aape — thaakyu man-tantu-fari-taaju thay.
words.usage_note: A slightly formal adjective, but natural in reviews and personal accounts of a particularly refreshing outing.
words.memory_tip: 'Rejuvenate' = fari-navanuu → rejuvenating picnic = thakelo man fari-taazu — juvaan-jevi feeling.
examples: The day-long picnic in the hills was thoroughly rejuvenating.
She came back from the outing feeling rejuvenated and ready for the week ahead.
There is something deeply rejuvenating about spending a full day in nature.
A rejuvenating break outdoors can do more good than any spa treatment.

words.english_meaning: Describing something so special or remarkable that it is easily and fondly remembered.
words.gujarati_meaning: aw-khaas-anubhav — je etlu-sundar-hoi ke yaadagaar-bani-jaay — bhulatu naahi.
words.usage_note: Very versatile — can describe a meal, a view, a conversation, or an entire day out.
words.memory_tip: 'Memory' = yaad + 'able' = karva-yogya → memorable = yaadgaar — bhulatu naahi.
examples: It was the most memorable picnic we had ever been on.
The sunset view from the hilltop made the whole day truly memorable.
She created a scrapbook of the outing to preserve the memorable moments.
Memorable experiences are made by the people you share them with.

words.english_meaning: Calm, peaceful, and undisturbed — describing a place or atmosphere that inspires quiet contentment.
words.gujarati_meaning: shaant, aanandmay ane nishchal — aw-jaga ya vataavaran je man-ne-chain-aape.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe natural settings like lakesides and forests; a go-to word in travel and lifestyle writing.
words.memory_tip: 'Serene' = shaant ane nishchal → serene picnic spot = jyaa man ek-dam chain maane.
examples: The forest glade was so serene that nobody wanted to break the silence.
She described the hilltop picnic as serene and utterly restorative.
A serene setting makes even simple food taste more delicious.
The serene atmosphere of the orchard instantly calmed her busy mind.
