words.usage_note: Team-building activities help boost team spirit and improve workplace relationships.
words.memory_tip: 'team spirit' = team + spirit → team = juth + spirit = bhaav → team spirit = milelu bhaav.
examples: The manager organised activities to build team spirit.
High team spirit improves overall performance.
The competition between departments reduced team spirit.
Team spirit was high after winning the company award.

words.english_meaning: A person of lower rank or status who reports to a superior.
words.gujarati_meaning: Ochhu pad dhravta vayakti jo oocha adhikarine report kare.
words.usage_note: Good managers delegate effectively and treat subordinates with respect.
words.memory_tip: 'subordinate' = sub + ordinate → sub = neeche → subordinate = neeche wala.
examples: She manages five direct subordinates.
He treated his subordinates with great respect.
Good communication between manager and subordinate is essential.
Empower your subordinates by giving them responsibility.

words.english_meaning: The conduct, behaviour, and attitude expected of a professional person.
words.gujarati_meaning: Vyavsayik vayaktitha apekshit aacharan, vyavahar ane abhigam.
words.usage_note: Professionalism includes punctuality, proper communication, and meeting standards.
words.memory_tip: 'professionalism' = professional + ism → vayasayikta → professionalism = office ma sahi aacharan.
examples: She is known for her high level of professionalism.
Professionalism in the workplace builds trust and respect.
He handled the client complaint with great professionalism.
Always demonstrate professionalism in your emails.

words.english_meaning: A harmonious relationship with mutual trust and understanding.
words.gujarati_meaning: Parasparik vishvaas ane samajana saathe saras sambandha.
words.usage_note: Building rapport with clients and colleagues improves communication and outcomes.
words.memory_tip: 'rapport' = re + port → carry back → rapport = ek bija pase vaatoni aapali.
examples: She quickly built rapport with the new client.
Good rapport between manager and team boosts morale.
He has strong rapport with all departments.
Building rapport requires active listening and empathy.

words.english_meaning: The ability to understand and share the feelings of another person.
words.gujarati_meaning: Bija ni laagani samajva ane tena jeva anubhav karva ni kshamata.
words.usage_note: Leaders with empathy create more positive and inclusive workplaces.
words.memory_tip: 'empathy' = em + pathy → feel + inside → empathy = andar thi samajvanu.
examples: She showed empathy when a colleague was going through a tough time.
Empathy is a key leadership quality.
He handled the complaint with empathy and patience.
Workplace empathy builds stronger teams.

words.english_meaning: The fact or condition of being responsible for one's actions and decisions.
words.gujarati_meaning: Potana karyono ane nirnayoni jimmedari svikarva ni sthiti.
words.usage_note: Accountability means accepting responsibility when things go wrong, not just when they go right.
words.memory_tip: 'accountability' = account + ability → account = hisab → accountability = hisab aapva ni kshamata.
examples: She took full accountability for the project's failure.
Accountability is the foundation of trust in a team.
He refused to take accountability for the mistake.
A culture of accountability improves team performance.

words.english_meaning: A formal complaint made by an employee about a workplace issue.
words.gujarati_meaning: Karmachari dwara karyasthal na preshna ange karatee sattaavar farayad.
words.usage_note: All companies should have a formal grievance procedure for employees to raise concerns.
words.memory_tip: 'grievance' = grieve + ance → grieve = dukhi thavanu → grievance = dukh no sattavar avaaj.
examples: She filed a formal grievance about the manager's behaviour.
The HR team handles all employee grievances.
A grievance procedure ensures fair treatment.
He raised a grievance regarding unequal pay.

words.english_meaning: Aggressive, intimidating, or unwanted behaviour directed at someone in the workplace.
words.gujarati_meaning: Karyasthal ma koi prati avandhu, dabavtu athava agrahyo aacharan.
words.usage_note: Harassment is illegal in most countries; employees should report it to HR immediately.
words.memory_tip: 'harassment' = harry + ment → harry = tang karvanu → harassment = tang karva nu aacharan.
examples: She reported workplace harassment to the HR department.
Harassment of any kind is not tolerated in our company.
He faced legal consequences for workplace harassment.
All employees must complete anti-harassment training.

words.english_meaning: Including everyone, especially people from different backgrounds, without discrimination.
words.gujarati_meaning: Bhedabhav vagar badha ne, khaaskarake alag alag pachhapatna ne, saamil karvu.
words.usage_note: An inclusive workplace values diversity and ensures all voices are heard.
words.memory_tip: 'inclusive' = include + ive → include = samavesh → inclusive = badha ne samaviltu.
examples: The company promotes an inclusive workplace culture.
Inclusive policies attract diverse talent.
She ensured the meeting was inclusive of all team members.
An inclusive leader values every team member's opinion.

words.english_meaning: Working together with others to achieve a common goal.
words.gujarati_meaning: Ek samaan lakshya padhava mate bija saathe saath kaam karvu.
words.usage_note: Collaboration tools like Slack, Teams, and Notion facilitate remote team collaboration.
words.memory_tip: 'collaboration' = co + labor + ation → saath + mehnat → collaboration = saath mehnat.
examples: Collaboration between departments improved the project outcome.
She encouraged collaboration by sharing resources openly.
Effective collaboration requires trust and communication.
The new platform was designed for real-time collaboration.

words.english_meaning: Acknowledgement of someone's efforts, achievements, or contributions at work.
words.gujarati_meaning: Karyasthal ma koi ni mehnat, uplabdhi ya yogdaan ni kadra karvi.
words.usage_note: Employee recognition boosts morale, engagement, and retention.
words.memory_tip: 'recognition' = re + cognize → pharthi jaanvu → recognition = tamara kaami ni kadra.
examples: She received recognition for her contribution to the project.
Employee recognition programs improve motivation.
He gave public recognition to his team at the annual dinner.
Lack of recognition is a top reason employees leave jobs.

mini_dialogues.title: Discussing a Project Deadline
mini_dialogues.situation: Two colleagues discuss an approaching project deadline.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Hey, have you checked the project deadline? It's this Friday.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I know. I've been trying to prioritize the key deliverables, but we still have a backlog.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Should we request a deadline extension from the manager?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Let's first see what can be done by tomorrow. We can clarify the situation with him in the morning briefing.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good idea. I'll prepare a short summary of where we stand right now.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Perfect. Let's make sure we communicate clearly so there are no surprises.

mini_dialogues.title: Running a Team Meeting
mini_dialogues.situation: A manager facilitates a team meeting to discuss targets and action points.

turns.speaker: Manager
turns.text: Good morning everyone. Let's begin. I've shared the agenda by email — please take a look.

turns.speaker: Employee A
turns.text: I noticed the first agenda item is the quarterly targets. Are we on track?

turns.speaker: Manager
turns.text: Mostly yes, but we need to brainstorm ways to close the gap before month-end.

turns.speaker: Employee B
turns.text: I think the bottleneck is in the approval process. That's slowing us down.

turns.speaker: Manager
turns.text: Good point. Let's list that as an action point — we'll resolve it by Wednesday.

turns.speaker: Employee A
turns.text: Should I take the minutes so we have a clear record?

turns.speaker: Manager
turns.text: Yes please. Let's wrap up in twenty minutes so we can get back to work.

mini_dialogues.title: A Performance Appraisal Conversation
mini_dialogues.situation: A manager and employee discuss the employee's annual appraisal.

turns.speaker: Manager
turns.text: Thank you for coming in. Let's go through your performance review for this year.

turns.speaker: Employee
turns.text: Of course. I'm looking forward to your feedback.

turns.speaker: Manager
turns.text: Overall, your work has been excellent. You've met all your targets and shown great professionalism.

turns.speaker: Employee
turns.text: Thank you. I've worked hard on my time management this year.

turns.speaker: Manager
turns.text: It shows. Based on your appraisal, we're recommending you for a promotion.

turns.speaker: Employee
turns.text: That's wonderful news. I'm grateful for the recognition and the opportunity.

mini_dialogues.title: Handling a Workplace Conflict
mini_dialogues.situation: HR facilitates conflict resolution between two colleagues.

turns.speaker: HR
turns.text: I understand there's been some tension between you two. Let's try to resolve this professionally.

turns.speaker: Employee A
turns.text: I raised a grievance because I felt my colleague was taking credit for my work.

turns.speaker: Employee B
turns.text: That wasn't my intention at all. I should have acknowledged your contribution in the report.

turns.speaker: HR
turns.text: Thank you for being open. Accountability is key here. Can you both agree on how to collaborate better going forward?

turns.speaker: Employee A
turns.text: Yes. I'd appreciate more clear communication and recognition when I contribute.

turns.speaker: Employee B
turns.text: Agreed. I'll make sure to acknowledge everyone's efforts in future reports.

mini_dialogues.title: Preparing for a Client Presentation
mini_dialogues.situation: Two colleagues prepare a slide deck and rehearse for a client presentation.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Is the slide deck ready for tomorrow's presentation?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Almost. I just need to add the Q3 figures and a summary slide at the end.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Make sure you summarize the key findings clearly. The client wants to reach a consensus on the proposal quickly.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Understood. I'll also prepare a few talking points for the Q&A session.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good. Don't forget to connect the laptop to the projector before they arrive.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Already booked the conference room and checked the projector. We're all set.

words.english_meaning: A physical or mental sign that indicates the presence of a disease or condition.
words.gujarati_meaning: રોગ કે બીમારી હોવાનું દર્શાવતું શારીરિક અથવા માનસિક ચિહ્ન.
words.usage_note: Used to describe what a patient feels or shows, not the disease itself.
examples: Fever is a common symptom of many infections.
She ignored the early symptoms of the illness.
Please describe your symptoms to the doctor.
A persistent cough can be a symptom of something serious.

words.english_meaning: The identification of a disease by examining the symptoms and test results.
words.gujarati_meaning: લક્ષણો અને તપાસના આધારે રોગ ઓળખવાની પ્રક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: A diagnosis is the doctor's conclusion, while a prognosis is the predicted outcome.
examples: The doctor's diagnosis was a mild viral infection.
Early diagnosis greatly improves the chances of recovery.
They sought a second opinion to confirm the diagnosis.
An accurate diagnosis requires several tests.

words.english_meaning: Describing an illness that lasts for a long time or keeps recurring.
words.gujarati_meaning: લાંબા સમય સુધી ચાલતો અથવા વારંવાર પાછો આવતો રોગ.
words.usage_note: Contrast with 'acute', which means severe but short-lived.
examples: He suffers from chronic back pain.
Diabetes is a chronic condition that needs daily care.
Chronic stress can damage your health over time.
She has been managing a chronic illness for years.

words.english_meaning: A feeling of sickness in the stomach with an urge to vomit.
words.gujarati_meaning: પેટમાં ઊબકા આવવા અને ઊલટી થવાની લાગણી.
words.usage_note: 'Nauseous' describes the person feeling it; 'nauseating' describes what causes it.
examples: The patient complained of nausea after the meal.
Pregnancy often brings nausea in the early months.
The medicine may cause mild nausea.
A wave of nausea hit her on the bumpy ride.

words.english_meaning: Redness, swelling, and pain in a part of the body as a reaction to injury or infection.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઈજા કે ચેપના કારણે શરીરના ભાગમાં થતો સોજો, લાલાશ અને દુખાવો.
words.usage_note: It is the body's natural defence, but excessive inflammation can be harmful.
words.memory_tip: 'flame' = જ્વાળા → શરીરમાં બળતરા જેવો સોજો → સોજો/બળતરા.
examples: The doctor prescribed a cream to reduce the inflammation.
Inflammation of the joints causes severe pain.
Chronic inflammation is linked to many diseases.
Ice can help bring down the inflammation quickly.

words.english_meaning: Able to be spread from one person to another through contact.
words.gujarati_meaning: સંપર્ક દ્વારા એક વ્યક્તિથી બીજામાં ફેલાઈ શકે તેવો (ચેપી).
words.usage_note: 'Contagious' usually spreads by direct contact, while 'infectious' can spread by air or water too.
examples: The flu is highly contagious during the first few days.
He stayed home because his illness was contagious.
Measles is one of the most contagious diseases.
Wash your hands to avoid spreading contagious germs.

words.english_meaning: Extreme tiredness resulting from physical or mental effort or illness.
words.gujarati_meaning: શારીરિક કે માનસિક શ્રમ કે બીમારીથી થતો ભારે થાક.
words.usage_note: More formal than 'tiredness' and common in medical descriptions.
examples: She felt extreme fatigue after the long surgery.
Chronic fatigue made it hard for him to work.
Lack of sleep often leads to mental fatigue.
The doctor said his fatigue was caused by low iron.

words.english_meaning: A fixed time arranged to meet a doctor or specialist.
words.gujarati_meaning: ડૉક્ટર કે નિષ્ણાતને મળવા માટે નક્કી કરેલો સમય.
words.usage_note: You 'make', 'keep', 'cancel', or 'reschedule' an appointment.
words.memory_tip: 'point' = નક્કી કરવું → સમય નક્કી કરવો → મુલાકાતનો સમય.
examples: I have a dental appointment at four o'clock.
Please call to make an appointment with the doctor.
She had to cancel her appointment due to work.
Don't be late for your appointment tomorrow.

words.english_meaning: A meeting with a doctor to get medical advice or discuss a condition.
words.gujarati_meaning: તબીબી સલાહ લેવા કે સ્થિતિ વિશે ચર્ચા કરવા ડૉક્ટર સાથેની મુલાકાત.
words.usage_note: Often used for a longer, advice-focused visit rather than a quick check.
words.memory_tip: 'consult' = સલાહ લેવી → સલાહ માટેની મુલાકાત → પરામર્શ.
examples: The consultation lasted nearly half an hour.
You can book an online consultation from home.
After the consultation, the doctor ordered some tests.
A specialist consultation is needed for this case.

words.english_meaning: A written instruction from a doctor for medicines a patient should take.
words.gujarati_meaning: દર્દીએ કઈ દવા લેવી તે અંગે ડૉક્ટરે લખેલી સૂચના (ચિઠ્ઠી).
words.usage_note: Some medicines are 'prescription-only' and cannot be bought without one.
words.memory_tip: 'pre' = પહેલાં + 'script' (લખવું) → ડૉક્ટરે લખી આપેલું → દવાની ચિઠ્ઠી.
examples: The doctor gave me a prescription for antibiotics.
Take this prescription to the pharmacy.
You need a prescription to buy these tablets.
She forgot to fill her prescription on time.

words.english_meaning: The act of sending a patient to a specialist for further treatment.
words.gujarati_meaning: વધુ સારવાર માટે દર્દીને નિષ્ણાત પાસે મોકલવાની પ્રક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: Many specialists require a referral from a general doctor before seeing you.
examples: My doctor gave me a referral to a cardiologist.
You will need a referral before the appointment.
The referral letter explained my medical history.
Without a referral, the specialist cannot see you.

words.english_meaning: A routine medical examination to make sure a person is healthy.
words.gujarati_meaning: વ્યક્તિ સ્વસ્થ છે કે નહીં તે જોવા માટેની નિયમિત તબીબી તપાસ.
words.usage_note: Usually preventive, done even when the person feels fine.
words.memory_tip: 'check' = તપાસવું + 'up' → ઉપરથી નીચે તપાસ → આરોગ્ય તપાસ.
examples: I go for a check-up every year.
The doctor recommended a full health check-up.
A regular check-up can catch problems early.
Her routine check-up showed everything was normal.

words.english_meaning: A doctor who is highly trained in one particular area of medicine.
words.gujarati_meaning: દવાના કોઈ એક ખાસ ક્ષેત્રમાં વિશેષ તાલીમ પામેલ ડૉક્ટર.
words.usage_note: Contrast with a 'general practitioner' (GP), who treats common problems.
examples: He was referred to a heart specialist.
A skin specialist treated her allergy.
You may need to see a specialist for this.
The specialist explained the treatment options clearly.

words.english_meaning: To officially allow a patient to leave the hospital after treatment.
words.gujarati_meaning: સારવાર પછી દર્દીને હૉસ્પિટલમાંથી જવાની સત્તાવાર પરવાનગી આપવી.
words.usage_note: Opposite of 'admit'; a 'discharge summary' lists post-care instructions.
examples: The patient was discharged after three days.
She received her discharge papers in the morning.
Doctors will discharge him once the fever is gone.
He felt relieved to be discharged from the hospital.

words.english_meaning: A type of medicine that kills or stops the growth of bacteria.
words.gujarati_meaning: બેક્ટેરિયાને મારતી કે વધતા અટકાવતી દવા.
words.usage_note: Antibiotics treat bacterial infections, not viral ones like the common cold.
examples: The doctor prescribed antibiotics for the infection.
Always finish the full course of antibiotics.
Antibiotics do not work against the flu.
Overusing antibiotics can make them less effective.

words.english_meaning: The amount and frequency of medicine that should be taken.
words.gujarati_meaning: દવા કેટલી માત્રામાં અને કેટલી વાર લેવી તેનું પ્રમાણ.
words.usage_note: Always follow the recommended dosage printed on the label.
examples: Read the label for the correct dosage.
Never exceed the recommended dosage.
The dosage depends on the patient's weight.
He took a higher dosage by mistake.

words.english_meaning: A substance given to protect the body against a particular disease.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ ચોક્કસ રોગ સામે શરીરને રક્ષણ આપવા આપવામાં આવતો પદાર્થ.
words.usage_note: A vaccine trains the immune system before the real infection occurs.
examples: Children receive the vaccine at a young age.
The new vaccine was tested for two years.
Get a flu vaccine before the winter season.
Scientists worked hard to develop the vaccine.

words.english_meaning: Treatment intended to relieve or heal a physical or mental problem.
words.gujarati_meaning: શારીરિક કે માનસિક સમસ્યા મટાડવા માટેની સારવાર.
words.usage_note: Often used for non-surgical treatments such as physical or speech therapy.
examples: He needed physical therapy after the accident.
Speech therapy helped the child speak clearly.
She is undergoing therapy for her injured knee.
Group therapy can be very supportive.

words.english_meaning: A medical operation in which the body is cut open to treat or repair it.
words.gujarati_meaning: શરીરને કાપીને સારવાર કે સમારકામ કરવાની તબીબી શસ્ત્રક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: 'Surgery' can also mean the operation itself or a doctor's office in British English.
examples: She underwent surgery on her knee.
Heart surgery requires a long recovery.
The surgery was successful and quick.
He needs minor surgery to remove the lump.

words.english_meaning: The process of returning to good health after illness or injury.
words.gujarati_meaning: બીમારી કે ઈજા પછી ફરી સ્વસ્થ થવાની પ્રક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: Wish someone 'a speedy recovery' when they are unwell.
words.memory_tip: 're' = ફરી + 'cover' → ફરી પાછું મેળવવું → સાજા થવું.
examples: The doctors expect a full recovery.
Rest is important during the recovery period.
We all wished him a speedy recovery.
Her recovery from the surgery was remarkable.

words.english_meaning: A medicine taken to reduce or stop pain.
words.gujarati_meaning: દુખાવો ઘટાડવા કે બંધ કરવા માટે લેવાતી દવા.
words.usage_note: Stronger painkillers usually require a prescription.
examples: She took a painkiller for her headache.
These painkillers are available without a prescription.
Strong painkillers can cause drowsiness.
Don't rely on painkillers for everything.

words.english_meaning: The body's natural defence that fights germs and disease.
words.gujarati_meaning: જંતુઓ અને રોગ સામે લડતી શરીરની કુદરતી રક્ષણ-પ્રણાલી.
words.usage_note: A healthy diet and sleep help keep the immune system strong.
words.memory_tip: 'immune' = મુક્ત → રોગથી મુક્ત રાખે → રોગપ્રતિકારક તંત્ર.
examples: A strong immune system fights off infections.
Stress can weaken your immune system.
Vitamins help boost the immune system.
His immune system was too weak after the illness.

words.english_meaning: The movement of blood through the body, pumped by the heart.
words.gujarati_meaning: હૃદય દ્વારા શરીરમાં લોહીનું વહન અને ફરવું.
words.usage_note: Often paired with 'blood', as in 'blood circulation'.
examples: Exercise improves blood circulation.
Poor circulation can cause cold hands and feet.
Good circulation keeps the organs healthy.
The massage helped the circulation in his legs.

words.english_meaning: The process by which the body breaks down food to use as energy.
words.gujarati_meaning: શરીર ખોરાકને તોડીને ઊર્જા તરીકે વાપરવાની પ્રક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: Fibre and water help support good digestion.
examples: A light walk aids digestion after meals.
Spicy food can upset your digestion.
Good digestion depends on a balanced diet.
Poor digestion left him feeling bloated.

words.english_meaning: Relating to breathing or the organs used for breathing.
words.gujarati_meaning: શ્વાસ લેવા સાથે અથવા શ્વસન અંગો સાથે સંબંધિત.
words.usage_note: Commonly used in phrases like 'respiratory infection' or 'respiratory system'.
examples: The patient had a respiratory infection.
Smoking damages the respiratory system.
Asthma is a common respiratory problem.
Pollution affects respiratory health badly.

words.english_meaning: A place where two bones meet and allow the body to move.
words.gujarati_meaning: જ્યાં બે હાડકાં મળે છે અને હલનચલન શક્ય બને છે તે સ્થાન (સાંધો).
words.usage_note: Common in 'joint pain' and conditions like arthritis.
examples: Arthritis causes painful joints.
He injured the joint in his shoulder.
Cold weather makes her joints stiff.
Knee joints carry a lot of body weight.

words.english_meaning: The chemical processes in the body that convert food into energy.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખોરાકને ઊર્જામાં ફેરવતી શરીરની રાસાયણિક પ્રક્રિયાઓ.
words.usage_note: A faster metabolism burns calories more quickly.
examples: Exercise can speed up your metabolism.
A slow metabolism makes weight loss harder.
Metabolism changes as people grow older.
Her fast metabolism keeps her slim.

words.english_meaning: The regular beating of the heart felt in the arteries.
words.gujarati_meaning: ધમનીઓમાં અનુભવાતી હૃદયના નિયમિત ધબકારની ગતિ (નાડી).
words.usage_note: Doctors check the pulse to measure heart rate.
examples: The nurse checked his pulse quickly.
Her pulse was rapid after running.
A weak pulse can be a warning sign.
You can feel your pulse at the wrist.

words.english_meaning: A feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something uncertain.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ અનિશ્ચિત બાબત અંગે ચિંતા, ગભરાટ કે બેચેનીની લાગણી.
words.usage_note: Mild anxiety is normal, but severe anxiety may need treatment.
examples: She felt anxiety before the exam.
Deep breathing can ease anxiety.
He suffers from anxiety in crowded places.
Therapy helped reduce her anxiety.

words.english_meaning: A serious medical condition causing lasting sadness and loss of interest.
words.gujarati_meaning: લાંબા સમય સુધી ઉદાસી અને રસનો અભાવ કરાવતી ગંભીર તબીબી સ્થિતિ.
words.usage_note: Clinical depression is more than ordinary sadness and needs support.
examples: He sought help for his depression.
Depression can affect anyone at any age.
Talking to friends can ease mild depression.
Treatment helped her overcome depression.

words.english_meaning: The practice of being fully aware and present in the current moment.
words.gujarati_meaning: વર્તમાન ક્ષણમાં પૂરેપૂરા જાગૃત અને હાજર રહેવાની પ્રથા.
words.usage_note: Often practised through meditation to reduce stress.
examples: Mindfulness helps people manage stress.
She practises mindfulness every morning.
Mindfulness meditation calms the mind.
Eating slowly is a form of mindfulness.

words.english_meaning: The state of being healthy, comfortable, and happy.
words.gujarati_meaning: સ્વસ્થ, સંતુષ્ટ અને સુખી હોવાની સ્થિતિ.
words.usage_note: Covers both physical and emotional health.
examples: Exercise improves both body and wellbeing.
The company cares about employee wellbeing.
A balanced life supports mental wellbeing.
Nature walks boost a sense of wellbeing.

words.english_meaning: Mental or emotional strain caused by pressure or difficult situations.
words.gujarati_meaning: દબાણ કે મુશ્કેલ પરિસ્થિતિથી થતો માનસિક કે ભાવનાત્મક તણાવ.
words.usage_note: Some stress is normal, but long-term stress harms health.
examples: Too much stress can affect your sleep.
She learned to manage her stress with yoga.
He is under a lot of stress at work.
Regular breaks help lower stress levels.

words.english_meaning: The ability to recover quickly from difficulties or hardship.
words.gujarati_meaning: મુશ્કેલીઓ કે કષ્ટમાંથી ઝડપથી બેઠા થવાની ક્ષમતા.
words.usage_note: Resilience can be strengthened with support and good habits.
examples: Her resilience helped her recover from loss.
Building resilience takes time and support.
Children develop resilience through challenges.
Mental resilience is key during tough times.

words.english_meaning: A serious, unexpected situation that needs immediate action.
words.gujarati_meaning: તાત્કાલિક પગલાં માગતી ગંભીર અને અણધારી પરિસ્થિતિ.
words.usage_note: Call the emergency number for life-threatening situations.
words.memory_tip: 'emerge' = અચાનક ઊભું થવું → અચાનક સ્થિતિ → કટોકટી.
examples: Call an ambulance in a medical emergency.
The emergency room was very busy that night.
Stay calm during an emergency.
Keep emergency numbers near the phone.

words.english_meaning: A vehicle equipped to carry sick or injured people to hospital.
words.gujarati_meaning: બીમાર કે ઈજાગ્રસ્ત લોકોને હૉસ્પિટલ લઈ જવા સજ્જ વાહન.
words.usage_note: In many countries you call a specific number to request one.
examples: Someone called an ambulance right away.
The ambulance reached the scene in minutes.
An ambulance rushed him to the hospital.
The ambulance service is available all night.

words.english_meaning: A strip of material used to cover and protect a wound.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઘા ઢાંકવા અને રક્ષણ આપવા વપરાતી પટ્ટી.
words.usage_note: Can also be used as a verb: 'to bandage a wound'.
examples: She applied a bandage to the cut.
Change the bandage twice a day.
He wrapped a bandage around his ankle.
Keep the bandage clean and dry.

words.english_meaning: A break or crack in a bone.
words.gujarati_meaning: હાડકામાં તૂટ કે તિરાડ.
words.usage_note: Can be a noun or a verb: 'He fractured his arm.'
examples: The X-ray showed a fracture in his leg.
She suffered a fracture during the fall.
A hairline fracture is hard to detect.
He fractured his wrist while playing.

words.english_meaning: To revive someone who has stopped breathing or whose heart has stopped.
words.gujarati_meaning: શ્વાસ કે હૃદય બંધ થઈ ગયેલ વ્યક્તિને ફરી જીવંત કરવો.
words.usage_note: Often done through CPR in emergencies.
words.memory_tip: 're' = ફરી + 'suscitate' (ઊભું કરવું) → ફરી જીવંત કરવો → પુનર્જીવિત કરવો.
examples: The doctors managed to resuscitate the patient.
Paramedics tried to resuscitate him at the scene.
Knowing how to resuscitate can save a life.
She was resuscitated after the accident.

words.english_meaning: A substance that prevents infection by killing germs on the skin.
words.gujarati_meaning: ત્વચા પરના જંતુઓ મારીને ચેપ અટકાવતો પદાર્થ.
words.usage_note: Used on wounds to prevent infection before bandaging.
examples: Clean the wound with an antiseptic.
Apply antiseptic cream before the bandage.
Antiseptic wipes are handy for small cuts.
The antiseptic stung a little on the cut.

mini_dialogues.title: At the Doctor's Appointment
mini_dialogues.situation: A patient describes symptoms to a doctor during a routine consultation.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good morning, doctor. I've had a fever and a lot of fatigue for three days.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Let me note your symptoms. Any nausea or cough along with the fever?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yes, mild nausea, and my throat feels sore.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Based on this, my diagnosis is a viral infection. I'll write a prescription and suggest plenty of rest.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Thank you. Should I come back for a check-up?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, book an appointment if the symptoms don't improve in five days.

mini_dialogues.title: A Referral to a Specialist
mini_dialogues.situation: A doctor refers a patient with chronic pain to a specialist.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: My knee joint has been hurting for months now.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: This sounds like a chronic problem. I'm giving you a referral to a specialist.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Will I need surgery for it?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Maybe not. The specialist might suggest physical therapy first.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That's a relief. I'd prefer to avoid an operation.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Take this referral letter and book a consultation with them.

mini_dialogues.title: At the Pharmacy
mini_dialogues.situation: A customer fills a prescription and asks about medicines.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Hello, I'd like to fill this prescription for antibiotics.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Of course. The dosage is one tablet twice a day after meals.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Do you also have a painkiller I can take with it?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, this one is safe. Don't exceed the dosage on the label.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Great. I also need some antiseptic for a small cut.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Here's an antiseptic cream and a few bandages.

mini_dialogues.title: A Medical Emergency
mini_dialogues.situation: Two people respond to an accident and give first aid.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: He's fallen badly! I think it might be a fracture.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Stay calm. Call an ambulance right now, this is an emergency.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: His pulse is weak. Should we try to resuscitate him?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: He's still breathing. Let's just keep him still and apply a bandage to the cut.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The ambulance is on its way.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Good. The paramedics will check his pulse and take over.

mini_dialogues.title: Talking About Mental Wellbeing
mini_dialogues.situation: Two friends discuss managing stress and looking after mental health.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I've been feeling a lot of anxiety and stress lately.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Have you tried mindfulness or meditation?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: A little. It does seem to help my overall wellbeing.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That's great. Building resilience takes time, so be patient with yourself.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: True. If it gets worse, I might talk to someone about possible depression.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That's a wise idea. Looking after your mind matters as much as your body.

questions.question: What does 'Symptom' mean in Gujarati?
કયો શબ્દ 'લક્ષણોના આધારે રોગ ઓળખવાની પ્રક્રિયા' માટે વપરાય છે?
Which word is the OPPOSITE of 'Chronic'?
Which word is a synonym of 'Fatigue'?
The flu is highly ______ during the first few days, so stay home.
Which word means 'a written instruction from a doctor for medicines'?
What does 'Discharge' (verb) mean in Gujarati?
Which word is the OPPOSITE of 'Appointment'?
Read the label and never exceed the recommended ______ of the medicine.
Which term means 'the body's natural defence that fights germs and disease'?
કયો શબ્દ 'જ્યાં બે હાડકાં મળે છે તે સ્થાન (સાંધો)' માટે વપરાય છે?
Which word is a synonym of 'Emergency'?
The paramedics tried to ______ the patient whose heart had stopped.
What does 'Anxiety' mean in Gujarati?
Which word means 'a substance that kills germs on the skin to prevent infection'?

words.english_meaning: The subjects and content that are taught in a school or course.
words.gujarati_meaning: શાળા અથવા અભ્યાસક્રમમાં ભણાવવામાં આવતા વિષયો અને સામગ્રીનો સમૂહ.
words.usage_note: Refers to the overall plan of study, broader than a single syllabus.
words.memory_tip: 'curriculum' = curri (Latin 'run a course') → ભણવાનો કોર્સ → curriculum.
examples: The new curriculum includes more practical lessons.
Science is a key part of the school curriculum.
Teachers helped design the updated curriculum.
The curriculum was revised to add coding classes.

words.english_meaning: A piece of work given to students to complete, usually for marks.
words.gujarati_meaning: વિદ્યાર્થીઓને પૂર્ણ કરવા માટે આપવામાં આવતું કાર્ય, સામાન્ય રીતે ગુણ માટે.
words.usage_note: Common in both school and university contexts for graded work.
words.memory_tip: 'assign' = કોઈને કામ સોંપવું → assignment = સોંપેલું કાર્ય.
examples: Please submit your assignment by Friday.
The assignment was harder than expected.
She got full marks on her history assignment.
We have three assignments due next week.

words.english_meaning: A formal talk given to teach students about a particular subject.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ ચોક્કસ વિષય શીખવવા માટે વિદ્યાર્થીઓને આપવામાં આવતું ઔપચારિક પ્રવચન.
words.usage_note: Usually refers to a one-way teaching session, common at universities.
examples: The professor gave a fascinating lecture on physics.
I missed the morning lecture today.
Students took notes during the lecture.
Her lecture lasted almost two hours.

words.english_meaning: To take part actively in an activity or discussion.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ પ્રવૃત્તિ અથવા ચર્ચામાં સક્રિય રીતે ભાગ લેવો.
words.usage_note: Often praised by teachers as a sign of active learning.
examples: Students who participate learn faster.
She always participates in group discussions.
Please participate in tomorrow's debate.
He rarely participates in class activities.

words.english_meaning: To make something clearer or easier to understand.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ બાબતને વધુ સ્પષ્ટ અથવા સમજવામાં સરળ બનાવવી.
words.usage_note: Useful when asking a teacher to explain something again.
examples: Could you clarify that point, please?
The teacher clarified the difficult concept.
I need to clarify a few doubts before the exam.
Let me clarify what I meant earlier.

words.english_meaning: To show clearly how something works or is done.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ વસ્તુ કેવી રીતે કામ કરે છે અથવા થાય છે તે સ્પષ્ટ રીતે બતાવવું.
words.usage_note: Often used when a teacher shows a practical example or experiment.
examples: The teacher demonstrated the experiment step by step.
Can you demonstrate how to solve this problem?
She demonstrated excellent leadership skills.
He demonstrated the software to the class.

words.english_meaning: To fully understand the meaning of something.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ બાબતનો અર્થ સંપૂર્ણ રીતે સમજવો.
words.usage_note: More formal than 'understand' and common in academic settings.
examples: Students must comprehend the passage before answering.
It took me a while to comprehend the theory.
He could not comprehend the complex instructions.
Reading daily improves how well you comprehend texts.

words.english_meaning: A long piece of writing on a subject, or the main idea of an argument.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ વિષય પરનું લાંબું લખાણ, અથવા દલીલનો મુખ્ય વિચાર.
words.usage_note: Can mean a master's or PhD document or the central claim of an essay.
examples: Her thesis explored renewable energy sources.
Every essay needs a clear thesis statement.
He spent two years writing his doctoral thesis.
The thesis of the article is well supported.

words.english_meaning: A reference to a source of information used in academic writing.
words.gujarati_meaning: શૈક્ષણિક લખાણમાં વપરાયેલા માહિતી સ્રોતનો સંદર્ભ.
words.usage_note: Citations are essential to avoid plagiarism in academic work.
examples: Each quote needs a proper citation.
He forgot to add citations to his essay.
The citation style was APA format.
Accurate citations strengthen your argument.

words.english_meaning: To express someone's ideas in your own words without copying.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈના વિચારોને નકલ કર્યા વગર પોતાના શબ્દોમાં વ્યક્ત કરવા.
words.usage_note: Paraphrasing still requires a citation of the original source.
words.memory_tip: 'para' (બાજુમાં) + phrase → શબ્દોને બીજી રીતે મૂકવા → paraphrase.
examples: Try to paraphrase instead of copying the text.
She paraphrased the author's main argument.
Learning to paraphrase reduces plagiarism.
Paraphrase this paragraph in two sentences.

words.english_meaning: Logical, clear, and well organized so it is easy to follow.
words.gujarati_meaning: તાર્કિક, સ્પષ્ટ અને સારી રીતે ગોઠવાયેલું, જેથી સમજવામાં સરળ હોય.
words.usage_note: A coherent essay flows logically from one point to the next.
examples: Her essay presented a coherent argument.
The report was clear and coherent.
Make sure your paragraphs are coherent.
A coherent structure helps the reader follow you.

words.english_meaning: Expressing a lot in few words; short and clear.
words.gujarati_meaning: થોડા શબ્દોમાં ઘણું વ્યક્ત કરનારું; ટૂંકું અને સ્પષ્ટ.
words.usage_note: Examiners value concise writing that avoids unnecessary words.
examples: Keep your answer concise and to the point.
She wrote a concise summary of the chapter.
A concise essay is easier to mark.
Try to be concise in your introduction.

words.english_meaning: A set of reasons given to support an idea or opinion.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ વિચાર અથવા અભિપ્રાયને સમર્થન આપવા માટે રજૂ કરાયેલા કારણોનો સમૂહ.
words.usage_note: In academic writing, an argument means reasoned support, not a quarrel.
examples: He made a convincing argument for change.
Your essay needs a stronger central argument.
She supported her argument with evidence.
The argument was well structured and clear.

words.english_meaning: The act of copying someone else's work and presenting it as your own.
words.gujarati_meaning: બીજાનું કાર્ય નકલ કરીને તેને પોતાનું ગણાવવાનું કૃત્ય.
words.usage_note: Plagiarism is a serious academic offence that can fail your work.
examples: Plagiarism can lead to expulsion from university.
Always cite sources to avoid plagiarism.
The software detected plagiarism in the essay.
He was warned about plagiarism in his report.

words.english_meaning: To study again something you have already learned, especially before an exam.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખાસ કરીને પરીક્ષા પહેલાં, પહેલેથી શીખેલી બાબતનો ફરી અભ્યાસ કરવો.
words.usage_note: In British English, 'revise' often means to study for exams.
examples: I need to revise for my chemistry test.
She revised all her notes last night.
Revise regularly instead of cramming.
He revised the whole chapter twice.

words.english_meaning: To focus all your attention on one thing.
words.gujarati_meaning: પોતાનું સંપૂર્ણ ધ્યાન એક જ બાબત પર કેન્દ્રિત કરવું.
words.usage_note: Often paired with 'on' when naming what you focus on.
examples: It is hard to concentrate with noise around.
She concentrated on the difficult math problem.
Turn off your phone to concentrate better.
He cannot concentrate when he is tired.

words.english_meaning: To learn something so that you can remember it exactly.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ બાબતને એવી રીતે શીખવી કે જેથી તે બરાબર યાદ રહે.
words.usage_note: Useful for vocabulary and formulas, but understanding is often better.
examples: Students often memorize key dates for history.
She memorized fifty new words this week.
Don't just memorize; try to understand.
He memorized the entire speech.

words.english_meaning: To keep delaying something that you should do.
words.gujarati_meaning: જે કામ કરવું જોઈએ તેને વારંવાર ટાળતા રહેવું.
words.usage_note: A common study problem; the noun form is 'procrastination'.
examples: I always procrastinate before big exams.
Stop procrastinating and start revising.
He procrastinated until the night before the deadline.
Procrastinating only increases your stress.

words.english_meaning: Working hard carefully and with steady effort.
words.gujarati_meaning: સતત પ્રયત્ન સાથે કાળજીપૂર્વક અને મહેનતથી કામ કરનારું.
words.usage_note: Often used to praise students who study consistently.
examples: She is a diligent student who never misses class.
His diligent efforts paid off in the exam.
Diligent revision improves your marks.
The teacher praised her diligent work.

words.english_meaning: Something that takes your attention away from what you are doing.
words.gujarati_meaning: જે કોઈ વસ્તુ તમે કરી રહ્યા છો તેમાંથી તમારું ધ્યાન ભટકાવે છે.
words.usage_note: Removing distractions is a common study tip.
examples: Mobile phones are a big distraction while studying.
She removed all distractions before the exam.
Noise can be a serious distraction.
Avoid distractions to study effectively.

words.english_meaning: The quality of continuing to try despite difficulties.
words.gujarati_meaning: મુશ્કેલીઓ છતાં પ્રયત્ન ચાલુ રાખવાનો ગુણ.
words.usage_note: Highly valued in education as a key to long-term success.
examples: Her perseverance helped her pass the tough exam.
Success requires patience and perseverance.
He showed great perseverance during his studies.
Perseverance is more important than talent.

words.english_meaning: A formal test of knowledge or ability in a subject.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ વિષયમાં જ્ઞાન અથવા ક્ષમતાની ઔપચારિક કસોટી.
words.usage_note: 'Examination' is more formal; 'exam' is used in everyday speech.
examples: The final examination is next month.
She passed her examination with distinction.
He was nervous before the examination.
The examination covered the whole syllabus.

words.english_meaning: A mark or score showing the quality of a student's work.
words.gujarati_meaning: વિદ્યાર્થીના કાર્યની ગુણવત્તા દર્શાવતો ગુણ અથવા સ્કોર.
words.usage_note: Can also be used as a verb meaning to mark students' work.
examples: She got the highest grade in the class.
His grades improved this semester.
The teacher will grade the papers tonight.
A good grade requires consistent effort.

words.english_meaning: To judge or evaluate the quality or level of something.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ વસ્તુની ગુણવત્તા અથવા સ્તરનું મૂલ્યાંકન કરવું.
words.usage_note: Common in education for evaluating students' progress.
examples: Teachers assess students through tests and projects.
We need to assess his progress this term.
The exam assesses both theory and practice.
It is hard to assess such complex skills.

words.english_meaning: A very high grade or mark awarded for excellent work.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઉત્તમ કાર્ય માટે મળતો ખૂબ ઊંચો ગ્રેડ અથવા ગુણ.
words.usage_note: Often awarded for top-level performance in exams.
examples: She graduated with distinction.
Earning a distinction takes hard work.
He passed every subject with distinction.
The award recognised his academic distinction.

words.english_meaning: To carefully consider something to form an opinion about its value.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ બાબતના મૂલ્ય વિશે અભિપ્રાય બાંધવા માટે તેને કાળજીપૂર્વક વિચારવી.
words.usage_note: In essays, 'evaluate' asks you to weigh strengths and weaknesses.
examples: The teacher will evaluate each presentation.
Evaluate both sides before deciding.
We must evaluate the test results carefully.
Critically evaluate the author's claims.

words.english_meaning: Acting dishonestly to gain an unfair advantage in a test.
words.gujarati_meaning: પરીક્ષામાં અન્યાયી ફાયદો મેળવવા માટે અપ્રામાણિક રીતે વર્તવું.
words.usage_note: Cheating in exams usually leads to serious penalties.
examples: He was caught cheating in the exam.
Cheating can result in disqualification.
The school has strict rules against cheating.
She would never consider cheating on a test.

words.english_meaning: An official record of a student's grades and courses.
words.gujarati_meaning: વિદ્યાર્થીના ગ્રેડ અને અભ્યાસક્રમોનો સત્તાવાર રેકોર્ડ.
words.usage_note: Often required when applying to universities or for jobs.
examples: She submitted her transcript with the application.
The university requested an official transcript.
His transcript showed excellent grades.
You can download your transcript online.

words.english_meaning: Money given to a student to help pay for their education.
words.gujarati_meaning: વિદ્યાર્થીને તેના શિક્ષણ માટે મદદરૂપ થવા આપવામાં આવતી રકમ.
words.usage_note: Usually awarded for academic merit or financial need.
examples: She won a scholarship to study abroad.
He applied for a full scholarship.
The scholarship covers all tuition fees.
Top students often receive scholarships.

words.english_meaning: To officially join a course, school, or university.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ અભ્યાસક્રમ, શાળા અથવા યુનિવર્સિટીમાં સત્તાવાર રીતે દાખલ થવું.
words.usage_note: Often spelled 'enrol' in British English.
examples: She enrolled in an online English course.
Thousands of students enroll each year.
He enrolled at the local university.
You can enroll for the new term now.

words.english_meaning: The teaching staff of a university or a department within it.
words.gujarati_meaning: યુનિવર્સિટીનો શિક્ષક સ્ટાફ અથવા તેની અંદરનો કોઈ વિભાગ.
words.usage_note: Can mean the teaching staff or an academic department.
examples: She joined the science faculty last year.
The faculty held a meeting about exams.
He studies in the faculty of law.
Several faculty members published new research.

words.english_meaning: One of the two main periods into which a school year is divided.
words.gujarati_meaning: શૈક્ષણિક વર્ષ જે બે મુખ્ય ભાગમાં વહેંચાય છે તેમાંનો એક ભાગ.
words.usage_note: Common in universities; schools may use 'term' instead.
examples: She did very well in her first semester.
Exams are held at the end of each semester.
He is taking five subjects this semester.
The new semester starts in July.

words.english_meaning: The successful completion of a degree or course of study.
words.gujarati_meaning: ડિગ્રી અથવા અભ્યાસક્રમની સફળતાપૂર્વક પૂર્ણાહુતિ.
words.usage_note: Also refers to the ceremony marking the end of studies.
examples: Her family attended the graduation ceremony.
After graduation, he found a good job.
Graduation day was full of joy.
She plans to travel after graduation.

words.english_meaning: The money paid for teaching, or teaching given to a small group.
words.gujarati_meaning: શિક્ષણ માટે ચૂકવાતી રકમ, અથવા નાના જૂથને અપાતું શિક્ષણ.
words.usage_note: In American English it usually means fees; in British use it can mean teaching.
examples: University tuition fees keep rising.
She takes private tuition in maths.
His parents paid his tuition.
The scholarship covers his tuition.

words.english_meaning: Information and skills gained through learning or experience.
words.gujarati_meaning: શીખવા અથવા અનુભવ દ્વારા મેળવેલી માહિતી અને કુશળતા.
words.usage_note: An uncountable noun; we say 'much knowledge', not 'knowledges'.
examples: Reading widens your knowledge.
She has deep knowledge of biology.
Knowledge is power, as the saying goes.
He shared his knowledge with the class.

words.english_meaning: A clear, deep understanding of a complex situation or idea.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ જટિલ પરિસ્થિતિ અથવા વિચારની સ્પષ્ટ અને ઊંડી સમજ.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe a sudden, useful realisation.
examples: The book offers great insight into history.
Her comment gave us new insight.
He has real insight into human behaviour.
The data provided valuable insights.

words.english_meaning: To examine something in detail to understand or explain it.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ વસ્તુને સમજવા અથવા સમજાવવા માટે વિગતવાર તપાસવી.
words.usage_note: Spelled 'analyse' in British English; the noun is 'analysis'.
words.memory_tip: 'ana' + lyze (છૂટું પાડવું) → ભાગ પાડીને તપાસવું → analyze.
examples: Scientists analyze the data carefully.
Let's analyze the poem line by line.
She analyzed the results of the survey.
You must analyze both causes and effects.

words.english_meaning: An abstract idea or general notion about something.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ બાબત વિશેનો અમૂર્ત વિચાર અથવા સામાન્ય ખ્યાલ.
words.usage_note: Used widely in academic subjects to mean a basic idea.
examples: Gravity is a difficult concept for young children.
She explained the concept clearly.
This chapter introduces a key concept.
He struggled to grasp the new concept.

words.english_meaning: Relating to the ability to think, reason, and understand ideas.
words.gujarati_meaning: વિચારવાની, તર્ક કરવાની અને વિચારોને સમજવાની ક્ષમતા સાથે સંબંધિત.
words.usage_note: Can also be a noun meaning a person who values thinking and ideas.
examples: Chess is an intellectual game.
She has great intellectual curiosity.
The course offers a real intellectual challenge.
He enjoys intellectual discussions.

words.english_meaning: Very great, deep, or showing serious understanding.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખૂબ ઊંડું, ગહન અથવા ગંભીર સમજ દર્શાવનારું.
words.usage_note: Used to describe deep ideas, effects, or understanding.
examples: The lecture had a profound effect on me.
She has a profound understanding of philosophy.
His words carried a profound meaning.
The book raises profound questions about life.

mini_dialogues.title: Asking a Teacher to Clarify
mini_dialogues.situation: A student approaches the teacher after a lecture to clear some doubts.

turns.speaker: Student
turns.text: Excuse me, could you clarify the concept you explained in today's lecture?

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Of course. Which part did you find hard to comprehend?

turns.speaker: Student
turns.text: The second example. I couldn't fully understand how you demonstrated it.

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: No problem. Let me demonstrate it again, step by step, so the concept becomes clear.

turns.speaker: Student
turns.text: Thank you. I'll revise it tonight and try to participate more next time.

mini_dialogues.title: Preparing for Exams
mini_dialogues.situation: Two friends talk about how they are studying for their examinations.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: How are you revising for the final examination next week?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I try to concentrate for two hours and remove every distraction.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good idea. I always procrastinate, so my grades suffer.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: You need more diligence. A bit of perseverance and you'll get a distinction.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: You're right. From today I'll be more diligent and stop wasting time.

mini_dialogues.title: Working on an Assignment
mini_dialogues.situation: A student asks a classmate for help with an academic writing assignment.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'm struggling with this assignment. My argument doesn't feel coherent.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Did you add a clear thesis statement at the start?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Not really. And I'm worried about plagiarism if I use too many quotes.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Then paraphrase the ideas in your own words and add a citation for each source.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That makes sense. I'll keep it concise and make the argument coherent.

mini_dialogues.title: Applying to University
mini_dialogues.situation: A student discusses university admission with a counsellor.

turns.speaker: Counsellor
turns.text: Have you decided which course you want to enroll in?

turns.speaker: Student
turns.text: Yes, but the tuition fees are quite high for me.

turns.speaker: Counsellor
turns.text: Have you applied for a scholarship? Your transcript shows excellent grades.

turns.speaker: Student
turns.text: Not yet. Would the faculty consider my results from last semester?

turns.speaker: Counsellor
turns.text: Definitely. With a scholarship, tuition will be much easier to manage.

mini_dialogues.title: Discussing a Difficult Topic
mini_dialogues.situation: A student and a mentor talk about understanding a complex subject.

turns.speaker: Student
turns.text: This subject demands real intellectual effort. I can't grasp the main concept.

turns.speaker: Mentor
turns.text: Try to analyze it slowly. Break the idea into smaller parts.

turns.speaker: Student
turns.text: That gave me a new insight. It suddenly makes more sense.

turns.speaker: Mentor
turns.text: Excellent. With patience, your knowledge will become much more profound.

turns.speaker: Student
turns.text: Thank you. I now understand the concept far better.

questions.question: 'Curriculum' નો ગુજરાતી અર્થ શું છે?
'જે કામ કરવું જોઈએ તેને વારંવાર ટાળતા રહેવું' — આ ગુજરાતી અર્થ ક્યા અંગ્રેજી શબ્દ માટે છે?
'Comprehend' નો સૌથી નજીકનો synonym કયો છે?
'Coherent' નો વિરુદ્ધાર્થી (antonym) કયો છે?
Every quote in your essay needs a proper ______ to show its source.
Which word means 'copying someone else's work and presenting it as your own'?
'Insight' નો ગુજરાતી અર્થ શું છે?
It is hard to ______ on your studies when your phone keeps buzzing.
'વિદ્યાર્થીને શિક્ષણ માટે મદદરૂપ થવા આપવામાં આવતી રકમ' — આ ક્યા અંગ્રેજી શબ્દ માટે છે?
'Diligent' નો સૌથી નજીકનો synonym કયો છે?
Which word means 'an official record of a student's grades and courses'?
'Profound' નો વિરુદ્ધાર્થી (antonym) કયો છે?
'Perseverance' નો ગુજરાતી અર્થ શું છે?
Instead of copying, try to ______ the author's ideas in your own words.
'Analyze' નો સૌથી નજીકનો synonym કયો છે?

words.english_meaning: A planned route or detailed schedule of a journey.
words.gujarati_meaning: મુસાફરીનો વિગતવાર કાર્યક્રમ અથવા આયોજિત માર્ગ.
words.usage_note: Used when describing a fixed, organized plan for a trip including places, dates, and times.
examples: Our itinerary includes three cities in five days.
She emailed me the full itinerary before the trip.
We had to change our itinerary due to bad weather.
A flexible itinerary lets you enjoy unplanned moments.

words.english_meaning: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.
words.gujarati_meaning: જ્યાં કોઈ વ્યક્તિ કે વસ્તુ પહોંચવાનું હોય તે સ્થળ.
words.usage_note: Commonly used to refer to the final place you intend to reach on a journey.
words.memory_tip: 'destination' = destiny → જ્યાં તમારી મંજિલ છે તે સ્થળ.
examples: Goa is a popular tourist destination in India.
What is your final destination?
We chose a quiet destination for our honeymoon.
The destination was worth the long journey.

words.english_meaning: An arrangement to have something kept or held for your use in advance.
words.gujarati_meaning: પહેલેથી કંઈક પોતાના માટે રાખી મૂકવાની વ્યવસ્થા.
words.usage_note: Used for hotels, flights, and restaurants when something is booked ahead of time.
words.memory_tip: 'reserve' = re + serve → પહેલેથી પોતાના માટે રાખી મૂકવું.
examples: I made a reservation for two at the hotel.
Please confirm your reservation a day in advance.
Our dinner reservation is at eight o'clock.
They cancelled the reservation at the last minute.

words.english_meaning: The amount of money that you plan to spend on a trip or activity.
words.gujarati_meaning: મુસાફરી કે પ્રવૃત્તિ માટે ખર્ચ કરવાનું આયોજિત નાણાં.
words.usage_note: Often used as a noun, but also as an adjective meaning cheap, as in 'budget hotel'.
words.memory_tip: 'budget' = બજેટ → ખર્ચની યોજના, કેટલા પૈસા વાપરવા.
examples: We planned the whole trip on a tight budget.
A backpacking holiday suits a small budget.
Try to stick to your travel budget.
This budget hotel is clean and affordable.

words.english_meaning: To begin a journey or start something new and important.
words.gujarati_meaning: મુસાફરી શરૂ કરવી અથવા કોઈ નવી મહત્વની વાત આરંભવી.
words.usage_note: Often followed by 'on' when starting a journey or a new venture.
words.memory_tip: 'embark' = em + bark (વહાણ) → વહાણમાં ચઢીને મુસાફરી શરૂ કરવી.
examples: We embarked on a road trip across the country.
The passengers embarked early in the morning.
She embarked on a new adventure abroad.
They embarked on their voyage at dawn.

words.english_meaning: An official permission stamped in a passport that allows you to enter a country.
words.gujarati_meaning: પાસપોર્ટ પર લાગતી સત્તાવાર પરવાનગી જે દેશમાં પ્રવેશ આપે છે.
words.usage_note: Different types exist, such as tourist visa, student visa, and work visa.
words.memory_tip: 'visa' = વિઝા → દેશમાં પ્રવેશ માટેની સત્તાવાર પરવાનગી.
examples: I applied for a tourist visa last week.
Your visa is valid for ninety days.
The visa application was rejected.
Make sure your visa is approved before booking flights.

words.english_meaning: A short trip taken for pleasure, usually returning the same day.
words.gujarati_meaning: આનંદ માટે કરેલી ટૂંકી સફર, સામાન્ય રીતે તે જ દિવસે પાછા આવવાનું.
words.usage_note: Often refers to an optional short trip arranged as part of a larger holiday.
words.memory_tip: 'excursion' = ex + cur (દોડવું) → બહાર નીકળીને ટૂંકી સફર.
examples: We booked a guided excursion to the waterfalls.
The hotel offers a day excursion to the old town.
Our excursion to the islands was unforgettable.
They organized an excursion for the whole group.

words.english_meaning: A document that permits a passenger to board an aircraft.
words.gujarati_meaning: વિમાનમાં ચઢવાની પરવાનગી આપતો દસ્તાવેજ.
words.usage_note: Shows your seat number, gate, and boarding time at the airport.
words.memory_tip: 'boarding pass' = board (ચઢવું) + pass → વિમાનમાં ચઢવાનો પાસ.
examples: Please have your boarding pass ready at the gate.
I downloaded my boarding pass on my phone.
The boarding pass shows seat 14C.
She lost her boarding pass at the security check.

words.english_meaning: A short stay at a place between two parts of a journey, especially when changing flights.
words.gujarati_meaning: મુસાફરીના બે ભાગ વચ્ચે, ખાસ કરીને ફ્લાઇટ બદલતી વખતે, કોઈ સ્થળે ટૂંકો રોકાવ.
words.usage_note: A long layover gives time to rest, while a short one risks missing the connecting flight.
words.memory_tip: 'layover' = lay over → થોડી વાર પડ્યા રહેવું, બે ફ્લાઇટ વચ્ચે રોકાવ.
examples: We had a six-hour layover in Singapore.
A short layover means we must hurry to the next gate.
I explored the city during my long layover.
The layover was tiring but the rest helped.

words.english_meaning: The official place at a border where luggage is checked for taxable or illegal goods.
words.gujarati_meaning: સરહદ પર આવેલું સત્તાવાર સ્થળ જ્યાં સામાનની તપાસ થાય છે.
words.usage_note: You must declare certain goods when you pass through customs at an airport.
words.memory_tip: 'customs' = custom (કર/રિવાજ) → સરહદ પર કર અને તપાસનું સ્થળ.
examples: We had to go through customs after landing.
He declared his purchases at customs.
Clearing customs took almost an hour.
Fill in the customs declaration form on the plane.

words.english_meaning: A building at an airport or station where passengers arrive and depart.
words.gujarati_meaning: વિમાનઘર કે સ્ટેશન પરનું મકાન જ્યાંથી મુસાફરો આવ-જા કરે છે.
words.usage_note: Large airports have separate terminals for domestic and international flights.
examples: Our flight departs from Terminal 2.
The international terminal is very crowded today.
We waited at the terminal for two hours.
Take the shuttle to the departure terminal.

words.english_meaning: To travel regularly between two places, especially to and from work.
words.gujarati_meaning: બે સ્થળો વચ્ચે, ખાસ કરીને કામ માટે, નિયમિત મુસાફરી કરવી.
words.usage_note: Used both as a verb and as a noun, as in 'a long commute'.
words.memory_tip: 'commute' = com + mute (બદલવું) → રોજ સ્થળ બદલીને મુસાફરી કરવી.
examples: I commute by train every morning.
Her daily commute takes over an hour.
Many people commute into the city for work.
We commuted between the two towns for years.

words.english_meaning: The act of leaving a place to begin a journey.
words.gujarati_meaning: મુસાફરી શરૂ કરવા માટે કોઈ સ્થળ છોડવાની ક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: Opposite of 'arrival'; check the departure board for your gate and time.
examples: The departure time is six in the evening.
Check the board for any departure delays.
Passengers should reach the departure gate early.
Our departure was postponed by an hour.

words.english_meaning: The process of passing through a place while travelling to a final destination.
words.gujarati_meaning: અંતિમ સ્થળ તરફ જતી વખતે કોઈ સ્થળમાંથી પસાર થવાની પ્રક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: A 'transit passenger' changes flights without officially entering the country.
words.memory_tip: 'transit' = trans (પાર) + it → એક છેડેથી પાર થઈને જવું.
examples: The goods were damaged in transit.
We waited in the transit lounge for our connection.
Transit passengers do not need a local visa here.
Our luggage was lost while in transit.

words.english_meaning: A place where travellers can stay, such as a hotel or guesthouse.
words.gujarati_meaning: મુસાફરો રહી શકે તેવી જગ્યા, જેમ કે હોટેલ કે ગેસ્ટહાઉસ.
words.usage_note: An uncountable noun in British English; often spelled with double 'c' and double 'm'.
words.memory_tip: 'accommodate' = બે c, બે m → રહેવાની જગ્યા આપવી.
examples: We booked accommodation near the beach.
The accommodation was clean and comfortable.
Budget accommodation is easy to find here.
The price includes flights and accommodation.

words.english_meaning: The process of registering your arrival at a hotel or airport.
words.gujarati_meaning: હોટેલ કે વિમાનઘરે પોતાના આગમનની નોંધણી કરવાની પ્રક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: Hyphenated as a noun ('check-in'), but written as two words when used as a verb ('check in').
words.memory_tip: 'check-in' = check + in → અંદર પ્રવેશતી વખતે નોંધણી.
examples: Check-in starts at two in the afternoon.
We did online check-in before our flight.
The check-in desk is on the ground floor.
Please check in at the reception first.

words.english_meaning: An available room or space that is not currently occupied.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઉપલબ્ધ ખાલી રૂમ કે જગ્યા જે હાલમાં વપરાશમાં નથી.
words.usage_note: A 'No Vacancy' sign means the hotel is fully booked.
examples: The hotel had no vacancy that night.
We were lucky to find a vacancy at the inn.
The sign outside said 'Vacancy'.
Is there any vacancy for tonight?

words.english_meaning: Useful or pleasant features and services provided at a place to stay.
words.gujarati_meaning: રહેવાના સ્થળે પૂરી પાડવામાં આવતી ઉપયોગી અને સુખદ સુવિધાઓ.
words.usage_note: Usually used in the plural to describe a hotel's facilities like a pool or gym.
examples: The resort offers all modern amenities.
Free Wi-Fi is among the hotel amenities.
Even basic amenities were missing in that lodge.
Guests enjoy amenities like a spa and gym.

words.english_meaning: A set of connected rooms in a hotel, usually more luxurious than a single room.
words.gujarati_meaning: હોટેલમાં જોડાયેલા રૂમોનો સમૂહ, સામાન્ય રીતે સામાન્ય રૂમ કરતાં વધુ વૈભવી.
words.usage_note: Pronounced like 'sweet'; do not confuse the spelling with 'suit' (clothing).
examples: They stayed in the honeymoon suite.
The luxury suite has a private balcony.
We upgraded to a suite for our anniversary.
The suite was spacious and elegant.

words.english_meaning: A hotel employee who helps guests with bookings, tours, and special requests.
words.gujarati_meaning: હોટેલનો કર્મચારી જે મહેમાનોને બુકિંગ, પ્રવાસ અને ખાસ વિનંતીઓમાં મદદ કરે છે.
words.usage_note: A concierge can arrange taxis, restaurant tables, and sightseeing tours for guests.
words.memory_tip: 'concierge' = કૉન્સિઅર્ઝ → મહેમાનોની મદદ કરનાર હોટેલ કર્મચારી.
examples: Ask the concierge for a good restaurant.
The concierge booked our theatre tickets.
Our hotel offers a concierge service.
The concierge arranged a taxi to the airport.

words.english_meaning: The act of paying the bill and leaving a hotel room.
words.gujarati_meaning: બિલ ચૂકવીને હોટેલનો રૂમ છોડવાની ક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: Hyphenated as a noun; written as two words as a verb ('check out').
words.memory_tip: 'check-out' = check + out → બહાર નીકળતી વખતે બિલ ચૂકવવું.
examples: Check-out time is eleven in the morning.
We requested a late check-out.
Please check out before noon.
The express check-out saved us time.

words.english_meaning: A famous or easily recognized building or place in an area.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ વિસ્તારની પ્રખ્યાત કે સહેલાઈથી ઓળખાય તેવી ઇમારત કે સ્થળ.
words.usage_note: Often used for well-known structures that help people find their way or identify a city.
words.memory_tip: 'landmark' = land + mark → જમીન પરની ઓળખ આપતી નિશાની.
examples: The Taj Mahal is a famous landmark.
We visited every major landmark in the city.
That tower is a well-known historic landmark.
Use the clock tower as a landmark to find us.

words.english_meaning: Valued traditions, buildings, and culture passed down from earlier generations.
words.gujarati_meaning: પહેલાંની પેઢીઓ તરફથી મળેલી મૂલ્યવાન પરંપરાઓ, ઇમારતો અને સંસ્કૃતિ.
words.usage_note: A 'World Heritage Site' is a place protected for its cultural or natural value.
words.memory_tip: 'heritage' = inherit (વારસામાં મળવું) → પૂર્વજો તરફથી મળેલો વારસો.
examples: The old city has a rich cultural heritage.
This temple is a World Heritage Site.
We must protect our heritage for future generations.
The museum celebrates the region's heritage.

words.english_meaning: The activity of visiting interesting places as a tourist.
words.gujarati_meaning: પ્રવાસી તરીકે રસપ્રદ સ્થળોની મુલાકાત લેવાની પ્રવૃત્તિ.
words.usage_note: Commonly used with 'go', as in 'go sightseeing'.
examples: We spent the whole day sightseeing.
The sightseeing tour covered ten landmarks.
Let's go sightseeing tomorrow morning.
There are many sightseeing spots near the river.

words.english_meaning: Originating naturally in a particular place; native to a region.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ ચોક્કસ સ્થળે મૂળભૂત રીતે ઉદ્ભવેલું; પ્રદેશનું મૂળ વતની.
words.usage_note: Often used respectfully to describe the original inhabitants and culture of a region.
words.memory_tip: 'indigenous' = in + gen (જન્મ) → જે સ્થળે જ જન્મેલું, મૂળ વતની.
examples: We learned about the indigenous culture of the area.
These plants are indigenous to the region.
The indigenous people preserve old traditions.
The museum displays indigenous art.

words.english_meaning: Visually attractive in a charming, old-fashioned way, like a painting.
words.gujarati_meaning: ચિત્ર જેવું મનમોહક અને દૃષ્ટિને આકર્ષક, જૂની ઢબનું સુંદર.
words.usage_note: Used to describe places that look beautiful enough to be in a picture.
examples: We stayed in a picturesque mountain village.
The picturesque view took our breath away.
Their cottage is in a picturesque setting.
The old town is famous for its picturesque streets.

words.english_meaning: An object kept as a reminder of a place visited or an event.
words.gujarati_meaning: મુલાકાત લીધેલા સ્થળ કે પ્રસંગની યાદગીરી તરીકે રાખવામાં આવતી વસ્તુ.
words.usage_note: Tourists often buy souvenirs to remember the places they have visited.
examples: I bought a souvenir from the local market.
This magnet is a souvenir from Paris.
The souvenir shop sells handmade crafts.
She keeps every travel souvenir in a box.

words.english_meaning: A style of cooking typical of a particular country or region.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ ચોક્કસ દેશ કે પ્રદેશની વિશિષ્ટ રસોઈ શૈલી.
words.usage_note: Often used to describe the characteristic food of a culture, as in 'Italian cuisine'.
examples: We loved the local cuisine on our trip.
Italian cuisine is famous around the world.
The hotel serves traditional regional cuisine.
Trying new cuisine is the best part of travelling.

words.english_meaning: A period of time when something is made later or slower than planned.
words.gujarati_meaning: જ્યારે કંઈક આયોજન કરતાં મોડું કે ધીમું થાય તે સમયગાળો.
words.usage_note: Used as both a noun and a verb when something happens later than expected.
words.memory_tip: 'delay' = de + lay → મોડું પાડવું, વિલંબ થવો.
examples: There was a two-hour flight delay.
Bad weather caused a long delay.
Our train was delayed by an accident.
We apologize for the delay in your journey.

words.english_meaning: The act of deciding that a planned event or booking will not happen.
words.gujarati_meaning: આયોજિત પ્રસંગ કે બુકિંગ ન થાય તેવો નિર્ણય લેવાની ક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: Many bookings charge a cancellation fee if you cancel late.
examples: The flight cancellation ruined our plans.
There is a cancellation fee after Monday.
We received a sudden cancellation notice.
Last-minute cancellations are common in winter.

words.english_meaning: Left in a difficult situation without a way to leave a place.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ સ્થળ છોડવાનો માર્ગ ન હોય તેવી મુશ્કેલ સ્થિતિમાં ફસાયેલું.
words.usage_note: Often used when travellers cannot continue because of strikes, weather, or breakdowns.
words.memory_tip: 'stranded' = strand (કિનારે ફસાવું) → ક્યાંય જઈ ન શકાય તેમ ફસાવું.
examples: Hundreds of passengers were stranded by the strike.
We were stranded at the airport overnight.
The storm left many tourists stranded.
Their car broke down, leaving them stranded.

words.english_meaning: Tiredness felt after a long flight across different time zones.
words.gujarati_meaning: જુદા જુદા સમય-ક્ષેત્રો પાર કરતી લાંબી ફ્લાઇટ પછી અનુભવાતો થાક.
words.usage_note: Caused by crossing several time zones, which disturbs the body's natural clock.
words.memory_tip: 'jet lag' = jet + lag (પાછળ રહેવું) → ઝડપી ઉડાન પછી શરીરનો સમય પાછળ રહેવો.
examples: I had terrible jet lag after the long flight.
It took me three days to recover from jet lag.
She felt jet-lagged the whole morning.
Drinking water helps reduce jet lag.

words.english_meaning: Having accepted more bookings than there are seats or rooms available.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઉપલબ્ધ બેઠકો કે રૂમ કરતાં વધુ બુકિંગ સ્વીકારી લેવાયેલું.
words.usage_note: Airlines sometimes overbook flights, expecting that some passengers will not show up.
words.memory_tip: 'overbooked' = over + booked → જરૂર કરતાં વધારે બુક થઈ ગયેલું.
examples: The flight was overbooked, so some passengers waited.
Our hotel was overbooked during the festival.
They offered compensation because the plane was overbooked.
An overbooked train can be very uncomfortable.

words.english_meaning: A sum of money returned to you, especially when a service is not provided.
words.gujarati_meaning: પાછા આપવામાં આવતા નાણાં, ખાસ કરીને જ્યારે સેવા આપવામાં ન આવે.
words.usage_note: Used as both a noun and a verb when money is returned to a customer.
examples: We claimed a full refund for the cancelled tour.
The airline refunded the ticket price.
You can request a refund within seven days.
They gave us a refund for the unused nights.

words.english_meaning: Extremely beautiful, impressive, or exciting.
words.gujarati_meaning: અત્યંત સુંદર, પ્રભાવશાળી અથવા રોમાંચક.
words.usage_note: Used to describe scenery or sights so beautiful they seem to take your breath away.
words.memory_tip: 'breathtaking' = breath + taking → શ્વાસ રોકાઈ જાય તેવું સુંદર.
examples: The view from the peak was breathtaking.
We saw breathtaking scenery along the coast.
The sunset over the sea was breathtaking.
Their performance was simply breathtaking.

words.english_meaning: Worth remembering or easy to remember because it is special.
words.gujarati_meaning: યાદ રાખવા જેવું અથવા ખાસ હોવાથી સહેલાઈથી યાદ રહે તેવું.
words.usage_note: Used for experiences that leave a strong, lasting impression.
words.memory_tip: 'memorable' = memory → લાંબા સમય સુધી યાદ રહે તેવું.
examples: It was the most memorable trip of my life.
We had a memorable evening by the lake.
The festival was a truly memorable experience.
Their hospitality made the visit memorable.

words.english_meaning: Willing to take risks or try new and exciting experiences.
words.gujarati_meaning: જોખમ ઉઠાવવા કે નવા અને રોમાંચક અનુભવો કરવા તૈયાર.
words.usage_note: Describes both people who love thrills and activities full of excitement.
examples: She is an adventurous traveller who loves trekking.
We chose an adventurous holiday in the mountains.
His adventurous spirit took him around the world.
Try something adventurous on your next trip.

words.english_meaning: Making you feel very happy, excited, and full of energy.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખૂબ ખુશ, ઉત્સાહિત અને ઊર્જાથી ભરપૂર અનુભવ કરાવતું.
words.usage_note: Stronger than 'exciting'; describes experiences that give a rush of energy and joy.
words.memory_tip: 'exhilarating' = hilar (આનંદ) → ઊર્જા અને આનંદથી ભરી દેતું.
examples: The white-water rafting was exhilarating.
We had an exhilarating ride down the slopes.
Skydiving is an exhilarating experience.
The exhilarating climb left us breathless and happy.

words.english_meaning: Disappointing because it is much less impressive than expected.
words.gujarati_meaning: અપેક્ષા કરતાં ઘણું ઓછું પ્રભાવશાળી હોવાથી નિરાશાજનક.
words.usage_note: Used when something fails to meet expectations, the opposite of impressive.
examples: The famous beach was rather underwhelming.
We found the museum tour underwhelming.
Sadly, the show was an underwhelming experience.
The view from the hill was underwhelming in the fog.

words.english_meaning: Feeling a sentimental longing for happy times or places from the past.
words.gujarati_meaning: ભૂતકાળના સુખદ સમય કે સ્થળો માટે લાગણીસભર ઝંખના અનુભવતું.
words.usage_note: Describes a bittersweet longing for the past, often triggered by familiar places.
words.memory_tip: 'nostalgic' = nostos (પાછા ઘરે) → જૂના સમય તરફ ઝંખના.
examples: Returning to my village made me feel nostalgic.
The old photos brought back nostalgic memories.
She felt nostalgic about her childhood holidays.
The music made everyone nostalgic for the past.

mini_dialogues.title: Planning the Holiday
mini_dialogues.situation: Two friends sit down to plan an upcoming trip and discuss the schedule and costs.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Have you finalized our itinerary for the trip yet?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Almost. I've added two cities, but I'm worried about the budget.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Don't worry. If we choose a budget hotel, we can still afford one excursion to the islands.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Good idea. I'll make a reservation today and confirm our destination by tonight.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Perfect. Did you also apply for your visa?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, the visa was approved last week, so we're ready to embark on this adventure.

mini_dialogues.title: At the Airport
mini_dialogues.situation: A traveller asks an airline agent about the flight and connection details.

turns.speaker: Traveller
turns.text: Excuse me, where do I collect my boarding pass?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: At the check-in desk in this terminal. Your departure is from Gate 12.

turns.speaker: Traveller
turns.text: Thank you. Do I have a long layover before the next flight?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Yes, about four hours. You'll stay in the transit area, so you won't need to go through customs.

turns.speaker: Traveller
turns.text: That's a relief. I was worried about my luggage in transit.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Your bags are checked through to the final destination, so just relax.

mini_dialogues.title: Checking into the Hotel
mini_dialogues.situation: A guest arrives at a hotel reception and discusses the room and facilities.

turns.speaker: Guest
turns.text: Hello, I have a reservation. Is there a vacancy for an upgrade to a suite?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Let me check. Yes, we have one suite available. Shall I complete your check-in now?

turns.speaker: Guest
turns.text: Please. Does the accommodation include all the usual amenities?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Of course. Free Wi-Fi, a pool, and a gym are all included.

turns.speaker: Guest
turns.text: Wonderful. And what is the check-out time?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Eleven in the morning. Our concierge can arrange a taxi whenever you leave.

mini_dialogues.title: A Day of Sightseeing
mini_dialogues.situation: Two tourists discuss what they saw and experienced during a city tour.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Today's sightseeing was amazing! That landmark by the river was breathtaking.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I agree. The old town is so picturesque, almost like a painting.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: And the local cuisine was delicious. I want to learn about the indigenous culture too.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Me too. This city has such a rich heritage. It really is a memorable place.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Let's buy a souvenir before we leave so we can remember this trip.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Great idea. This whole journey has been truly memorable.

mini_dialogues.title: Dealing with Travel Trouble
mini_dialogues.situation: A frustrated passenger speaks to an airline desk about a cancelled flight.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: I just heard about the cancellation of my flight. What happens now?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I'm sorry. There was also a long delay on earlier flights due to the storm.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: So I'm stranded here overnight? I already have terrible jet lag.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Unfortunately the next flight is overbooked, but we can offer you a full refund.

turns.speaker: Passenger
turns.text: I'd prefer to fly tomorrow. Can you find me a seat?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Yes, I've secured one for the morning, and we'll cover your hotel tonight.

questions.question: What is the Gujarati meaning of 'itinerary'?
નીચેનામાંથી કયો શબ્દ 'મુસાફરીના બે ભાગ વચ્ચે ટૂંકો રોકાવ' નો અર્થ આપે છે?
Which word is a synonym of 'breathtaking'?
Which word is an antonym of 'departure'?
The storm cancelled all flights, and hundreds of passengers were ______ at the airport.
What does 'amenities' mean?
options: A) A planned route of a journey
B) Useful features and services at a place to stay
C) The act of leaving a place

questions.question: What is the Gujarati meaning of 'heritage'?
Because the tour was cancelled, the company gave us a full ______.
નીચેનામાંથી કયો શબ્દ 'ચિત્ર જેવું મનમોહક અને સુંદર' નો અર્થ આપે છે?
Which word is a synonym of 'souvenir'?
What does 'concierge' mean?
options: A) A document allowing entry to a country
B) A hotel employee who helps guests with bookings and requests
C) A style of cooking from a region
D) Tiredness after a long flight

questions.question: Which word is an antonym of 'underwhelming'?
What is the Gujarati meaning of 'jet lag'?
options: B) લાંબી ફ્લાઇટ પછી અનુભવાતો થાક

questions.question: Next week we will ______ on a road trip across the country.
નીચેનામાંથી કયો શબ્દ 'ઉપલબ્ધ ખાલી રૂમ' નો અર્થ આપે છે?

words.english_meaning: A piece of electronic equipment made for a particular purpose.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ ખાસ કામ માટે બનાવેલું ઇલેક્ટ્રોનિક સાધન, જેમ કે ફોન કે લેપટોપ.
words.usage_note: Commonly used for phones, tablets, and other portable electronics.
words.memory_tip: 'device' = ડિવાઇસ → સાધન જે કોઈ કામ માટે બનેલું છે.
examples: Most people carry at least one smart device every day.
This app works on any Android device.
Please charge your device before the meeting.
The hospital uses a special device to monitor heartbeats.

words.english_meaning: The part of a computer that performs calculations and runs programs.
words.gujarati_meaning: કમ્પ્યુટરનો એ ભાગ જે ગણતરી કરે છે અને પ્રોગ્રામ ચલાવે છે; એને કમ્પ્યુટરનું મગજ કહેવાય.
words.usage_note: A faster processor generally makes a computer run more smoothly.
examples: This laptop has a powerful processor for video editing.
