A slow processor can make games lag badly.
They upgraded the processor to boost performance.
The new phone's processor handles many apps at once.

words.english_meaning: An external device connected to a computer, such as a mouse or printer.
words.gujarati_meaning: કમ્પ્યુટર સાથે જોડાતું બહારનું સાધન, જેમ કે માઉસ, કીબોર્ડ કે પ્રિન્ટર.
words.usage_note: As an adjective, 'peripheral' also means of secondary importance.
words.memory_tip: 'peri' = આસપાસ → peripheral = આસપાસ જોડાતું વધારાનું સાધન.
examples: A keyboard is the most basic computer peripheral.
You can connect several peripherals through a USB hub.
The printer is a peripheral that needs its own driver.
Wireless peripherals reduce the clutter of cables.

words.english_meaning: A display screen that responds to being touched with a finger or stylus.
words.gujarati_meaning: એવી સ્ક્રીન જે આંગળી અડાડવાથી કામ કરે છે, જેમ કે સ્માર્ટફોનની સ્ક્રીન.
words.usage_note: Most modern smartphones and tablets rely entirely on a touchscreen.
words.memory_tip: 'touch' = સ્પર્શ + screen = સ્ક્રીન → સ્પર્શથી ચાલતી સ્ક્રીન.
examples: The cracked touchscreen no longer responds to my taps.
Modern cars now come with a large touchscreen display.
Clean the touchscreen gently with a soft cloth.
Her grandfather struggles with the small touchscreen buttons.

words.english_meaning: The physical parts of a computer or electronic system.
words.gujarati_meaning: કમ્પ્યુટર કે ઇલેક્ટ્રોનિક સિસ્ટમના ભૌતિક ભાગો, જેને હાથથી અડી શકાય.
words.usage_note: Hardware is the opposite of software; you can physically touch it.
words.memory_tip: 'hard' = કઠણ → hardware = કઠણ, અડી શકાય તેવા ભાગો.
examples: The hardware is fine, but the software keeps crashing.
Old hardware cannot run this heavy program.
They invested in new hardware for the office.
A hardware failure caused the server to shut down.

words.english_meaning: A device used to supply electrical power to recharge a battery.
words.gujarati_meaning: બેટરી ભરવા માટે વીજળી પૂરી પાડતું સાધન, જેમ કે ફોનનું ચાર્જર.
words.usage_note: A fast charger refills a battery much more quickly than a standard one.
examples: I forgot my charger at home, so my phone died.
This wireless charger works without any cables.
A faulty charger can damage your battery.
Could you lend me your charger for a minute?

words.english_meaning: A device that connects multiple devices to a network and to the internet.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક સાધન જે ઘણાં ડિવાઇસને નેટવર્ક અને ઇન્ટરનેટ સાથે જોડે છે.
words.usage_note: Restarting the router often fixes a weak Wi-Fi connection.
words.memory_tip: 'route' = માર્ગ → router = ડેટાને માર્ગ આપનાર સાધન.
examples: Restart the router if the internet stops working.
Place the router in the center of your home for better signal.
The new router supports much faster Wi-Fi.
I changed the password in the router settings.

words.english_meaning: A program used to access and view websites on the internet.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક પ્રોગ્રામ જેનાથી ઇન્ટરનેટ પર વેબસાઇટ ખોલીને જોઈ શકાય, જેમ કે ક્રોમ.
words.usage_note: Popular browsers include Chrome, Firefox, and Safari.
words.memory_tip: 'browse' = ફરી ફરીને જોવું → browser = વેબ ફેરવનાર પ્રોગ્રામ.
examples: Open your browser and type the website address.
Clearing the browser cache can fix loading problems.
This site works best on a modern browser.
She uses a private browser window for online banking.

words.english_meaning: To transfer data or files from the internet onto your device.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઇન્ટરનેટ પરથી ફાઇલ કે ડેટા તમારા ડિવાઇસમાં ઉતારવો.
words.usage_note: Download means bringing files in; upload means sending them out.
words.memory_tip: 'down' = નીચે → download = ઇન્ટરનેટથી નીચે પોતાના ડિવાઇસમાં લાવવું.
examples: Download the app from the official store only.
The file is too large to download on mobile data.
I downloaded the report before the meeting.
The movie is still downloading in the background.

words.english_meaning: A software program designed to perform a specific task on a device.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ ખાસ કામ કરવા માટેનો સોફ્ટવેર પ્રોગ્રામ, જેને ટૂંકમાં એપ કહેવાય.
words.usage_note: In everyday speech, 'application' is usually shortened to 'app'.
words.memory_tip: 'apply' = લાગુ કરવું → application = કામ માટે લાગુ થતો પ્રોગ્રામ.
examples: This application helps you learn new languages.
Close any application you are not using to save battery.
The banking application requires a fingerprint to open.
They built a new application for online shopping.

words.english_meaning: Watching or listening to media over the internet without downloading it first.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઇન્ટરનેટ પર સીધું વીડિયો કે સંગીત જોવું-સાંભળવું, ડાઉનલોડ કર્યા વગર.
words.usage_note: Streaming needs a steady internet connection to avoid buffering.
words.memory_tip: 'stream' = વહેણ → streaming = ડેટા સતત વહીને આવે છે.
examples: Streaming movies in high quality uses a lot of data.
She started a live streaming channel for cooking.
Music streaming has replaced buying CDs for many people.
The streaming kept stopping because of slow internet.

words.english_meaning: The maximum amount of data that can be transferred over a connection in a given time.
words.gujarati_meaning: નક્કી સમયમાં ઇન્ટરનેટ કનેક્શન પરથી મોકલી શકાય તેટલા ડેટાની મહત્તમ ક્ષમતા.
words.usage_note: Higher bandwidth allows faster downloads and smoother streaming.
words.memory_tip: 'band' = પટ્ટી + width = પહોળાઈ → ડેટા વહેવાની પહોળાઈ.
examples: Video calls use a large amount of bandwidth.
Low bandwidth makes streaming videos pause often.
The office upgraded to higher bandwidth last month.
Too many users sharing one line reduces everyone's bandwidth.

words.english_meaning: An arrangement to pay regularly to use a service or receive content.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ સેવા વાપરવા માટે નિયમિત રીતે પૈસા ભરવાની વ્યવસ્થા, જેમ કે માસિક પ્લાન.
words.usage_note: Many digital services now run on a monthly or yearly subscription model.
examples: I canceled my streaming subscription to save money.
The subscription renews automatically every month.
A yearly subscription is cheaper than paying monthly.
Your subscription gives you access to all premium features.

words.english_meaning: Online storage and computing where data is kept on remote internet servers.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઇન્ટરનેટ પરના દૂરના સર્વર પર ડેટા સંગ્રહવાની વ્યવસ્થા, જેને ક્લાઉડ કહેવાય.
words.usage_note: Files stored in the cloud can be accessed from any device.
words.memory_tip: 'cloud' = વાદળ → ડેટા જાણે વાદળમાં, ઇન્ટરનેટ પર સંગ્રહાય છે.
examples: All my photos are backed up to the cloud.
The cloud lets you open files from anywhere.
Our company moved its data to the cloud.
If you lose your phone, the cloud keeps your files safe.

words.english_meaning: A page showing a person's information and posts on a social media account.
words.gujarati_meaning: સોશિયલ મીડિયા પર વ્યક્તિની માહિતી અને પોસ્ટ બતાવતું પાનું.
words.usage_note: Your profile picture is often the first thing others notice.
examples: She updated her profile with a new photo.
Keep your profile private to protect your information.
His profile lists his job and hometown.
I added a short bio to my profile.

words.english_meaning: A person who subscribes to see another user's posts on social media.
words.gujarati_meaning: જે વ્યક્તિ બીજાની સોશિયલ મીડિયા પોસ્ટ જોવા માટે તેને ફોલો કરે છે.
words.usage_note: A large number of followers can give a person influence online.
words.memory_tip: 'follow' = પાછળ જવું → follower = પોસ્ટ જોવા ફોલો કરનાર.
examples: Her cooking videos gained thousands of followers.
He thanked his followers for their support.
Buying fake followers can get your account banned.
The brand replies to many of its followers' comments.

words.english_meaning: Spreading very quickly and widely among many people online.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઇન્ટરનેટ પર ખૂબ ઝડપથી અને દૂર સુધી ફેલાઈ જતું, જેમ કે વાઇરલ વીડિયો.
words.usage_note: When content 'goes viral', it suddenly reaches a huge audience.
words.memory_tip: 'virus' જેવું → viral = વાઇરસની જેમ ઝડપથી ફેલાય.
examples: His dance video went viral overnight.
A viral post can reach millions in a few hours.
The funny clip became viral on every platform.
Brands hope their ads will go viral.

words.english_meaning: A word or phrase with a hash sign used to label and group posts by topic.
words.gujarati_meaning: હેશ ચિહ્ન સાથેનો શબ્દ જે પોસ્ટને વિષય પ્રમાણે જૂથમાં ગોઠવે છે.
words.usage_note: Clicking a hashtag shows all posts using that same tag.
words.memory_tip: 'hash' = # ચિહ્ન + tag = નિશાન → hashtag = # વાળું નિશાન.
examples: Add a popular hashtag so more people see your post.
The hashtag started a worldwide campaign.
She follows a hashtag about healthy recipes.
Too many hashtags can make a caption look messy.

words.english_meaning: A person with many online followers who can affect others' opinions or buying choices.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઘણા ફોલોઅર ધરાવતી વ્યક્તિ જે લોકોના વિચાર કે ખરીદી પર અસર પાડે છે.
words.usage_note: Brands often pay influencers to promote their products.
examples: The travel influencer earns money from sponsored posts.
Brands hire influencers to reach younger customers.
She became an influencer through her fitness videos.
Not every influencer gives honest product reviews.

words.english_meaning: The stream of posts and updates you see when you open a social media app.
words.gujarati_meaning: સોશિયલ મીડિયા ખોલતા જે પોસ્ટ અને અપડેટની યાદી દેખાય તે ફીડ કહેવાય.
words.usage_note: Apps use algorithms to decide what appears in your feed.
words.memory_tip: 'feed' = ખવડાવવું → feed = તમને નવી પોસ્ટ સતત પીરસે છે.
examples: I scrolled through my feed during the break.
Her feed is full of travel photos.
Refresh the feed to see the latest posts.
The app changed how the feed shows posts.

words.english_meaning: The likes, comments, and shares that show how people interact with online content.
words.gujarati_meaning: પોસ્ટ પર મળતી લાઇક, કોમેન્ટ અને શેર, જે લોકોની પ્રતિક્રિયા બતાવે છે.
words.usage_note: Marketers track engagement to see how well a post performs.
words.memory_tip: 'engage' = જોડાવું → engagement = લોકો પોસ્ટ સાથે જોડાય.
examples: This post got high engagement with many comments.
Asking questions can boost engagement on your page.
Their engagement dropped after they posted less often.
Videos usually get more engagement than plain photos.

words.english_meaning: An alert from an app or device telling you about new activity or messages.
words.gujarati_meaning: એપ કે ડિવાઇસ તરફથી નવી પ્રવૃત્તિ કે સંદેશ વિશે આપતી સૂચના.
words.usage_note: You can mute notifications to avoid constant interruptions.
words.memory_tip: 'notify' = જાણ કરવી → notification = જાણ કરતી સૂચના.
examples: I get a notification whenever someone messages me.
Turn off notifications during your study time.
A push notification reminded her about the sale.
His phone buzzes with notifications all day.

words.english_meaning: A file sent along with an email or message.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઈમેલ કે સંદેશ સાથે જોડીને મોકલેલી ફાઇલ.
words.usage_note: Never open an attachment from an unknown sender; it may contain a virus.
examples: Please find the report in the attachment.
The attachment was too big to send by email.
Be careful before opening any unknown attachment.
She forgot to add the attachment to her email.

words.english_meaning: The folder where incoming emails or messages are received and stored.
words.gujarati_meaning: આવેલા ઈમેલ કે સંદેશ જમા થાય તે ફોલ્ડર, જેને ઇનબોક્સ કહેવાય.
words.usage_note: Keeping your inbox organized helps you find important messages.
words.memory_tip: 'in' = અંદર + box = પેટી → ઇનબોક્સ = આવેલા સંદેશની પેટી.
examples: Check your inbox for the confirmation email.
My inbox is full of unread messages.
She cleared her inbox before the weekend.
The reply landed straight in my inbox.

words.english_meaning: To send a received message or email on to another person.
words.gujarati_meaning: મળેલો સંદેશ કે ઈમેલ બીજા કોઈને આગળ મોકલવો.
words.usage_note: Avoid forwarding chain messages or unverified information.
examples: Please forward this email to the whole team.
She forwarded the invitation to her friends.
Don't forward messages you haven't checked.
He forwarded the document to his manager.

words.english_meaning: To respond to a message, email, or comment.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ સંદેશ, ઈમેલ કે કોમેન્ટનો જવાબ આપવો.
words.usage_note: Be careful with 'reply all', as it sends your message to everyone.
examples: Please reply to my email by tomorrow.
She replied to every comment on her post.
He forgot to reply to the invitation.
Don't click 'reply all' unless everyone needs the answer.

words.english_meaning: A small digital picture used to express an emotion or idea in messages.
words.gujarati_meaning: સંદેશમાં લાગણી કે વિચાર બતાવવા વપરાતું નાનું ડિજિટલ ચિત્ર.
words.usage_note: Emojis can soften the tone of a short text message.
examples: She added a heart emoji to her reply.
Sometimes an emoji says more than words.
He uses too many emojis in his messages.
A thumbs-up emoji means she agreed.

words.english_meaning: A live meeting held over the internet where people see and hear each other.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઇન્ટરનેટ પર થતી જીવંત મીટિંગ જેમાં લોકો એકબીજાને જોઈ-સાંભળી શકે.
words.usage_note: Videoconferences let teams in different cities meet without travel.
words.memory_tip: 'video' + conference = બેઠક → વીડિયો દ્વારા થતી બેઠક.
examples: We held a videoconference with the foreign office.
Please mute your mic during the videoconference.
The videoconference saved us a long flight.
Her internet dropped in the middle of the videoconference.

words.english_meaning: A small, temporary fault in a system or program.
words.gujarati_meaning: સિસ્ટમ કે પ્રોગ્રામમાં થોડી વાર માટે આવતી નાની ખામી.
words.usage_note: A glitch is usually minor and often disappears on its own.
examples: A small glitch froze the screen for a second.
The app had a glitch that deleted my notes.
They fixed the glitch in the next update.
A payment glitch double-charged some customers.

words.english_meaning: Harmful software designed to damage or gain access to a device.
words.gujarati_meaning: નુકસાન કરવા કે ડિવાઇસમાં ઘૂસવા માટે બનાવેલો હાનિકારક સોફ્ટવેર.
words.usage_note: Good antivirus software helps protect your device from malware.
examples: Malware slowed his computer to a crawl.
Never download files from sites that spread malware.
The malware stole users' passwords.
They cleaned the malware off the infected laptop.

words.english_meaning: A pause in video or audio while data loads over a slow connection.
words.gujarati_meaning: ધીમા કનેક્શનને કારણે વીડિયો કે ઓડિયો અટકીને ડેટા લોડ થવાની રાહ જોવી.
words.usage_note: Buffering usually means your internet speed is too slow for the video.
words.memory_tip: 'buffer' = રાહ જોવાનો સંગ્રહ → buffering = વીડિયો અટકીને રાહ જુએ.
examples: The video kept buffering because of weak Wi-Fi.
Lower the quality to reduce buffering.
Constant buffering ruined the live match.
After I restarted the router, the buffering stopped.

words.english_meaning: When a program or device suddenly stops working completely.
words.gujarati_meaning: જ્યારે પ્રોગ્રામ કે ડિવાઇસ અચાનક સંપૂર્ણ બંધ થઈ જાય.
words.usage_note: Saving your work often protects you when a program crashes.
words.memory_tip: 'crash' = તૂટી પડવું → પ્રોગ્રામ અચાનક બંધ થઈ જાય.
examples: The game crashed right before I could save.
My laptop crashes whenever I open too many tabs.
A sudden crash erased an hour of work.
The website crashed under heavy traffic.

words.english_meaning: Unwanted messages or emails sent in large numbers, often advertising.
words.gujarati_meaning: મોટી સંખ્યામાં મોકલાતા નકામા સંદેશ કે ઈમેલ, મોટેભાગે જાહેરાતના.
words.usage_note: Email services move suspected spam into a separate folder automatically.
examples: My spam folder is full of fake offers.
Mark that message as spam so it stops.
Spam emails often try to steal your details.
He gets dozens of spam texts every day.

words.english_meaning: Gaining unauthorized access to a computer system or account.
words.gujarati_meaning: પરવાનગી વગર કોઈના કમ્પ્યુટર સિસ્ટમ કે એકાઉન્ટમાં ઘૂસવાની ક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: Strong passwords and two-factor login help prevent hacking.
words.memory_tip: 'hack' = ઘૂસવું → hacking = પરવાનગી વગર ઘૂસવાની ક્રિયા.
examples: The bank improved security after a hacking attempt.
Hacking into someone's account is a crime.
Two-factor login reduces the risk of hacking.
News of the hacking worried millions of users.

words.english_meaning: To send files or data from your device to the internet or a server.
words.gujarati_meaning: પોતાના ડિવાઇસથી ફાઇલ કે ડેટા ઇન્ટરનેટ કે સર્વર પર મોકલવો.
words.usage_note: Upload sends files out, while download brings them in.
words.memory_tip: 'up' = ઉપર → upload = પોતાનું ઇન્ટરનેટ ઉપર મોકલવું.
examples: She uploaded the photos to share with family.
Please upload the document before the deadline.
Uploading large files takes time on slow internet.
He uploads a new video every week.

words.english_meaning: To make data the same across two or more devices automatically.
words.gujarati_meaning: બે કે વધારે ડિવાઇસમાં ડેટા આપમેળે એકસરખો રાખવો.
words.usage_note: When devices sync, changes on one appear on the others.
words.memory_tip: 'sync' = synchronize નું ટૂંકું → ડેટા એકસરખો રાખવો.
examples: My phone and laptop sync my photos automatically.
Sync your contacts before switching phones.
The files synced as soon as I went online.
Calendar events sync across all my devices.

words.english_meaning: To set up a program or app so it is ready to use on a device.
words.gujarati_meaning: પ્રોગ્રામ કે એપને ડિવાઇસમાં ગોઠવીને વાપરવા માટે તૈયાર કરવી.
words.usage_note: Always install apps from a trusted source to stay safe.
examples: Install the latest update for better security.
She installed a new editing app on her phone.
Installing the software took only a minute.
You must install the driver before using the printer.

words.english_meaning: To turn a device off and on again to restart it.
words.gujarati_meaning: ડિવાઇસ બંધ કરીને ફરી ચાલુ કરવું, જેને રીસ્ટાર્ટ પણ કહેવાય.
words.usage_note: Rebooting often solves small glitches and freezes.
words.memory_tip: 're' = ફરી + boot = ચાલુ → reboot = ફરી ચાલુ કરવું.
examples: Reboot the computer to apply the update.
A quick reboot fixed the frozen screen.
Rebooting the router restored the connection.
Try rebooting before you call support.

words.english_meaning: To convert data into a secret code so only authorized people can read it.
words.gujarati_meaning: ડેટાને ગુપ્ત કોડમાં ફેરવવો જેથી માત્ર પરવાનગીવાળા જ વાંચી શકે.
words.usage_note: Encrypting messages keeps them private even if intercepted.
words.memory_tip: 'crypt' = ગુપ્ત → encrypt = ડેટાને ગુપ્ત કોડમાં ફેરવવો.
examples: The app encrypts every message you send.
Banks encrypt your data to keep it safe.
He encrypted the file before emailing it.
Encrypted chats cannot be read by outsiders.

words.english_meaning: To look through websites or content on the internet casually.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઇન્ટરનેટ પર વેબસાઇટ કે માહિતી આમતેમ ફેરવીને જોવી.
words.usage_note: 'Browse' suggests casual looking rather than searching for one thing.
words.memory_tip: 'browse' = ફરી ફરીને જોવું → ઇન્ટરનેટ પર આમતેમ જોવું.
examples: I like to browse the news every morning.
She browsed several stores before buying online.
He spent the evening browsing travel websites.
You can browse the catalog without signing in.

mini_dialogues.title: My Phone Keeps Crashing
mini_dialogues.situation: Two friends discuss a misbehaving smartphone.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: My phone keeps crashing whenever I open the camera app.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Have you tried to reboot it? A quick restart often fixes a glitch like that.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I did, but it crashed again. Maybe I should install the latest update.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Good idea. Sometimes old software causes these problems on newer hardware.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'll update tonight and see if the crashing stops.

mini_dialogues.title: Going Viral
mini_dialogues.situation: A young creator talks to a friend about a sudden surge of attention.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: My cooking video went viral last night! I gained five thousand followers.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That's amazing! The engagement on your profile must be huge right now.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: It is. My feed is full of comments, and a brand wants me to become an influencer.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Don't forget to use the right hashtag so even more people find you.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Great tip. I'll add a few popular ones to my next post.

mini_dialogues.title: Sorting Out the Inbox
mini_dialogues.situation: A manager helps a new employee handle email at work.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Could you check your inbox? I sent the report as an attachment this morning.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Found it. Should I reply to everyone, or just to you?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Just reply to me, then forward the file to the finance team.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Will do. By the way, a lot of spam is filling my inbox today.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Mark those messages as spam and they'll stop appearing.

mini_dialogues.title: Slow Streaming Night
mini_dialogues.situation: A couple tries to watch a movie with a weak connection.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The movie keeps buffering. I think our bandwidth is too low tonight.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Let me reboot the router. That usually improves the streaming.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: While you do that, I'll lower the video quality in the app.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Done. The router is back on. Is the buffering gone now?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yes, it's playing smoothly. Maybe too many devices were using the cloud backup.

mini_dialogues.title: Staying Safe Online
mini_dialogues.situation: A father gives his daughter advice about online security.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Dad, I got a strange email with an attachment I didn't expect.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Don't open it. It could contain malware that harms your device.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good thing I asked. How do I protect my messages then?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Use an app that encrypts your chats, and never reuse passwords to avoid hacking.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Got it. I'll delete the email and turn on two-factor login.

questions.question: What does 'hardware' mean?
options: A) કમ્પ્યુટરના ભૌતિક ભાગો જેને અડી શકાય

questions.question: કયો શબ્દ 'ઇન્ટરનેટ પરથી ફાઇલ પોતાના ડિવાઇસમાં ઉતારવી' એ અર્થ આપે છે?
Which word is closest in meaning to 'viral'?
What is the opposite of 'upload'?
The video kept ______ because of weak Wi-Fi.
Which word means 'harmful software designed to damage or access a device'?
કયો શબ્દ 'ઇન્ટરનેટ પરના સર્વર પર ડેટા સંગ્રહવાની વ્યવસ્થા' એ અર્થ આપે છે?
Which word is closest in meaning to 'application'?
What does 'notification' mean?
options: A) એપ કે ડિવાઇસ તરફથી આપતી સૂચના

questions.question: ______ the computer to apply the update.
What is the opposite of 'encrypt'?
Which word means 'a person with many online followers who affects others' choices'?
કયો શબ્દ 'ઈમેલ સાથે જોડીને મોકલેલી ફાઇલ' એ અર્થ આપે છે?
Which word is closest in meaning to 'glitch'?
My ______ folder is full of fake offers and junk emails.

words.english_meaning: A large self-service store selling food, household goods, and other items.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક મોટી સ્વ-સેવા દુકાન જ્યાં ખોરાક, ઘરવખરી અને અન્ય ચીજો વેચાય છે.
words.usage_note: Used for large stores with many departments under one roof.
examples: I buy vegetables from the supermarket every week.
The supermarket is open until midnight.
She found a great deal at the supermarket.
The supermarket has a bakery section.

words.english_meaning: A small shop selling fashionable clothes or accessories.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક નાની દુકાન જ્યાં ફેશનેબલ કપડાં અથવા ઍક્સેસરીઝ વેચાય છે.
words.usage_note: Usually implies a small, stylish, and often expensive shop.
words.memory_tip: 'Boutique' = ફ્રેન્ચ શબ્દ, નાની ફેન્સી દુકાન — like a VIP shop!
examples: She bought her wedding dress from a boutique.
The boutique on Main Street sells imported clothes.
They opened a boutique specializing in handmade jewelry.
The boutique was beautifully decorated.

words.english_meaning: A shop where medicines and healthcare products are sold.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં દવાઓ અને આરોગ્ય સંબંધી ઉત્પાદનો વેચાય છે.
words.usage_note: In British English 'chemist' is used; in American English 'drugstore' or 'pharmacy'.
examples: Pick up my prescription from the pharmacy.
The pharmacy is next to the clinic.
She works as a pharmacist at the pharmacy.
The pharmacy stocks vitamins and supplements.

words.english_meaning: An outdoor market where people sell second-hand goods at low prices.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક ખુલ્લું બજાર જ્યાં લોકો સસ્તા ભાવે જૂની ચીજો વેચે છે.
words.usage_note: Often held on weekends; great for bargain hunting.
words.memory_tip: 'Flea' = ચાંચડ (નાનો) → નાની-નાની સસ્તી ચીજો મળે એ flea market.
examples: I found antique coins at the flea market.
The flea market opens every Sunday morning.
She loves browsing flea markets for vintage items.
They sold homemade crafts at the flea market.

words.english_meaning: A small shop open long hours selling everyday essential items.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક નાની દુકાન જે લાંબા સમય સુધી ખુલ્લી રહે અને રોજની જરૂરી ચીજો વેચે.
words.usage_note: Typically more expensive than supermarkets due to convenience.
examples: I grabbed a snack from the convenience store.
The convenience store is open 24 hours.
She stopped at the convenience store for milk.
Convenience stores often sell lottery tickets.

words.english_meaning: A large retail store with separate sections for different types of goods.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક મોટી દુકાન જ્યાં જુદા-જુદા પ્રકારની ચીજો માટે અલગ-અલગ વિભાગ હોય.
words.usage_note: Examples: Walmart, Marks & Spencer, Shoppers Stop.
words.memory_tip: 'Department' = વિભાગ → department store = ઘણા વિભાગ વાળી દુકાન.
examples: We bought furniture from the department store.
The department store has a sale every Christmas.
She works in the cosmetics section of a department store.
The department store spans five floors.

words.english_meaning: A market where goods are sold in large quantities at lower prices, usually to retailers.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક બજાર જ્યાં ઘણો મોટો જથ્થો ઓછા ભાવે, ખાસ કરીને વેપારીઓને, વેચાય છે.
words.usage_note: Wholesale is cheaper per unit but requires buying in bulk.
words.memory_tip: 'Whole' = આખો/બધો → wholesale = બધો માલ એકસાથે ખરીદવો.
examples: Shopkeepers buy goods from the wholesale market.
The wholesale market opens early in the morning.
She visited the wholesale market to stock her store.
Prices at the wholesale market are much lower.

words.english_meaning: A shop where manufacturers sell products directly at discounted prices.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં ઉત્પાદક સીધા ઘટાડેલા ભાવે ઉત્પાદનો વેચે છે.
words.usage_note: Often located outside city centers; sells last season's stock or slight defects.
words.memory_tip: 'Outlet' = બહાર નીકળવાનો રસ્તો → manufacturer નો outlet = factory outlet store.
examples: I bought branded shoes from the outlet store.
The outlet store has up to 70% off.
She found designer handbags at the outlet.
Outlet stores are popular during holiday sales.

words.english_meaning: A shop where people can borrow money by leaving valuable items as security.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં ઘરેણા જેવી કીમતી વસ્તુ ગિરવી મૂકીને પૈસા ઉધાર મળે છે.
words.usage_note: If you repay the loan with interest, you get your item back.
words.memory_tip: 'Pawn' = ગિરવી → pawnshop = ગિરવી દુકાન (ઘરેણું ગિરવી, પૈસા મળે).
examples: He pawned his watch at the pawnshop.
The pawnshop gave her a loan against her gold ring.
She redeemed her jewelry from the pawnshop.
Pawnshops offer quick cash in emergencies.

words.english_meaning: A shop selling second-hand goods, often run by charities.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં ઉપયોગ થઈ ગયેલ ચીજો વેચાય છે, ઘણી વખત ધર્માદો સંસ્થા ચલાવે.
words.usage_note: Very popular in the US and UK; eco-friendly shopping option.
words.memory_tip: 'Thrift' = કરકસર → thrift store = કરકસર ભરી ખરીદી (સસ્તી, વાપરેલ ચીજો).
examples: She found a vintage jacket at the thrift store.
Thrift stores help reduce waste.
He donated old books to the thrift store.
Thrift shopping is trendy among young people.

words.english_meaning: A place where goods are sold to the highest bidder through a public sale.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક સ્થળ જ્યાં ચીજો જાહેર હરાજી દ્વારા સૌથી વધુ ભાવ આપનારને વેચાય.
words.usage_note: Famous auction houses include Sotheby's and Christie's.
examples: The painting sold for millions at the auction house.
She bid on antique furniture at the auction house.
Auction houses deal in art, jewelry, and collectibles.
He attended an auction house event last month.

words.english_meaning: A person or shop that sells flowers and floral arrangements.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક વ્યક્તિ અથવા દુકાન જ્યાં ફૂલ અને ફૂલ સજાવટ વેચાય છે.
words.usage_note: A florist can also arrange custom bouquets for events.
examples: She ordered a bouquet from the florist.
The florist arranged flowers for the wedding.
The florist is open on Valentine's Day.
He works as a florist and loves his job.

words.english_meaning: A shop that sells writing materials, paper, pens, and office supplies.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં કાગળ, પેન, ઑફિસ સ્ટેશનરી અને લખવા-ભણવાની ચીજો મળે.
words.usage_note: Do not confuse 'stationery' (paper/pen) with 'stationary' (not moving).
words.memory_tip: 'Stationery' → 'e' for envelope → pen, paper, envelope — stationery shop!
examples: She bought notebooks from the stationery shop.
The stationery shop sells art supplies too.
Children visit the stationery shop before school.
The stationery shop is near the library.

words.english_meaning: A shop selling cooked meats, cheeses, and fine prepared foods.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં રાંધેલ માંસ, ચીઝ અને તૈયાર ખાસ ખોરાક મળે છે.
words.usage_note: Commonly shortened to 'deli'. Often sells sandwiches and imported foods.
examples: He bought smoked salmon from the delicatessen.
The delicatessen makes excellent sandwiches.
She visited the deli for imported cheese.
The delicatessen is known for its gourmet products.

words.english_meaning: A shop selling tools, building materials, and home improvement products.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં સાધનો, બાંધકામ સામગ્રી અને ઘર સુધારણાની ચીજો મળે.
words.usage_note: In the UK, often called a 'DIY store' or 'ironmonger'.
words.memory_tip: 'Hard' + 'ware' = ઠોસ/કઠણ ચીજો → hardware store = ઓજારો ને સાધનોની દુકાન.
examples: Dad went to the hardware store to buy nails.
The hardware store sells paint and brushes.
She found a good drill at the hardware store.
The hardware store is helpful for home repairs.

words.english_meaning: A shop where books are sold.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં પુસ્તકો વેચાય છે.
words.usage_note: 'Bookstore' is American English; 'bookshop' is British English.
examples: She spent hours browsing the bookstore.
The bookstore has a great children's section.
He bought a novel from the bookstore.
The bookstore hosts author signing events.

words.english_meaning: A shop that sells rings, necklaces, bracelets, and other ornaments.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાน જ્યાં વીંટી, હાર, બંગડી અને અન્ય ઘરેણા વેચાય છે.
words.usage_note: 'Jewellery' is British spelling; 'jewelry' is American spelling.
examples: She bought gold earrings from the jewellery shop.
The jewellery shop has a wide collection.
He proposed with a ring from the local jewellery shop.
The jewellery shop offers free engraving.

words.english_meaning: Something bought for less than its usual price; also to negotiate a lower price.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઓછી કિંમતે ખરીદાયેલ ચીજ, અથવા ભાવ ઘટાડવા માટે વાટાઘાટ કરવી.
words.usage_note: As a verb: 'to bargain' = to negotiate price. As a noun: 'a bargain' = a great deal.
examples: This jacket was a real bargain at half price.
She loves bargain hunting at flea markets.
They bargained for a lower price.
It's a bargain you can't refuse.

words.english_meaning: To buy something; or the act of buying something.
words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈ ખરીદવું; અથવા ખરીદીની ક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: 'Purchase' is more formal than 'buy'. Used in official receipts and documents.
words.memory_tip: 'pur' = સારી રીતે + 'chase' = પીછો → purchase = ચીજ પાછળ ધ્યાન આપી ખરીદવી.
examples: She made a purchase at the online store.
Please keep your purchase receipt.
The purchase was completed within minutes.
He purchased a new laptop yesterday.

words.english_meaning: A person or company that sells goods or services.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક વ્યક્તિ અથવા કંપની જે ચીજો અથવા સેવાઓ વેચે છે.
words.usage_note: Street vendors sell goods outdoors; online vendors sell through websites.
examples: The street vendor sells fresh fruit every morning.
We chose a reliable vendor for office supplies.
The food vendor set up a stall near the park.
Online vendors offer competitive prices.

words.english_meaning: A written or printed document confirming payment for goods or services.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખરીદી માટે ચૂકવણીની પુષ્ટિ આપતો લખિત અથવા છાપેલ કાગળ.
words.usage_note: Always keep your receipt in case you need to return or exchange an item.
examples: Can I have a receipt for this purchase?
Keep the receipt if you want to return it.
The receipt shows the date and price.
She lost her receipt and couldn't get a refund.

words.english_meaning: Money returned to a customer when they return a product or cancel a service.
words.gujarati_meaning: ગ્રાહક ચીજ પરત કરે અથવા સેવા રદ કરે ત્યારે પાછા અપાતા પૈસા.
words.usage_note: You may need the original receipt to claim a refund.
examples: I asked for a refund because the item was defective.
The store gave me a full refund.
The refund was credited to my account.
Their refund policy allows 30 days.

words.english_meaning: To give one thing and receive another in return; to swap a product for a different one.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક ચીજ આપીને બીજી લેવી; ખરીદેલ ઉત્પાદ બદલાવવું.
words.usage_note: In shopping: exchange means replacing a product with a different size/colour.
examples: Can I exchange this shirt for a larger size?
The shop allows exchange within 7 days.
They exchanged gifts on Christmas.
The exchange rate affects international shopping.

words.english_meaning: The selling of goods in large quantities at lower prices, typically to retailers.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઓછા ભાવે મોટા જથ્થામાં ચીજો વેચવી, ખાસ કરીને દુકાનદારોને.
words.usage_note: Wholesale requires buying large quantities; not typically available to individual consumers.
examples: She buys fabric wholesale for her boutique.
Wholesale prices are much lower than retail.
He is a wholesale dealer in electronics.
The wholesale market opens at 5 AM.

words.english_meaning: The sale of goods to individual consumers in small quantities.
words.gujarati_meaning: વ્યક્તિગત ગ્રાહકોને નાની માત્રામાં ચીજો વેચવી.
words.usage_note: Retail prices are higher than wholesale because of added costs.
words.memory_tip: 'Re' + 'tail' = ફરી + છેડો → retail = છેલ્લો ગ્રાહક સુધી વેચાણ.
examples: The retail price of this phone is ₹15,000.
She works in retail management.
The retail sector has grown this year.
Retail stores attract many shoppers on weekends.

words.english_meaning: To argue or negotiate over the price of something, especially in a market.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખાસ કરીને બજારમાં ભાવ ઘટાડવા માટે ઝઘડો/વાટાઘાટ કરવી.
words.usage_note: Haggling is common and expected in street markets and bazaars.
words.memory_tip: 'Haggle' = ઘા-ઘૂ → ઘા-ઘૂ કરી ભાવ ઘટાડવો — that's haggling!
examples: She haggled the price down by 30%.
Don't be afraid to haggle at the market.
He haggled with the vendor for 10 minutes.
Haggling is a skill that saves money.

words.english_meaning: An offer of a specific price for something at an auction or in a competition.
words.gujarati_meaning: હરાજી અથવા સ્પર્ધામાં ચોક્કસ ભાવ ઑફર કરવો.
words.usage_note: In online shopping (e.g., eBay), users bid to win items.
examples: She placed a bid of ₹5,000 on the antique vase.
The winning bid was much higher than expected.
He bid on several items at the auction.
Online bidding is common on platforms like eBay.

words.english_meaning: A document sent by a seller to a buyer, listing goods/services and the amount owed.
words.gujarati_meaning: વેચનાર દ્વારા ખરીદનારને મોકલવામાં આવેલ કાગળ, જેમાં ચીજો અને ચૂકવવાની રકમ હોય.
words.usage_note: Invoices are used in business transactions; receipts are given at retail stores.
words.memory_tip: 'In' + 'voice' = અંદર + અવાજ → invoice = ગ્રાહક સુધી પૈસા માટેનો 'અવાજ' (demand).
examples: Please send the invoice by email.
The invoice is due within 30 days.
She received an invoice for the repair service.
The invoice lists all items purchased.

words.english_meaning: Goods sent to a seller to sell on behalf of the owner, with payment after sale.
words.gujarati_meaning: માલ માલિક વતી વેચવા માટે વેચનારને મોકલવો, વેચ્યા પછી ચૂકવણી.
words.usage_note: In consignment selling, the seller only pays the supplier after goods are sold.
words.memory_tip: 'Con' + 'sign' = સાથે + સહી → consignment = સહી કરી માલ સોંપવો.
examples: She sells clothes on consignment at the boutique.
The consignment arrived yesterday.
He operates a consignment store for used goods.
Payment is made once the consignment is sold.

words.english_meaning: A reduction in the price of a product, often to clear stock.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઉત્પાદનની કિંમત ઘટાડવી, ઘણી વખત સ્ટૉક ખાલી કરવા.
words.usage_note: Opposite of markup; stores markdown prices during clearance sales.
examples: The store offered a 40% markdown on winter coats.
Items are marked down after the holiday season.
Look for markdowns to save money.
The markdown brought more customers in.

words.english_meaning: The amount added to the cost price of goods to cover expenses and profit.
words.gujarati_meaning: ચીજની કિંમત ઉપર ઉમેરાયેલ રકમ, ખર્ચ અને નફો આવરવા.
words.usage_note: A 50% markup means a product that costs ₹100 is sold for ₹150.
examples: Luxury brands have a very high markup.
The markup on electronics is usually 20-30%.
She calculated the markup to determine the selling price.
High markups reduce customer loyalty.

words.english_meaning: An excess of production or stock beyond what is needed.
words.gujarati_meaning: જરૂર કરતા વધારે ઉત્પાદન અથવા સ્ટૉક.
words.usage_note: Surplus goods are often sold at reduced prices to clear inventory.
examples: The store has a surplus of summer clothes.
Surplus food was donated to the charity.
A trade surplus means more exports than imports.
They sold surplus inventory at a discount.

words.english_meaning: A complete list of goods/products a business has in stock.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક વ્યવસાયમાં ઉપલબ્ધ ચીજોની સંપૂર્ણ યાદી.
words.usage_note: Regular inventory checks help businesses avoid stockouts or overstocking.
words.memory_tip: 'Invent' + 'ory' = ઊભું કરેલ + સ્થળ → inventory = ચીજો ઊભી કરેલ/રાખેલ જગ્યા.
examples: The manager did an inventory check this morning.
They use software for inventory management.
The inventory shows 50 units remaining.
Out-of-stock items need inventory restocking.

words.english_meaning: To send back a purchased item to the store, usually for a refund or exchange.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખરીદેલ ચીજ દુકાને પાછી આપવી, ઘણી વખત રિફંડ અથવા બદલી માટે.
words.usage_note: Most stores have a return window (e.g., 15 or 30 days) with receipt required.
words.memory_tip: 'Re' = પાછું + 'turn' = ફેરવ → return = ફરી પાછું ફેરવવું.
examples: I need to return these shoes; they don't fit.
The store has a 30-day return policy.
She returned the dress and got a full refund.
Returning items online is easy with prepaid labels.

words.english_meaning: A label attached to a product showing its price.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઉત્પાદ ઉપર લગાડેલ ટૅગ જે ભાવ દર્શાવે.
words.usage_note: Also used figuratively: 'the price tag of success' = the cost of achieving something.
words.memory_tip: 'Price' = ભાવ + 'tag' = ટૅગ/ચિઠ્ઠી → price tag = ભાવ ચિઠ્ઠી.
examples: Always check the price tag before buying.
She removed the price tag as a gift.
The price tag said ₹2,500.
Some luxury items don't display a price tag.

words.english_meaning: A reduction in the usual price of something.
words.gujarati_meaning: ચીજની સામાન્ย કિંમતમાં ઘટાડો.
words.usage_note: Discounts are given in percentage (10% off) or fixed amount (₹100 off).
words.memory_tip: 'Dis' = દૂર + 'count' = ગણ → discount = ભાવ ગણ દૂર (ઘટાડ).
examples: The shop offered a 20% discount on all items.
She got a student discount at the museum.
Are there any discounts for bulk buying?
The discount code saved me ₹500.

words.english_meaning: To discuss something to reach an agreement, especially about a price.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ વ્યાપારિક સોદો, ખાસ કરીને ભાવ અંગે, સંમતિ મળે ત્યાં સુધી ચર્ચા કરવી.
words.usage_note: Negotiation is a key business skill; also used in salary discussions.
words.memory_tip: 'Neg' + 'otiate' = ના + ઓ → negotiation = 'ના' ન પડે ત્યાં સુધી ચર્ચા.
examples: He negotiated the price down by ₹2,000.
She is good at negotiating deals.
They negotiated the terms of the contract.
Negotiate politely for best results.

words.english_meaning: A voucher that gives the holder a discount or special offer.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક વાઉચર જે ધારક ને ડિસ્કાઉન્ટ અથવા ખાસ ઑફર આપે.
words.usage_note: Coupons can be physical (cut from a newspaper) or digital (promo codes online).
examples: Use this coupon to get 15% off.
She collected coupons from magazines.
Enter the coupon code at checkout.
The coupon expires at the end of the month.

words.english_meaning: A period when a shop sells goods at reduced prices.
words.gujarati_meaning: એવો સમય જ્યારે દુકાન ઘટાડેલ ભાวે ચીજો વેચે.
words.usage_note: 'On sale' means reduced price. 'For sale' means available to buy.
examples: The shop has a big sale every January.
These shoes are on sale for half price.
She waited for the sale to buy the coat.
Flash sales last only a few hours.

words.english_meaning: Priced too high; costing more than the item is worth.
words.gujarati_meaning: ભાવ ઘણો વધારે, ચીજ જેટલી કિંમત છે તેના કરતા ઘણી મોંઘી.
words.usage_note: Used when the buyer feels they are not getting value for money.
words.memory_tip: 'Over' = વધારે + 'priced' = ભાવ → overpriced = ભાવ ઘણો વધારે.
examples: This coffee is so overpriced for what you get.
Tourists often pay overpriced rates.
The hotel was luxurious but overpriced.
I refused to buy the overpriced souvenir.

words.english_meaning: Reasonably priced; not too expensive to buy.
words.gujarati_meaning: વ્યાજબી ભાવ; ખૂબ મોંઘી ન હોય.
words.usage_note: 'Afford' = to have enough money. 'Affordable' = priced within reach.
words.memory_tip: 'Afford' = ભોગવી શકવું → affordable = ભોગવી શકાય એ ભાવ.
examples: This restaurant offers affordable meals.
We found an affordable apartment near the city.
The brand is known for affordable fashion.
Are there any more affordable options?

words.english_meaning: A stated price for a product or service before purchase; to state such a price.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખરીદી પહેલા ઉત્પાદ/સેવા માટે જણાવેલ ભાવ; ભાว જણાવવો.
words.usage_note: 'Quote' and 'quotation' are interchangeable for prices.
examples: Can you give me a quote for the renovation?
The plumber quoted ₹3,000 for the repair.
She got three quotes before choosing a supplier.
The quote was much higher than expected.

words.english_meaning: An approximate calculation of cost or value.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખર્ચ અથવા મૂલ્યની અંદાજિત ગણતરી.
words.usage_note: Estimates can be rough or detailed; they may change once work begins.
examples: The contractor gave a rough estimate of ₹50,000.
We estimated the total cost at ₹1 lakh.
Please send a written estimate by Friday.
The actual cost was close to the estimate.

words.english_meaning: Getting good quality or quantity in exchange for the price paid.
words.gujarati_meaning: ચૂકવેલ ભાવ અનુસાર સારી ગુણવત્તા અથવા માત્રા મળવી.
words.usage_note: Often used in reviews: 'This product offers excellent value for money.'
words.memory_tip: 'Value' = મૂલ્ય + 'money' = પૈસા → value for money = પૈસા ઉઠ્ઠાં = worthwhile!
examples: This all-inclusive hotel is great value for money.
The course offered excellent value for money.
Cheap products aren't always value for money.
Consumers look for value for money when shopping.

words.english_meaning: A sale in which goods are sold cheaply to get rid of old stock.
words.gujarati_meaning: પૂરાણો સ્ટૉક ઓછા ભાવે ઉડાડી દેવા ગોઠવેલ વેચાણ.
words.usage_note: Clearance items often cannot be returned or exchanged.
words.memory_tip: 'Clear' = સાફ → clearance = સ્ટૉક સાફ (ઉડાડ) → clearance sale.
examples: I bought a coat in the clearance sale.
The clearance rack has 70% off items.
They held a clearance sale to make room for new stock.
Check clearance sections for the best deals.

words.english_meaning: The act of arguing or negotiating about the price of something.
words.gujarati_meaning: ભાવ ઘટાડવા માટે ઝઘડો/ચર્ચા કરવાની ક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: In many cultures, haggling is expected and seen as part of the shopping experience.
words.memory_tip: 'Haggle' = ઘા-ઘૂ → haggling = ઘા-ઘૂ કરી ભાવ ઘટાડ.
examples: Haggling is common in Turkish bazaars.
She improved her haggling skills on a trip to Morocco.
He is not comfortable with haggling.
A bit of haggling can save you a lot.

words.english_meaning: A set price that cannot be negotiated or changed.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક નક્કી ભાવ જે વાટાઘાટ અથવા બદલી ન શકાય.
words.usage_note: Supermarkets and malls typically have fixed prices; bazaars and markets often don't.
words.memory_tip: 'Fixed' = નક્કી + 'price' = ભાવ → fixed price = નક્કી ભાવ.
examples: The restaurant offers a fixed price lunch menu.
Their policy is fixed price — no negotiations.
Fixed price contracts help avoid disputes.
Unlike markets, malls have fixed prices.

words.english_meaning: A general increase in prices and fall in the purchasing value of money.
words.gujarati_meaning: ભાવ સ્તરમાં સામાન્ય વૃદ્ધિ અને પૈસાની ખરીદ-શક્તિ ઘટવી.
words.usage_note: Central banks raise interest rates to control inflation.
examples: High inflation has made groceries expensive.
The inflation rate is 6% this year.
Inflation affects the purchasing power of citizens.
Governments try to keep inflation under control.

words.english_meaning: The most favorable price a buyer is willing to pay or a seller is willing to accept.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખરીદનાર ભરવા માટે અથવા વેચનાર સ્વીકારવા તૈયાર હોય તે સૌથી સારો ભાવ.
words.usage_note: Often abbreviated as 'OBO' (or best offer) in classified ads.
words.memory_tip: 'Best' = સૌથી સારો + 'offer' = ઑફર → best offer = સૌથી સારો/સસ્તો ભાવ.
examples: The listing says ₹10,000 or best offer.
She made her best offer, and they accepted.
What's your best offer for this car?
Best offers are often welcomed in second-hand markets.

words.english_meaning: When a store agrees to sell a product at the same price as a competitor.
words.gujarati_meaning: જ્યારે દુકાન સ્પર્ધક જેટલા ભાવે ઉત્પાદ વેચવા સહમત થાય.
words.usage_note: Many large retailers offer price-match guarantees to attract customers.
words.memory_tip: 'Price' = ભાવ + 'match' = સ્પર્ધક = price match = ભાવ મળ.
examples: The store will price match any competitor's offer.
She got a price match and saved ₹800.
Ask about price match guarantees before buying.
Their price match policy applies to online stores too.

words.english_meaning: The original listed price of a product before any discounts.
words.gujarati_meaning: ડિસ્કાઉન્ટ પહેલા ઉત્પાદ ઉપર લિસ્ટ કરેલ મૂળ ભાવ.
words.usage_note: The sticker price on a car is usually negotiable at dealerships.
words.memory_tip: 'Sticker' = ચોંટેલ ટૅગ + 'price' = ભાવ → sticker price = ટૅગ ઉપર ભાવ.
examples: The sticker price of the car was ₹8 lakh.
We negotiated below the sticker price.
Sticker prices are often higher than what you pay.
Never pay the sticker price without negotiating.

words.english_meaning: An arrangement with a bank to keep and manage your money.
words.gujarati_meaning: બૅન્ક સાથે પૈસા સુરક્ષિત રાખવા અને વ્યવસ્થાપિત કરવા માટેની વ્યવસ્થા.
words.usage_note: Types: savings account, current account, fixed deposit account.
words.memory_tip: 'Account' = 'ac' + 'count' = ગણ → account = ગણ ઠેલ (money counted and kept).
examples: She opened a savings account at the bank.
My account balance is very low this month.
Transfer the money to my account.
He has both a current and savings account.

words.english_meaning: Money placed into a bank account; also an advance payment to secure goods/services.
words.gujarati_meaning: બૅન્ક ખાતામાં મૂકેલ પૈસા; અથવા ચીજ/સેવા સુરક્ષિત કરવા અગ્રિમ ચૂકવણી.
words.usage_note: A security deposit is a refundable amount paid before renting.
examples: She deposited ₹5,000 in her account.
Pay a deposit to reserve the hall.
The deposit will be returned after the tenancy.
He made a cash deposit at the ATM.

words.english_meaning: Taking money out of a bank account.
words.gujarati_meaning: બૅન્ક ખાતામાંથી પૈસા ઉપાડવા.
words.usage_note: ATM withdrawals may be limited per day; bank withdrawals may need ID.
examples: I made a withdrawal of ₹2,000 from the ATM.
There's a daily withdrawal limit of ₹20,000.
She requested a withdrawal at the bank counter.
The withdrawal was processed instantly.

words.english_meaning: Money paid for the use of borrowed money, or earned on savings.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઉધાર પૈસા ઉપર ચૂકવાતી અથવા બચત ઉપર મળતી અધ-કચ.
words.usage_note: Simple interest vs. compound interest — compound grows faster.
examples: The bank pays 6% interest on savings.
He paid a lot of interest on his loan.
Interest rates are rising this year.
Compound interest grows faster than simple interest.

words.english_meaning: Money borrowed from a bank or person that must be repaid with interest.
words.gujarati_meaning: બૅન્ક અથવા વ્યક્તિ પાસેથી ઉધાર લીધેલ પૈسا, જ્યારે વ્યાજ સાથે ભરવા પડે.
words.usage_note: Types: personal loan, home loan, car loan, education loan.
examples: She took out a loan to buy a car.
The bank approved his home loan.
Loan repayment begins after six months.
He is struggling to pay back the loan.

words.english_meaning: A loan taken to buy property, with the property as security.
words.gujarati_meaning: મિલ્કત ખરીદવા માટે લોન, જ્યાં મિલ્કત ગિરવી/ગેરેન્ટી તરીકે રહે.
words.usage_note: If mortgage payments are missed, the bank can repossess the property.
examples: They took out a 20-year mortgage to buy their home.
The mortgage payment is ₹25,000 per month.
Rising mortgage rates affect homebuyers.
She finally paid off her mortgage.

words.english_meaning: A numerical rating that represents a person's creditworthiness based on financial history.
words.gujarati_meaning: આર્થિક ઇતિહાસ આધારે વ્યક્તિની ધિરાણ-પ્રાયોગ્યતા દર્શાવતો આંકડો.
words.usage_note: In India, CIBIL score (300–900) is widely used; 750+ is considered good.
words.memory_tip: 'Credit' = ઉધારી + 'score' = ગુણ → credit score = ઉધારી-ગુણ = ભરોસો!
examples: A good credit score helps you get loans easily.
Check your credit score before applying.
Paying bills on time improves your credit score.
His credit score dropped after missing a payment.

words.english_meaning: When you withdraw more money from your account than you have, creating a debt.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખાતામાં જેટલા પૈसा ન હોય તેના કરતા વધારે ઉપાડ, જે ઋણ સર્જે.
words.usage_note: Banks may charge fees or interest on overdraft amounts.
words.memory_tip: 'Over' = વધારે + 'draft' = ઉપાડ → overdraft = ખાતા કરતા વધારે ઉપાડ.
examples: He went into overdraft after paying his bills.
The bank charges ₹500 as an overdraft fee.
She arranged an overdraft facility with her bank.
Avoid overdraft to prevent extra charges.

words.english_meaning: A printed or digital record of all transactions in a bank account over a period.
words.gujarati_meaning: ચોક્કસ સમય દરમ્યાન બૅન્ક ખાતાના બધા વ્યવહારોનો છાપેલ/ડિજિટલ અહેવાલ.
words.usage_note: Bank statements are important for tax filings and financial record-keeping.
examples: Please send me my bank statement.
She checked her statement for errors.
Monthly statements are available online.
The statement shows all deposits and withdrawals.

words.english_meaning: A type of savings where money is deposited for a fixed period at a set interest rate.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક પ્રકારની બચત જ્યાં ચોક્કસ સમય માટે નક્કી વ્યાજ-દરે પૈસા જમા થાય.
words.usage_note: FDs offer higher interest than savings accounts but are not accessible before maturity without penalty.
words.memory_tip: 'Fixed' = નક્કી + 'deposit' = જમા → fixed deposit = ચોક્કસ સમય નક્કી જમા.
examples: She invested in a fixed deposit for 3 years.
The fixed deposit earns 7% interest.
He broke his FD early to pay for emergency.
Fixed deposits are a safe investment option.

words.english_meaning: An instance of buying, selling, or transferring money.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખરીદ, વેચ, અથવા પૈसा ટ્રાન્સફરની ઘટના.
words.usage_note: Each purchase, transfer, or payment is recorded as a transaction.
examples: The transaction was completed in seconds.
Check your transaction history online.
This transaction is pending approval.
Every ATM withdrawal is a transaction.

words.english_meaning: The amount of money available in a bank account.
words.gujarati_meaning: બૅન્ક ખાતામાં ઉપલબ્ધ પૈसाની રકમ.
words.usage_note: 'Balance' can also mean the remaining amount owed on a debt.
examples: My account balance is ₹12,000.
Check your balance before making a payment.
The low balance alert saved me from overdraft.
She maintained a minimum balance of ₹10,000.

words.english_meaning: An asset pledged as security for a loan, which can be seized if the loan is not repaid.
words.gujarati_meaning: લોન માટે ગિરવી મૂકેલ સ્થાવર-જંગમ, ન ભરાય તો ઝૂંટવાઈ શકે.
words.usage_note: Common collaterals include property, gold, or fixed deposits.
examples: He offered his house as collateral for the loan.
Banks require collateral for large loans.
Gold jewellery is commonly used as collateral.
If you default, the bank takes the collateral.

words.english_meaning: One of several payments made at regular intervals for a purchase or loan.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખરીદ અથવા લોન માટે નિયમિત અંતરે ભરાતી અનેક ચૂકવણીઓ પૈકી એક.
words.usage_note: 'EMI' (Equated Monthly Instalment) is the Indian term for monthly loan instalments.
examples: She paid for the laptop in 12 instalments.
The monthly instalment is ₹3,500.
Buy now, pay later with easy instalments.
Missing an instalment attracts a penalty.

words.english_meaning: Money added to your account; also the ability to borrow money from a bank.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખાતામાં ઉમેરાયેલ પૈसा; અથવા બૅન્ક પાસેથી ઉધાર લેવાની ક્ષમતા.
words.usage_note: In banking: credit = money in (positive). Debit = money out (negative).
examples: The refund was credited to my account.
She has a credit limit of ₹50,000 on her card.
His credit history is excellent.
Credit is useful but must be used wisely.

words.english_meaning: Money taken out of or charged to a bank account.
words.gujarati_meaning: બૅન્ક ખાતામાંથી ઉઠાવેલ અથવા ચાર્જ કરાયેલ પૈसा.
words.usage_note: A debit card uses your own money; a credit card uses borrowed money.
examples: The amount was debited from my account immediately.
She uses a debit card for everyday shopping.
Direct debits automatically pay bills.
Check debit entries in your statement monthly.

words.english_meaning: The percentage charged on a loan or paid on savings over a period.
words.gujarati_meaning: લોન ઉપર ચૂકવાતી અથવા બચત ઉપર મળતી ટકા-વ્યાજ-દ.
words.usage_note: RBI sets the benchmark interest rate in India, affecting all bank rates.
words.memory_tip: 'Interest' = વ્યાજ + 'rate' = દ → interest rate = વ્યાજ- દ.
examples: The interest rate on this loan is 12% per year.
Lower interest rates encourage borrowing.
The RBI raised the interest rate last month.
Compare interest rates before choosing a bank.

words.english_meaning: The system of money used in a country.
words.gujarati_meaning: દેશમાં ઉપયોગ થતી ચલણ-વ્યવસ્થા.
words.usage_note: India's currency is the Indian Rupee (INR); USA's is the US Dollar (USD).
examples: The currency of Japan is the yen.
She exchanged currency at the airport.
Foreign currency can be exchanged at banks.
Digital currency is growing in popularity.

words.english_meaning: The rate at which one currency is exchanged for another.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક ચલણ બીજા ચલણ સાથે બદલાવાનો ભાવ-દ.
words.usage_note: Exchange rates fluctuate daily based on economic factors.
examples: The exchange rate today is 83 rupees per dollar.
A favourable exchange rate helps travellers.
She monitored exchange rates before her trip.
Exchange rate changes affect import prices.

words.english_meaning: Physical money in the form of notes and coins.
words.gujarati_meaning: નોટ અને સિક્કા સ્વરૂપ ભૌtik ચૂકvidname.
words.usage_note: 'Cash in hand' means payment in physical money, often unreported.
examples: Do you accept cash or only cards?
She paid cash for the groceries.
He cashed a cheque at the bank.
Always carry some cash for emergencies.

words.english_meaning: A written order from a bank account holder to pay a specific amount to someone.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખાતાધારક દ્વારા ચોક્કસ રકમ ચૂkav વા બૅne ને ลed ituated nut ful ull karo nu likh लिखित.
words.usage_note: 'Cheque' is British spelling; 'check' is American. A bounced cheque means insufficient funds.
words.memory_tip: 'Cheque' = ચૅક → ભૂ-ling ene = ckek karo ke kem che balance!
examples: She wrote a cheque for the school fees.
The cheque bounced due to low balance.
Please issue a cheque in my name.
Cheques are being replaced by digital transfers.

words.english_meaning: Paying for goods or services electronically, using apps, cards, or online banking.
words.gujarati_meaning: એપ, કાર્ડ, અથવા ઑnline-banking દ્વારા ઇsb-electra-nic-riti-e ચૂkav.
words.usage_note: UPI (Unified Payments Interface) is India's popular digital payment system.
words.memory_tip: 'Digital' = ઇsb-net + 'payment' = ચૂk → digital payment = net ble ble chu.
examples: She made a digital payment using PhonePe.
Digital payments are faster and safer.
Most shops now accept digital payments.
UPI has made digital payments easy in India.

words.english_meaning: Unified Payments Interface — India's real-time digital payment system.
words.gujarati_meaning: Unified Payments Interface — ભarelyat nu real-time digital ચૂkav-system.
words.usage_note: UPI allows instant money transfer using a smartphone; e.g., Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm.
words.memory_tip: UPI = Unified (એક) + Payments (ચૂk) + Interface (system) = એક-system ble ble.
examples: She paid via UPI using her phone.
Share your UPI ID for the transfer.
UPI transactions are processed instantly.
UPI has revolutionized payments in India.

words.english_meaning: Personal Identification Number — a secret numeric code used to access bank accounts or cards.
words.gujarati_meaning: Personal Identification Number — bank account/card access ue secret numeric code.
words.usage_note: Never share your PIN with anyone, including bank employees.
words.memory_tip: PIN = Personal + Identification + Number = ful tama ri nal identification.
examples: Enter your PIN to complete the transaction.
She forgot her ATM PIN.
Change your PIN regularly for security.
Never share your PIN with anyone.

words.english_meaning: An electronic transfer of money from one bank account to another.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક bank account-ma-thi ble account-ma electronic riti-e paisa transfer karvu.
words.usage_note: NEFT and RTGS are India's bank wire transfer systems.
words.memory_tip: 'Wire' = ble net + 'transfer' = bo-dav → wire transfer = net thi paisa bodlav.
examples: He sent money via wire transfer.
International wire transfers may take 2–3 days.
Wire transfer fees vary by bank.
RTGS is used for large wire transfers.

words.english_meaning: A digital or virtual currency that uses cryptography for security.
words.gujarati_meaning: ble-cryptography-thi secured digital/virtual currency.
words.usage_note: Bitcoin and Ethereum are popular cryptocurrencies; highly volatile in value.
words.memory_tip: 'Crypto' = ble-secret + 'currency' = currency → crypto-currency = secret digital currency.
examples: He invested in cryptocurrency last year.
Bitcoin is the most popular cryptocurrency.
Cryptocurrency values can rise and fall sharply.
A crypto wallet stores your digital coins.

words.english_meaning: A payment method where you tap a card or phone on a reader without entering a PIN.
words.gujarati_meaning: card ya phone-ne reader ane ble tap kari, PIN vinana, ble chukavnu.
words.usage_note: Contactless payments use NFC (Near Field Communication) technology.
words.memory_tip: 'Contact-less' = ble sparsh vigna → contactless payment = sparsh na karo, paisa chukavo.
examples: She tapped her card for a contactless payment.
Contactless payments are fast and hygienic.
The contactless limit is ₹5,000 per transaction.
Most modern cards support contactless payment.

words.english_meaning: A small flat case for carrying cards, cash, and ID; also a digital app for storing money.
words.gujarati_meaning: card, cash ne ID ble rakhva-nu nano flat case; ya digital money store-karava-ni app.
words.usage_note: Digital wallets (Paytm, Google Pay) store money and cards virtually.
words.memory_tip: 'Wallet' = paisa nu ble ghar → wallet = wallet = paisa-nu ble ghar (house for money).
examples: She keeps her cards in a slim wallet.
His digital wallet has ₹2,000.
I left my wallet at home.
Digital wallets make payments convenient.

words.english_meaning: The exchange of one country's currency for another; also called forex.
words.gujarati_meaning: ble country-ni currency-ne ble-na country-ni currency-thi badlav; forex pan kahevay.
words.usage_note: Forex trading is the world's largest financial market by trading volume.
words.memory_tip: 'Foreign' = pardeshi + 'exchange' = ble bodlav → foreign exchange = ble desh-ni currency bodlav.
examples: She bought foreign exchange before her trip abroad.
The foreign exchange market operates 24/7.
Forex trading carries financial risks.
Banks and airports provide foreign exchange services.

words.english_meaning: Money sent to someone in another country, usually by a migrant worker to family back home.
words.gujarati_meaning: ble na-country-ni individual-thi ble country-ni family-ne paisa moklavy.
words.usage_note: India is one of the top recipients of remittances worldwide.
words.memory_tip: 'Remit' = ble moklav → remittance = ble na desh-e paisa moklav.
examples: He sends a remittance to his family in Gujarat every month.
India receives billions in remittances.
Remittance charges vary by service.
Western Union is a popular remittance service.

words.english_meaning: A payment arrangement where the total cost is divided into smaller regular payments.
words.gujarati_meaning: ble total cost-ne ble nana-nana regular payments-ma vadhu-ne chukavani vyavastha.
words.usage_note: Many banks offer no-cost EMI (equal monthly instalments) on credit card purchases.
words.memory_tip: 'Instalment' = ble tukde tukde + 'plan' = yojna → instalment plan = ble tukde-tukde chukavani yojna.
examples: She bought the fridge on an instalment plan.
The instalment plan is interest-free for 6 months.
Choose an instalment plan that fits your budget.
Many e-commerce sites offer instalment plans.

words.english_meaning: A reward or refund of a percentage of the amount spent, returned to the buyer.
words.gujarati_meaning: kharcha-ni rakami-na ble tikka paisa ble-khari-dnar-ne pacha apava-ni reward.
words.usage_note: Cashback is offered by credit cards, apps, and online stores as a reward.
words.memory_tip: 'Cash' = paisa + 'back' = pacha → cashback = ble kharcha-na paisa pacha!
examples: She earned 5% cashback on her credit card purchase.
The app gives ₹100 cashback on first order.
Cashback is credited within 7 working days.
Look for cashback offers while shopping online.

words.english_meaning: An automatic regular payment made from a bank account on a fixed date.
words.gujarati_meaning: ble nakkhi date-e bank account-ma-thi automatically niyamit payment karvu.
words.usage_note: Standing orders are used for rent, subscriptions, and regular fixed payments.
words.memory_tip: 'Standing' = nikhal padu + 'order' = hukam → standing order = ble auto-hukam.
examples: She set up a standing order to pay rent.
The standing order goes out on the 1st of each month.
Cancel the standing order if you no longer need it.
Standing orders ensure bills are paid on time.

words.english_meaning: Able to last a long time without breaking or wearing out.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઘણા સમય સ્‌ ​udhee toot ya vankhi utarya vina tikuvu ble.
words.usage_note: 'Durable goods' are long-lasting products like appliances and furniture.
examples: This bag is made from durable leather.
Durable products save money in the long run.
She chose the durable option for outdoor use.
The jacket is stylish and durable.

words.english_meaning: Truly what it is claimed to be; not fake or counterfeit.
words.gujarati_meaning: jo kehvay che te j sachi rite che; nakli ya duplicate nahi.
words.usage_note: 'Genuine article' means the real thing. Used often in quality assurance.
examples: This is a genuine leather handbag.
The certificate proves the painting is genuine.
She only buys genuine products.
Be careful of fake goods sold as genuine.

words.english_meaning: Made in imitation of something genuine, with intent to deceive.
words.gujarati_meaning: thaganat karvani niyat-thi asli vastunu nakli-blo-tiyar karelu.
words.usage_note: Selling counterfeit goods is illegal and can result in criminal charges.
words.memory_tip: 'Counter' = against + 'feit' = ble (Old French) → counterfeit = asli-ni-saamnu nakli.
examples: The market was full of counterfeit watches.
Police seized counterfeit currency notes.
Buying counterfeit goods supports illegal trade.
The bag was a counterfeit of a luxury brand.

words.english_meaning: A written guarantee from a manufacturer to repair or replace a defective product within a set time.
words.gujarati_meaning: nirmat-a taraf-thi lakhit hemti ke nakkhi samay-ma khami hou to saadhse ya badlavse.
words.usage_note: Warranty covers manufacturing defects; 'guarantee' is often used interchangeably.
words.memory_tip: 'Warrant' = ble adhikaar → warranty = ble saadhva-nu adhikaar.
examples: This TV comes with a 2-year warranty.
The laptop is still under warranty.
She claimed a warranty replacement for the faulty phone.
Always keep your warranty card safe.

words.english_meaning: Having a fault or flaw; not working properly.
words.gujarati_meaning: ble khami ya toot hoy; sari rite kam na kare.
words.usage_note: You are entitled to a refund or replacement for defective products.
words.memory_tip: 'De' = without + 'fect' = ble kari shaku → defective = ble kari shakva-nu nathi (flaw).
examples: The fan was defective and stopped working.
She returned the defective item for a refund.
A defective batch was recalled by the company.
Defective products damage a brand's reputation.

words.english_meaning: Completely new and unused.
words.gujarati_meaning: bilkul navu ane upyog na thayelu.
words.usage_note: 'Brand new' emphasises the product has never been used before.
words.memory_tip: 'Brand' = ble stamp + 'new' = navu → brand new = ble stamp karelu navu (fresh from factory).
examples: She bought a brand new laptop for college.
The car is brand new — never driven.
Brand new items come in original packaging.
I prefer buying brand new over second-hand.

words.english_meaning: Previously owned or used by someone else.
words.gujarati_meaning: pahela ble bija koi-ae upyog karelu ya ma-likhi hoy.
words.usage_note: Also called 'pre-owned' especially for cars. Thrift stores sell second-hand goods.
words.memory_tip: 'Second' = bijo + 'hand' = haath → second-hand = be-o no haath lagyu chhe.
examples: She bought a second-hand bicycle at low cost.
Second-hand books are much cheaper.
The second-hand market is growing online.
He sold his second-hand phone for ₹5,000.

words.english_meaning: Of superior quality and usually higher price; also an additional payment.
words.gujarati_meaning: uchhi quality ane saamanye ble mota bhav; ya ble vadhanu bhetru.
words.usage_note: Premium products justify higher prices with better quality or features.
examples: This is a premium brand of coffee.
She paid a premium for the limited edition watch.
Premium seats offer extra legroom on the flight.
Premium quality materials last longer.

words.english_meaning: Low-cost; also a plan for managing income and expenses.
words.gujarati_meaning: ble ble ochha kharch; ya aavak ane kharcha manage karava-nu ble aayojan.
words.usage_note: 'On a budget' means managing with limited money.
words.memory_tip: 'Budget' = ble ble ankhe-bal ble (purse in Old French) → budget = ble purse manage.
examples: She found a budget hotel for the trip.
We planned a holiday on a tight budget.
Budget smartphones are great for students.
He set a monthly budget for shopping.

words.english_meaning: Not harmful to the environment; designed to have a minimal ecological impact.
words.gujarati_meaning: paryavaran-ne nukshan-karak na hoy; ble-nana paryavaran prabhav-thi ble-banavel.
words.usage_note: Look for eco-friendly certifications like 'recyclable' or 'biodegradable' on packaging.
examples: She prefers eco-friendly cleaning products.
The brand uses eco-friendly packaging.
Eco-friendly cars produce fewer emissions.
Buying eco-friendly products helps the planet.

words.english_meaning: Easily broken, damaged, or destroyed.
words.gujarati_meaning: saheli-thi tootay, nuksan-paame, ya nasht thaay.
words.usage_note: Fragile stickers are placed on packages to warn handlers to be careful.
examples: This vase is very fragile — handle with care.
The parcel was marked 'Fragile'.
Fragile items should be wrapped in bubble wrap.
She carefully packed the fragile glassware.

words.english_meaning: Able to be used in many different ways or for many different purposes.
words.gujarati_meaning: ble ghano upyogi — ble ghani rite ya ghani jagya upayog thay.
words.usage_note: Versatile products offer more value as they serve multiple functions.
words.memory_tip: 'Verse' = ble pharvatu → versatile = ble ghani-rite pharvatu (multi-use).
examples: This knife is versatile — it cuts vegetables and meat.
She bought a versatile dress for multiple occasions.
A versatile bag works for work and travel.
Versatile tools are popular in hardware stores.

words.english_meaning: Closely and neatly packed together; small and practical.
words.gujarati_meaning: ble nankanku ane vyavhari; ghanamaan khodayelu.
words.usage_note: Compact products are preferred for travel or small living spaces.
words.memory_tip: 'Com' + 'pact' = sathe + dabayelu → compact = ble dabayu jema ghanu smaay.
examples: She chose a compact camera for her travels.
The compact car is easy to park in the city.
The apartment has a compact but efficient kitchen.
Compact laptops are popular among students.

words.english_meaning: Unable to be penetrated or damaged by water.
words.gujarati_meaning: jema pani ble ghusi na shake ya nuksan na kare.
words.usage_note: Waterproof = fully protected from water. Water-resistant = partially protected.
words.memory_tip: 'Water' = pani + 'proof' = sabit → waterproof = pani thi sabit/surakhsit.
examples: She bought a waterproof jacket for the monsoon.
This phone is waterproof up to 30 metres.
Waterproof boots are essential for hiking.
The tent is waterproof and lightweight.

words.english_meaning: Made by hand rather than by machine; often implying higher quality or craftsmanship.
words.gujarati_meaning: machine ne badle haath-thi banavelhu; ghani vaakht uchhi quality ya kaarigiri-nu suchak.
words.usage_note: Handmade products are often more expensive due to the craftsmanship involved.
examples: She sells handmade jewellery at the craft fair.
The handmade pottery was unique and beautiful.
Handmade chocolates make a perfect gift.
Handmade products often cost more than factory-made.

words.english_meaning: A product produced in a small, specific quantity, often making it more exclusive and valuable.
words.gujarati_meaning: ble maryadit sankhyama banavelhu ble utpad, ble ghani vaakht ble exclusive ane kimti banave.
words.usage_note: Limited edition products create urgency and exclusivity among buyers.
words.memory_tip: 'Limited' = maryadit + 'edition' = aavrutti → limited edition = maryadit avrutti (sirf kuch j!).
examples: She bought a limited edition perfume.
The limited edition sneakers sold out in minutes.
Collectors pay high prices for limited edition items.
The brand released a limited edition for Diwali.

mini_dialogues.title: Bargaining at a Market
mini_dialogues.situation: Priya is shopping at a local street market and wants to buy a kurta.

dialogue.speaker: Priya
dialogue.english: How much is this kurta?
dialogue.gujarati: આ કુર્તાની કિંમત કેટલી છે?

dialogue.speaker: Vendor
dialogue.english: The price tag says 800 rupees, madam.
dialogue.gujarati: ભaval-chitthi 800 rupiya batave chhe, madam.

dialogue.speaker: Priya
dialogue.english: That seems overpriced. Can you give me a discount?
dialogue.gujarati: Ae ghanu mahnghu lagay chhe. Shya tame discount aapi shako?

dialogue.speaker: Vendor
dialogue.english: Okay, best offer — 650 rupees. It is genuine cotton, very durable.
dialogue.gujarati: Sari, best offer — 650 rupiya. Ae asli cotton chhe, khub tikau.

dialogue.speaker: Priya
dialogue.english: I will take it for 600 rupees. That is my final offer.
dialogue.gujarati: Hu 600 rupiya-ma lais. Ae meri final offer chhe.

dialogue.speaker: Vendor
dialogue.english: Deal! Here is your receipt.
dialogue.gujarati: Deal! Lo thari receipt.

mini_dialogues.title: Returning a Defective Product
mini_dialogues.situation: Raj bought a fan from a department store but it stopped working the next day.

dialogue.speaker: Raj
dialogue.english: I bought this fan yesterday and it is already defective.
dialogue.gujarati: Hu aa fan gaat-kal khadyo hto, ane ae pahela j kharab thai gayu.

dialogue.speaker: Store Manager
dialogue.english: I am sorry to hear that. Do you have the receipt?
dialogue.gujarati: Khed chhe ae janine. Thari paase receipt chhe?

dialogue.speaker: Raj
dialogue.english: Yes, here it is. I would like a full refund or an exchange.
dialogue.gujarati: Haa, lo ae. Mane full refund ya exchange joiye.

dialogue.speaker: Store Manager
dialogue.english: Since it is under warranty, we can exchange it immediately.
dialogue.gujarati: Chuky ae warranty-ma chhe, ame tatkal exchange kari shakiye.

dialogue.speaker: Raj
dialogue.english: Great. Can I also get a new receipt for the exchanged item?
dialogue.gujarati: Saaru. Ane exchange karela item ni navi receipt pan mali shake?

dialogue.speaker: Store Manager
dialogue.english: Of course. Here is your brand new fan and a new receipt.
dialogue.gujarati: Bilkul. Lo thamaro brand new fan ane navi receipt.

mini_dialogues.title: Opening a Bank Account
mini_dialogues.situation: Meena visits a bank to open her first savings account.

dialogue.speaker: Meena
dialogue.english: I would like to open a savings account, please.
dialogue.gujarati: Mane savings account kholvu chhe, please.

dialogue.speaker: Bank Officer
dialogue.english: Sure. You will need to make an initial deposit of 1000 rupees.
dialogue.gujarati: Bilkul. Tamne shuruat-ma 1000 rupiya deposit karva padse.

dialogue.speaker: Meena
dialogue.english: What is the interest rate on the savings account?
dialogue.gujarati: Savings account par interest rate ketlo chhe?

dialogue.speaker: Bank Officer
dialogue.english: It is 3.5 percent per year. You will receive a monthly statement by email.
dialogue.gujarati: Ae varshe 3.5% chhe. Tamne email par monthly statement malse.

dialogue.speaker: Meena
dialogue.english: Can I also get a debit card?
dialogue.gujarati: Shu mane debit card pan mali shake?

dialogue.speaker: Bank Officer
dialogue.english: Yes, your debit card and account balance can be checked anytime via our app.
dialogue.gujarati: Haa, thamari debit card ane account balance game tyare aapni app thi janchay.

mini_dialogues.title: Shopping for a Laptop Online
mini_dialogues.situation: Karan is buying a laptop on an e-commerce website and comparing payment options.

dialogue.speaker: Karan
dialogue.english: Hi, I see the sticker price is 65000 rupees but I have a coupon code.
dialogue.gujarati: Hi, Hu jou chhu ke sticker price 65000 rupiya chhe pan mara paas coupon code chhe.

dialogue.speaker: Support Agent
dialogue.english: Great! Enter the coupon at checkout for a 10 percent discount.
dialogue.gujarati: Saaru! Tame checkout vakhte coupon enter karo ane 10% discount malse.

dialogue.speaker: Karan
dialogue.english: Is there a cashback offer too?
dialogue.gujarati: Shu cashback offer pan chhe?

dialogue.speaker: Support Agent
dialogue.english: Yes, pay via UPI and earn 5 percent cashback — credited within 7 days.
dialogue.gujarati: Haa, UPI thi chukavsho to 5% cashback malse — 7 din-ma credit thashe.

dialogue.speaker: Karan
dialogue.english: Can I also choose an instalment plan?
dialogue.gujarati: Shu hu instalment plan pan pasand kari sakhu?

dialogue.speaker: Support Agent
dialogue.english: Yes, a no-cost instalment plan is available for 6 months via your credit card.
dialogue.gujarati: Haa, thamara credit card thi 6 mahine no-cost instalment plan uplabdh chhe.

mini_dialogues.title: At a Currency Exchange Counter
mini_dialogues.situation: Nita is at the airport exchanging Indian Rupees to US Dollars before her trip abroad.

dialogue.speaker: Nita
dialogue.english: I need to exchange some Indian Rupees to US Dollars.
dialogue.gujarati: Mane kuch Indian Rupees ne US Dollars-ma exchange karva chhe.

dialogue.speaker: Exchange Officer
dialogue.english: Today's exchange rate is 83 rupees per dollar.
dialogue.gujarati: Aaj-ni exchange rate 83 rupiya per dollar chhe.

dialogue.speaker: Nita
dialogue.english: I would like to exchange 83000 rupees — that should give me 1000 dollars.
dialogue.gujarati: Mne 83000 rupiya exchange karva chhe — ae 1000 dollar apashe.

dialogue.speaker: Exchange Officer
dialogue.english: Correct. Will you be paying in cash or via wire transfer?
dialogue.gujarati: Sahi chhe. Tame cash-ma chukavsho ke wire transfer thi?

dialogue.speaker: Nita
dialogue.english: Cash please. And do you accept contactless payment?
dialogue.gujarati: Cash please. Ane tame contactless payment sweekar karo chho?

dialogue.speaker: Exchange Officer
dialogue.english: Yes we do. Here is your foreign exchange and a receipt.
dialogue.gujarati: Haa karie. Lo thamari foreign exchange ane receipt.

questions.question: What does 'Bargain' mean in Gujarati?
questions.explanation: Bargain = ઓChhi kimt-e kharidayelu (something bought cheap or price negotiated).

questions.question: Bank account-ma-thi paisa upadvu = ?
Which word is a synonym of 'Genuine'?
questions.explanation: Genuine = Authentic = asli/original. Counterfeit is the antonym.

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'Wholesale'?
questions.explanation: Wholesale = bulk selling at low price. Retail = selling to individual consumers.

questions.question: She used a ________ code to get 15% off her purchase online.
questions.explanation: A coupon (or promo code) gives a discount on purchases.

questions.question: A numerical rating that represents a person's creditworthiness is called:
questions.explanation: Credit score (CIBIL score in India) measures how trustworthy a borrower is.

questions.question: What does 'Mortgage' mean?
options: milkat kharidva-ni loan jema milkat girvi rahe
questions.answer: milkat kharidva-ni loan jema milkat girvi rahe
questions.explanation: Mortgage = property loan where the property is held as security.

questions.question: The television comes with a 2-year ________ against manufacturing defects.
