words.usage_note: Hailstones can be as large as golf balls or bigger; cause millions in crop damage annually.
examples: A hailstorm destroyed most of the wheat crop in minutes.
Large hailstones shattered car windscreens across the city.
Farmers lost their entire harvest to a sudden hailstorm.
Hailstorm warnings are issued by meteorological departments in spring.

mini_dialogues.title: Before the Storm
mini_dialogues.situation: Two colleagues discuss an approaching storm and decide whether to cancel their outdoor plans.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Have you checked the forecast? There's a storm warning for tonight.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, the barometric pressure has been dropping all afternoon. That usually means heavy rain.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The sky is already overcast and I can hear distant thunder. Should we cancel the picnic?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Definitely. The weather app says there could even be a tornado warning in some areas.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Better safe than sorry. Let's reschedule for next weekend — hopefully we'll get a breezy, sunny day.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Agreed. I'll send a message to everyone now before the downpour starts.

mini_dialogues.title: Talking About Seasons and Climate
mini_dialogues.situation: A teacher explains seasonal weather changes to curious students.

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Can anyone tell me what happens during the summer solstice?

turns.speaker: Student
turns.text: It's the longest day of the year, right? When the sun is at its furthest point north.

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Excellent! And what about the equinox — how is that different?

turns.speaker: Student
turns.text: On the equinox, day and night are equal in length. It happens twice a year.

turns.speaker: Teacher
turns.text: Perfect. Now, why do deciduous trees lose their leaves in autumn?

turns.speaker: Student
turns.text: Because the autumnal season brings cooler temperatures and less light, so the trees become dormant to survive.

mini_dialogues.title: A Walk Through the Wetlands
mini_dialogues.situation: Two nature enthusiasts explore a wetland reserve and discuss its ecological importance.

turns.speaker: Riya
turns.text: This wetland is incredible! I had no idea so many species of birds migrate here every winter.

turns.speaker: Dev
turns.text: Yes, flamingos especially love the shallow lagoon over there. It's a classic example of migration.

turns.speaker: Riya
turns.text: And look at those mangrove roots along the estuary. They look like they're walking on water!

turns.speaker: Dev
turns.text: Mangroves are amazing. They protect the coast and support incredible biodiversity.

turns.speaker: Riya
turns.text: It's a shame that habitat loss is threatening places like this.

turns.speaker: Dev
turns.text: Exactly. Deforestation and pollution are driving so many ecosystems to the brink. Conservation is urgent.

mini_dialogues.title: After the Earthquake
mini_dialogues.situation: Two survivors discuss what happened after a major earthquake struck their city.

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: That earthquake last night was terrifying. Do you know where the epicentre was?

turns.speaker: Arjun
turns.text: The news said it was about 40 kilometres from the city. We felt strong tremors here, but the damage was worse closer to the epicentre.

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: I heard there were several aftershocks early this morning too.

turns.speaker: Arjun
turns.text: Yes, seismic activity in this region has been increasing. Scientists have been monitoring it for months.

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: At least there was a storm warning system that alerted people in coastal areas about the tsunami risk.

turns.speaker: Arjun
turns.text: Early warnings save lives. We need stronger earthquake-resistant buildings and better disaster preparedness.

mini_dialogues.title: The Climate Change Debate
mini_dialogues.situation: Two friends discuss environmental problems and what can be done about them.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Did you see the news? Wildfires are burning across three states and drought conditions are spreading fast.

turns.speaker: Karan
turns.text: Climate change is making extreme weather events like these far more frequent. The heatwave last month was record-breaking.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: And the glaciers are retreating rapidly. Once they are gone, millions of people lose a vital water source.

turns.speaker: Karan
turns.text: We need large-scale carbon sequestration and a rapid switch to renewable energy. Our carbon footprint as a society is far too high.

turns.speaker: Priya
turns.text: Desertification is also accelerating in arid regions — fertile land turning to desert because of overuse and drought.

turns.speaker: Karan
turns.text: Sustainability has to become the foundation of every policy decision. Otherwise the damage will be irreversible.

questions.question: What does 'Drizzle' mean in Gujarati?
ભારે બરફ અને જોરદાર પવન સાથે આવતું ભીષણ હિમ-તોફાન — આ Gujarati meaning ક્યા word ની છે?
Which word is the best synonym for 'Gale'?
What is the antonym of 'Humid'?
Farmers in India eagerly await the ________ season every year for their crops.
Which definition best describes 'Drought'?
options: A) A sudden and heavy fall of rain lasting one hour
B) A prolonged period of abnormally low rainfall leading to water shortage
C) The thinning of the ozone layer due to pollution
D) A violent, rotating column of air extending from a storm cloud

questions.question: What does 'Glacier' mean in Gujarati?
options: A) ઊભા ખડકો વચ્ચેની ઊંડી ખાડી
B) ઘણા વર્ષો સુધી જામેલ, ધીમે ધીમે ખસતો વિશાળ બરફ-ભૂ
C) નદી-સમુદ્ર મળ્યા ત્યાં ત્રિકોણ ભૂ-રચના

questions.question: ઋતુ-ક્રમ અનુસાર પ્રાણી/પક્ષી ખોરાક અથવા પ્રજનન માટે દૂર પ્રવાસ — આ meaning ક્યા word ની છે?
__________ in the Amazon rainforest is threatening thousands of species with extinction.
Which word is the best synonym for 'Biodiversity'?
Which option is the antonym of 'Aftershock' in earthquake terminology?
What is a 'Cyclone'?
options: A) A thin layer of ice crystals that forms on cold surfaces overnight
B) The point on the Earth's surface directly above the focus of an earthquake
C) A large, destructive system of winds rotating around a centre of low pressure over the ocean
D) The gradual wearing away of land by wind or water

questions.question: What does 'Sustainability' mean in Gujarati?
options: A) પ્રાકૃ-ઉ (environment) ઉ-ઉ (resources) ઘ-ઉ (reduce) — environmental damage
B) વર્તમાન જરૂ-ઉ (needs) ભ-ઉ (future) ક્ષ-ઉ (capacity) ઘ-ઉ (without reducing) — sustainability
C) CO₂ ઉ-ઉ (long-term store) — carbon capture
D) ઉ-ઉ (bacteria) ઉ-ઉ (naturally break down) — decompose

questions.question: A severe ________ struck northern India last June, with temperatures exceeding 47 degrees Celsius for over a week.
Which statement correctly describes the 'Greenhouse effect'?
options: A) The process by which green plants use sunlight to produce food from CO2 and water
B) The warming of the Earth caused by gases in the atmosphere trapping heat from the sun
C) The large-scale clearing of forests for agriculture and construction
D) A close, long-term interaction between two different species for mutual benefit

words.english_meaning: The main sequence of events that make up the story of a film, play, or book.
words.gujarati_meaning: ફિલ્મ, નાટક કે પુસ્તકની વાર્તાનો મુખ્ય ઘટનાક્રમ અથવા કથાનક.
words.usage_note: Use 'plot' for the structure of a story, not the message or theme.
words.memory_tip: 'plot' = પ્લોટ → વાર્તાનો નકશો, જમીનના પ્લોટ જેવો ગોઠવાયેલો.
examples: The plot of the movie kept me guessing until the very end.
I lost track of the plot because there were too many characters.
Critics praised the clever plot of the new thriller.
Without a strong plot, even great acting feels empty.

words.english_meaning: An exciting and tense ending to an episode that leaves the outcome uncertain.
words.gujarati_meaning: એપિસોડનો એવો રોમાંચક અંત જે પરિણામ અધૂરું છોડી દે અને જિજ્ઞાસા જગાવે.
words.usage_note: Common in TV series finales to make viewers wait for the next season.
words.memory_tip: 'cliff + hanger' = ભેખડ પર લટકવું → અંત અધૂરો, શ્વાસ રોકાય તેવો.
examples: The season ended on a cliffhanger that left fans furious.
I hate a cliffhanger when the next episode is a year away.
The writer added a cliffhanger to boost the show's ratings.
Every chapter closed with a cliffhanger, so I couldn't stop reading.

words.english_meaning: To watch many episodes of a TV series in one sitting.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક જ બેઠકમાં કોઈ સિરિઝના ઘણા બધા એપિસોડ સતત જોવા.
words.usage_note: A modern term linked to streaming platforms like Netflix.
words.memory_tip: 'binge' = વધુ પડતું કરવું → binge-watch = એકસાથે ઘણું જોવું.
examples: We binge-watched the whole series over the weekend.
She binge-watches comedy shows whenever she feels stressed.
Don't binge-watch all night; you have work tomorrow.
Streaming services make it easy to binge-watch entire seasons.

words.english_meaning: A category of artistic work marked by a particular style, form, or content.
words.gujarati_meaning: કળાકૃતિની એક ખાસ શૈલી, સ્વરૂપ કે વિષય પ્રમાણેની શ્રેણી, જેમ કે કોમેડી કે હોરર.
words.usage_note: Used for film, music, and literature classifications.
examples: Horror is my least favourite film genre.
The director is known for mixing several genres in one film.
Which music genre do you listen to the most?
This novel doesn't fit neatly into any single genre.

words.english_meaning: A film or book that continues the story of an earlier one.
words.gujarati_meaning: અગાઉની ફિલ્મ કે પુસ્તકની વાર્તાને આગળ વધારતી નવી કૃતિ.
words.usage_note: Opposite of 'prequel', which tells an earlier part of the story.
words.memory_tip: 'sequ' = follow → sequel = જે પાછળ આવે, આગળની કડી.
examples: The sequel was even more successful than the first film.
Fans waited three years for the sequel to be released.
Most sequels fail to match the magic of the original.
She is writing a sequel to her bestselling novel.

words.english_meaning: Praised highly by professional critics for its quality.
words.gujarati_meaning: જેને વ્યાવસાયિક સમીક્ષકોએ તેની ગુણવત્તા માટે ખૂબ વખાણ્યું હોય.
words.usage_note: Critical acclaim does not always mean commercial success.
words.memory_tip: 'acclaim' = જાહેરમાં વખાણ → critically acclaimed = સમીક્ષકો દ્વારા વખણાયેલું.
examples: Her critically acclaimed film won three major awards.
The novel was critically acclaimed but sold very few copies.
He gave a critically acclaimed performance as the lead actor.
Despite being critically acclaimed, the show was cancelled early.

words.english_meaning: Information about the ending or plot that ruins the surprise.
words.gujarati_meaning: વાર્તાના અંત કે મહત્વના વળાંકની એવી માહિતી જે મજા બગાડી નાખે.
words.usage_note: Often introduced with the warning phrase 'spoiler alert'.
examples: Please don't share any spoilers; I haven't watched it yet.
He posted a major spoiler in the group chat.
Spoiler alert: the hero does not survive.
The trailer accidentally revealed a big spoiler.

words.english_meaning: A pleasing sequence of musical notes forming a tune.
words.gujarati_meaning: સંગીતના સૂરોની એવી મધુર ગોઠવણી જે એક ધૂન બનાવે.
words.usage_note: Refers to the main tune you can hum, not the harmony.
words.memory_tip: 'melody' = મેલડી → મધુર ધૂન, મેળ ખાતા સૂર.
examples: The song has a melody that stays in your head all day.
She hummed a soft melody while cooking.
The film's haunting melody made the scene unforgettable.
Children quickly learn a simple melody by repetition.

words.english_meaning: To perform or create something without preparation, on the spot.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ પૂર્વ તૈયારી વગર, તે જ ક્ષણે કંઈક રચીને રજૂ કરવું.
words.usage_note: Common in jazz, theatre, and comedy performances.
words.memory_tip: 'im + provise' = pro (પહેલેથી) નહીં → તૈયારી વગર કરવું.
examples: The jazz musician loves to improvise during live shows.
When she forgot her lines, she had to improvise.
Great actors can improvise a whole scene convincingly.
We had no script, so we just improvised the dialogue.

words.english_meaning: An extra performance given because the audience demands more.
words.gujarati_meaning: પ્રેક્ષકોની માગણીથી કલાકાર દ્વારા આપવામાં આવતી વધારાની રજૂઆત.
words.usage_note: The audience often shouts 'Encore!' to ask for more.
examples: The crowd cheered loudly, demanding an encore.
The band played two songs as an encore.
After a stunning encore, the singer finally left the stage.
There was no encore because the show ran late.

words.english_meaning: The art of designing the sequence of steps and movements in a dance.
words.gujarati_meaning: નૃત્યમાં પગલાં અને હલનચલનનો ક્રમ ગોઠવવાની કળા.
words.usage_note: The person who creates it is called a choreographer.
examples: The choreography in the final scene was breathtaking.
She spent months perfecting the choreography for the show.
Good choreography can make an average song memorable.
The dancers struggled with the complex choreography at first.

words.english_meaning: The words of a song.
words.gujarati_meaning: ગીતના શબ્દો અથવા બોલ.
words.usage_note: Usually used in plural form when talking about a song's words.
examples: The lyrics of this song are deeply emotional.
I can't remember the lyrics to the second verse.
He writes both the music and the lyrics himself.
The lyrics tell a story about lost love.

words.english_meaning: A practice session held to prepare for a public performance.
words.gujarati_meaning: જાહેર રજૂઆત માટેની તૈયારી રૂપે કરવામાં આવતી પ્રેક્ટિસ.
words.usage_note: A 'dress rehearsal' is a full practice with costumes.
words.memory_tip: 'rehearse' = ફરી ફરી પ્રેક્ટિસ → rehearsal = તૈયારીની પ્રેક્ટિસ.
examples: The final rehearsal went smoothly before opening night.
All actors must attend tomorrow's rehearsal.
During the dress rehearsal, the lights failed twice.
Hours of rehearsal made the performance flawless.

words.english_meaning: A person with outstanding skill in a fine art, especially music.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ કળામાં, ખાસ કરીને સંગીતમાં, અસાધારણ કૌશલ્ય ધરાવતી વ્યક્તિ.
words.usage_note: Often used for musicians who have rare technical mastery.
examples: The young pianist is already a virtuoso.
His virtuoso performance left the audience speechless.
Only a true virtuoso can play this difficult piece.
She trained for years to become a violin virtuoso.

words.english_meaning: Fiction written to fit a specific category such as mystery or romance.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ ખાસ શ્રેણી — જેમ કે રહસ્ય કે પ્રેમકથા — પ્રમાણે લખાયેલી કાલ્પનિક વાર્તા.
words.usage_note: Often contrasted with 'literary fiction', which focuses on style.
examples: He enjoys genre fiction like thrillers and science fiction.
Genre fiction often sells far more than literary novels.
Many readers move from genre fiction to the classics over time.
Romance is one of the most popular forms of genre fiction.

words.english_meaning: The main character around whom the story revolves.
words.gujarati_meaning: વાર્તાનું મુખ્ય પાત્ર, જેની આસપાસ આખી કથા ફરે છે.
words.usage_note: Opposite of 'antagonist', who opposes the main character.
examples: The protagonist faces a difficult moral choice.
Readers quickly sympathised with the young protagonist.
The story is told from the protagonist's point of view.
An unlikeable protagonist can still make a great novel.

words.english_meaning: A book so exciting that you can't stop reading it.
words.gujarati_meaning: એવું પુસ્તક જે એટલું રસપ્રદ હોય કે વાંચવાનું બંધ ન કરી શકાય.
words.usage_note: An informal compliment for fast-paced, exciting books.
words.memory_tip: 'page + turner' = પાનાં ફેરવતા રહો → રસપ્રદ પુસ્તક.
examples: Her latest mystery is a real page-turner.
I finished the page-turner in a single night.
Critics called the thriller an unputdownable page-turner.
If you want a page-turner, try this crime novel.

words.english_meaning: A spoken or written account of connected events; a story.
words.gujarati_meaning: જોડાયેલી ઘટનાઓનું મૌખિક કે લેખિત વર્ણન, એટલે કે કથા.
words.usage_note: Also used for the way events are presented or framed.
examples: The novel uses a first-person narrative throughout.
Her compelling narrative held the readers' attention.
The film's narrative jumps between past and present.
Politicians often try to control the public narrative.

words.english_meaning: A book in which a person writes about their own life experiences.
words.gujarati_meaning: પુસ્તક જેમાં લેખક પોતાના જીવનના અનુભવો વિશે લખે છે, એટલે કે સંસ્મરણ.
words.usage_note: A memoir focuses on selected memories, unlike a full autobiography.
examples: Her memoir describes her childhood in a small village.
He spent two years writing his memoir.
The actor's memoir became an instant bestseller.
A good memoir feels honest and deeply personal.

words.english_meaning: To look through books or items in a relaxed, unhurried way.
words.gujarati_meaning: પુસ્તકો કે વસ્તુઓને નિરાંતે, કોઈ ઉતાવળ વગર જોવી.
words.usage_note: Used for both physical bookshops and online searching.
examples: I love to browse old bookshops on weekends.
She browsed the shelves looking for a good novel.
Feel free to browse before you decide to buy.
He browsed through the magazine while waiting.

words.english_meaning: A collection of writings, such as poems or stories, in one book.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક જ પુસ્તકમાં ભેગાં કરેલાં લખાણો — જેમ કે કવિતાઓ કે વાર્તાઓ — નો સંગ્રહ.
words.usage_note: Often groups works by theme, period, or author.
examples: The anthology features poems from twenty countries.
She was thrilled to have a story in the anthology.
We studied a famous anthology of war poetry.
The editor spent a year compiling the anthology.

words.english_meaning: The craft of making fabric or garments by looping yarn with needles.
words.gujarati_meaning: સોય અને ઊનની મદદથી કાપડ કે કપડાં ગૂંથવાની કળા.
words.usage_note: The tools used are called knitting needles.
examples: She took up knitting during the long winter.
My grandmother taught me knitting as a child.
He bought new needles for his knitting project.
Knitting helps her relax after a busy day.

words.english_meaning: The craft of making pots and other objects from clay.
words.gujarati_meaning: માટીમાંથી વાસણો અને બીજી વસ્તુઓ બનાવવાની કળા, એટલે કે કુંભારકામ.
words.usage_note: Objects are shaped on a 'pottery wheel' and then fired.
examples: She joined a pottery class to learn the wheel.
Handmade pottery makes a lovely gift.
The museum displays ancient pottery from the region.
He shaped a beautiful bowl during his pottery lesson.

words.english_meaning: Having or showing great enthusiasm for an activity or interest.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ પ્રવૃત્તિ કે રુચિ માટે ખૂબ જ ઉત્સાહ ધરાવતું હોવું.
words.usage_note: Frequently paired with hobbies, as in 'an avid gardener'.
words.memory_tip: 'avid' = એવિડ → ઉત્સાહી, કોઈ શોખનો જબરો રસિયો.
examples: He is an avid collector of old coins.
As an avid reader, she finishes a book every week.
My uncle is an avid gardener.
Avid fans queued overnight for the tickets.

words.english_meaning: To make small adjustments to something, often just for fun.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ વસ્તુમાં, ઘણીવાર શોખ ખાતર, નાનાં નાનાં ફેરફાર કર્યા કરવા.
words.usage_note: Usually followed by 'with', as in 'tinker with the engine'.
examples: He loves to tinker with old radios in his free time.
She spent the afternoon tinkering with her bicycle.
Don't tinker with the settings unless you know how.
My father is always tinkering around in the garage.

words.english_meaning: The art of producing beautiful, decorative handwriting.
words.gujarati_meaning: સુંદર અને સુશોભિત હસ્તાક્ષર બનાવવાની કળા.
words.usage_note: Practised with special pens or brushes for elegant strokes.
examples: She studies calligraphy as a relaxing hobby.
The wedding invitations were written in beautiful calligraphy.
He bought a special pen for practising calligraphy.
Japanese calligraphy requires years of patient practice.

words.english_meaning: The activity of growing and caring for plants in a garden.
words.gujarati_meaning: બગીચામાં છોડ ઉગાડવાની અને તેમની સંભાળ રાખવાની પ્રવૃત્તિ, એટલે કે બાગકામ.
words.usage_note: A popular relaxing hobby for people of all ages.
examples: Gardening keeps her active and calm.
He spends every Sunday morning gardening.
Organic gardening avoids chemical fertilisers.
They bought new tools for their gardening hobby.

words.english_meaning: To take part in an activity casually, without being serious about it.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ પ્રવૃત્તિમાં ગંભીરતા વગર, માત્ર શોખ ખાતર થોડું થોડું ભાગ લેવો.
words.usage_note: Usually followed by 'in', as in 'dabble in painting'.
examples: She dabbles in painting whenever she has free time.
He dabbled in photography before becoming a writer.
I only dabble in cooking; I'm no expert.
Many people dabble in music as a hobby.

words.english_meaning: A carefully planned method for achieving a goal, especially in a game.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ ધ્યેય હાંસલ કરવા માટેની, ખાસ કરીને રમતમાં, કાળજીપૂર્વક ઘડેલી યોજના.
words.usage_note: A 'strategy game' relies on planning rather than luck.
examples: Chess is a game that rewards careful strategy.
Their winning strategy was to control the centre.
He devised a clever strategy to beat his opponent.
Without a good strategy, the team kept losing.

words.english_meaning: A person who competes against you in a game or contest.
words.gujarati_meaning: રમત કે સ્પર્ધામાં તમારી સામે રમતી અથવા હરીફાઈ કરતી વ્યક્તિ.
words.usage_note: Used in sports, games, debates, and contests.
examples: She studied her opponent's moves carefully.
He proved to be a tough opponent in the final.
Respect your opponent even when you win.
The champion defeated every opponent with ease.

words.english_meaning: An amount of money risked on the outcome of an uncertain event.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ અનિશ્ચિત પરિણામ પર લગાવેલી શરત અથવા જોખમમાં મુકાયેલી રકમ.
words.usage_note: Can be used as both a noun and a verb meaning 'to bet'.
examples: They placed a small wager on the cricket match.
He lost the wager and had to pay up.
I'd wager that she finishes first.
A friendly wager made the game more exciting.

words.english_meaning: A competition with many players or teams over several rounds.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઘણા ખેલાડીઓ કે ટીમો વચ્ચે અનેક રાઉન્ડમાં યોજાતી સ્પર્ધા.
words.usage_note: Often organised as a knockout or league format.
examples: Our school won the inter-city chess tournament.
The tournament attracted players from ten countries.
He was knocked out in the first round of the tournament.
Tickets for the final tournament sold out quickly.

words.english_meaning: To lose or give up a right or game, often as a penalty.
words.gujarati_meaning: દંડ રૂપે કોઈ હક કે રમત ગુમાવી દેવી અથવા જતી કરવી.
words.usage_note: A team that does not show up may forfeit the match.
words.memory_tip: 'forfeit' = ફોર્ફિટ → દંડ રૂપે હારી જવું/જતું કરવું.
examples: The team had to forfeit the match for arriving late.
If you break the rules, you forfeit your turn.
He forfeited his deposit by cancelling the booking.
Rather than cheat, she chose to forfeit the game.

words.english_meaning: Done for enjoyment and relaxation rather than for work or competition.
words.gujarati_meaning: કામ કે સ્પર્ધાને બદલે આનંદ અને આરામ માટે કરવામાં આવતું.
words.usage_note: Used to distinguish casual play from professional play.
examples: He plays football purely for recreational reasons.
The park offers many recreational activities for families.
Recreational cycling is good for both body and mind.
She is a recreational, not a professional, swimmer.

words.english_meaning: To move around and talk with many different people at a social event.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ સામાજિક પ્રસંગે જુદા જુદા લોકો સાથે ફરીને વાતચીત કરવી, ભળી જવું.
words.usage_note: Often used at parties and networking events.
examples: She loves to mingle with new people at parties.
The host encouraged everyone to mingle.
He felt shy and found it hard to mingle.
Guests mingled freely over drinks and snacks.

words.english_meaning: The place where an event or gathering is held.
words.gujarati_meaning: જ્યાં કોઈ કાર્યક્રમ કે મેળાવડો યોજાય તે સ્થળ.
words.usage_note: Common in event planning for concerts, weddings, and meetings.
examples: We booked a beautiful venue for the wedding.
The concert venue holds ten thousand people.
They had to change the venue at the last minute.
This venue is perfect for small gatherings.

words.english_meaning: A planned meeting at an agreed time and place.
words.gujarati_meaning: નક્કી કરેલા સમય અને સ્થળે ગોઠવેલી મુલાકાત.
words.usage_note: A French loanword; pronounced without the final 's' sound.
examples: They arranged a rendezvous at the old cafe.
The café became their regular rendezvous.
We set a rendezvous point near the station.
Their secret rendezvous was finally discovered.

words.english_meaning: Entertainment and social activities available in a place at night.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ સ્થળે રાત્રે ઉપલબ્ધ મનોરંજન અને સામાજિક પ્રવૃત્તિઓ.
words.usage_note: Refers to clubs, bars, and late-night venues in a city.
examples: The city is famous for its vibrant nightlife.
Tourists flock here to enjoy the lively nightlife.
There isn't much nightlife in this quiet town.
The new district has a buzzing nightlife scene.

words.english_meaning: To spend time with others in a friendly way for enjoyment.
words.gujarati_meaning: આનંદ માટે બીજાઓ સાથે મૈત્રીપૂર્ણ રીતે સમય વિતાવવો, હળવુંમળવું.
words.usage_note: Spelt 'socialize' in American English.
examples: We often socialise with our neighbours on weekends.
He finds it hard to socialise with strangers.
After the meeting, the staff socialised over coffee.
Children learn to socialise at school.

words.english_meaning: An event where a group of people come together socially.
words.gujarati_meaning: એવો પ્રસંગ જ્યાં લોકોનું જૂથ સામાજિક રીતે ભેગું થાય, મેળાવડો.
words.usage_note: Used for both casual and formal social occasions.
examples: We hosted a small family gathering last Sunday.
The gathering lasted well into the night.
It was a warm gathering of old friends.
Large gatherings were limited during the festival.

mini_dialogues.title: Talking About a New Series
mini_dialogues.situation: Two friends discuss a TV show one of them just finished.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Have you started that new thriller? I binge-watched the whole first season last night.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Not yet! Please don't give me any spoilers.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Don't worry. But I'll just say the plot has a brilliant twist.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Does each episode end on a cliffhanger?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Every single one. It's critically acclaimed, and honestly, it deserves it.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Great, I'll watch it this weekend then.

mini_dialogues.title: Before the Concert
mini_dialogues.situation: Two musicians prepare backstage for a live show.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: How did the final rehearsal go this afternoon?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Smoothly. Though if I forget the lyrics, I'll just improvise.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: You're such a virtuoso, the crowd will love it either way.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: If they cheer enough, we'll give them an encore.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Perfect. The melody of the last song always gets them on their feet.

mini_dialogues.title: At the Bookshop
mini_dialogues.situation: A customer asks a friend for a reading recommendation.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I love to browse this shop. Any recommendations?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: If you want a real page-turner, try this crime novel.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Is the protagonist likeable? That matters to me.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Very. And the narrative jumps cleverly between past and present.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Sounds great. I usually prefer a good memoir, but I'll give this a try.

mini_dialogues.title: Comparing Hobbies
mini_dialogues.situation: Two colleagues chat about how they spend their weekends.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: What do you do to relax? I'm an avid gardener myself.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I dabble in pottery, and lately I've taken up calligraphy too.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Nice! My brother loves to tinker with old machines in the garage.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That sounds fun. Gardening must keep you outdoors a lot.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: It does, and it's so calming after a busy week.

mini_dialogues.title: Planning a Night Out
mini_dialogues.situation: Two friends arrange where to meet for an evening out.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: There's a small gathering at Riya's tonight. Want to come?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Sure! I love a chance to socialise after a long week.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Afterwards we could check out the nightlife downtown.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Good idea. What's the venue for the after-party?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Let's set a rendezvous at the café near the station first, then go together.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Perfect, that way we can mingle before heading out.

Which word is closest in meaning to 'avid'?

What is the opposite of 'recreational'?
Her latest mystery is a real ______; I couldn't put it down.

questions.question: The team had to ______ the match because they arrived too late.

words.english_meaning: Sports that involve running, jumping, and throwing, such as track and field events.
words.gujarati_meaning: દોડ, કૂદકા અને ફેંકવાની રમતો — જેમ કે ટ્રેક અને ફીલ્ડની સ્પર્ધાઓ.
words.usage_note: In British English it usually means track and field events.
words.memory_tip: 'Athlete' = એથ્લીટ → રમતવીર → એથ્લેટિક્સ એટલે રમતવીરોની રમતો.
examples: She trains in athletics every morning.
Athletics is a major part of the Olympic Games.
He won three medals in athletics last year.
The school has a strong athletics programme.

words.english_meaning: A person who watches a sports event or game.
words.gujarati_meaning: જે વ્યક્તિ રમત કે મેચ જોવા આવે છે — પ્રેક્ષક.
words.usage_note: Use it for people who watch sport rather than take part.
words.memory_tip: 'Spect' = જોવું (inspect જેવું) → spectator એટલે જોનાર → પ્રેક્ષક.
examples: The spectators cheered loudly when the goal was scored.
Thousands of spectators filled the stadium.
As a spectator, he enjoyed the match from the stands.
The spectators waved flags throughout the game.

words.english_meaning: An official who watches a game and makes sure the rules are followed.
words.gujarati_meaning: એ અધિકારી જે રમત પર નજર રાખે છે અને નિયમો પળાય તે જુએ છે — પંચ.
words.usage_note: In football the referee controls the match; in cricket it is usually called an umpire.
words.memory_tip: 'Refer' = પૂછવું → referee એ વ્યક્તિ જેને નિર્ણય માટે પૂછાય → પંચ.
examples: The referee showed him a red card.
Players argued with the referee about the penalty.
A good referee stays calm under pressure.
The referee blew the whistle to start the match.

words.english_meaning: A series of games in which many players or teams compete to find the winner.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઘણી ટીમો કે ખેલાડીઓ વચ્ચે વિજેતા શોધવા રમાતી મેચોની શ્રેણી — સ્પર્ધા.
words.usage_note: A tournament usually has several rounds leading to a final.
words.memory_tip: 'Tour' = ફરવું → tournament એટલે ઘણી મેચોની ફેરી → સ્પર્ધા.
examples: Our team reached the final of the tournament.
The tennis tournament lasts two weeks.
She has won every tournament this season.
Eight teams entered the knockout tournament.

words.english_meaning: Doing a sport or activity for pleasure rather than as a paid profession.
words.gujarati_meaning: પૈસા માટે નહીં પણ શોખ માટે રમત રમતો — બિન-વ્યાવસાયિક.
words.usage_note: An amateur is not paid; the opposite is a professional.
words.memory_tip: 'Amat' = પ્રેમ (Latin) → amateur એ જે પ્રેમ-શોખથી રમે → બિન-વ્યાવસાયિક.
examples: He plays football at an amateur level.
Amateur athletes often train after work.
She started as an amateur before turning professional.
The club welcomes both amateur and professional players.

words.english_meaning: A player or team that is expected to lose a game or competition.
words.gujarati_meaning: જે ખેલાડી કે ટીમ હારે એવી અપેક્ષા હોય — નબળી ગણાતી બાજુ.
words.usage_note: Fans often support the underdog because an unexpected win feels special.
words.memory_tip: 'Under' = નીચે + 'dog' → નીચે ગણાતો → underdog એટલે નબળી ગણાતી બાજુ.
examples: The underdog team surprised everyone by winning.
Nobody expected the underdog to reach the final.
Crowds love an underdog story.
Despite being the underdog, she beat the champion.

words.english_meaning: A result in a game in which neither side wins because the scores are equal.
words.gujarati_meaning: એવો પરિણામ જેમાં બંને બાજુનો સ્કોર સરખો હોવાથી કોઈ જીતતું નથી — બરાબરી.
words.usage_note: In some sports a draw is called a tie, especially in American English.
words.memory_tip: 'Draw' = ખેંચવું → બંને બાજુ સરખું ખેંચાય → ડ્રો એટલે બરાબરી.
examples: The match ended in a goalless draw.
Both teams were happy with a draw.
A draw was enough to win the league.
After ninety minutes the game was still a draw.

words.english_meaning: The ability to keep doing something difficult for a long time without getting tired.
words.gujarati_meaning: લાંબા સમય સુધી થાક્યા વગર કઠણ કામ ચાલુ રાખવાની ક્ષમતા — સહનશક્તિ.
words.usage_note: Endurance is about lasting power, not short bursts of strength.
words.memory_tip: 'Endure' = સહન કરવું → endurance એટલે સહનશક્તિ, લાંબી ટકાવ.
examples: Marathon runners need great endurance.
Endurance training improves your heart and lungs.
His endurance allowed him to finish the race.
Cycling long distances builds endurance.

words.english_meaning: The ability of the body to bend and stretch easily.
words.gujarati_meaning: શરીર સહેલાઈથી વાળવા અને ખેંચવાની ક્ષમતા — લચીલાપણું.
words.usage_note: Stretching and yoga are common ways to increase flexibility.
words.memory_tip: 'Flex' = વાળવું → flexibility એટલે વાળવાની ક્ષમતા → લચીલાપણું.
examples: Yoga greatly improves your flexibility.
Dancers need excellent flexibility.
Stretching every day increases flexibility.
Poor flexibility can lead to injuries.

words.english_meaning: Gentle exercise done before training or a game to prepare the body.
words.gujarati_meaning: તાલીમ કે મેચ પહેલાં શરીરને તૈયાર કરવા કરાતી હળવી કસરત — વોર્મ-અપ.
words.usage_note: A good warm-up reduces the risk of injury before exercise.
words.memory_tip: 'Warm up' = ગરમ કરવું → શરીરને ગરમ કરી તૈયાર કરવું → વોર્મ-અપ.
examples: Always do a warm-up before running.
The team finished their warm-up on the field.
A short warm-up loosens your muscles.
She skipped the warm-up and pulled a muscle.

words.english_meaning: A single complete movement of an exercise, repeated to build strength.
words.gujarati_meaning: કસરતની એક પૂરી હલચાલ, જે તાકાત વધારવા વારંવાર કરાય — પુનરાવર્તન.
words.usage_note: In the gym this is often shortened to a 'rep'.
words.memory_tip: 'Repeat' = ફરી કરવું → repetition એટલે પુનરાવર્તન, વારંવાર કરવું.
examples: Do twelve repetitions of each exercise.
He increased the repetitions to build muscle.
Repetition helps the body learn the movement.
She counted each repetition carefully.

words.english_meaning: The process of getting the body fit and strong through regular training.
words.gujarati_meaning: નિયમિત તાલીમ દ્વારા શરીરને તંદુરસ્ત અને મજબૂત બનાવવાની પ્રક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: Conditioning focuses on overall fitness, not just one muscle group.
words.memory_tip: 'Condition' = સ્થિતિ → conditioning એટલે શરીરની સ્થિતિ સુધારવી.
examples: The coach designed a tough conditioning programme.
Good conditioning helps players last the full match.
Pre-season conditioning builds their fitness.
Strength and conditioning are key to performance.

words.english_meaning: The energy and strength to continue physical effort for a long time.
words.gujarati_meaning: લાંબા સમય સુધી શારીરિક પ્રયત્ન ચાલુ રાખવાની ઊર્જા અને તાકાત — દમ.
words.usage_note: Stamina is often used in everyday speech for lasting energy.
examples: Swimming builds your stamina quickly.
He lacked the stamina to finish the climb.
Long runs improve your stamina.
The boxer showed amazing stamina in the final round.

words.english_meaning: The speed at which someone moves or trains during exercise.
words.gujarati_meaning: કસરત દરમિયાન કોઈ વ્યક્તિ જે ગતિએ આગળ વધે કે તાલીમ લે — ગતિ.
words.usage_note: Setting the right pace helps you avoid tiring too early.
words.memory_tip: 'Pace' = પેસ → ડગલું/ગતિ → દોડ કે કસરતની ઝડપ.
examples: She ran at a steady pace for an hour.
He set a fast pace from the start.
Try to keep up the pace until the finish.
A slow pace at first helps you last longer.

words.english_meaning: A competition to decide who is the best player or team in a sport.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ રમતમાં શ્રેષ્ઠ ખેલાડી કે ટીમ નક્કી કરવાની સ્પર્ધા — ચૅમ્પિયનશિપ.
words.usage_note: Winning a championship usually earns a major title or trophy.
words.memory_tip: 'Champion' = વિજેતા → championship એટલે વિજેતા નક્કી કરવાની સ્પર્ધા.
examples: They won the national championship last year.
The championship final drew a huge crowd.
She is training hard for the world championship.
Our club has held the championship three times.

words.english_meaning: To reach the standard needed to take part in the next stage of a competition.
words.gujarati_meaning: સ્પર્ધાના આગળના તબક્કામાં ભાગ લેવા જરૂરી સ્તર પ્રાપ્ત કરવું — ક્વોલિફાય થવું.
words.usage_note: You qualify when you do well enough to move to the next round.
words.memory_tip: 'Qualify' = ક્વોલિફાય → લાયક બનવું → આગળ વધવાનો હક મેળવવો.
examples: Our team qualified for the semi-final.
She needs to win to qualify for the Olympics.
They failed to qualify for the next round.
He qualified easily after a strong performance.

words.english_meaning: A competition stage where the loser is immediately removed from the contest.
words.gujarati_meaning: સ્પર્ધાનો એ તબક્કો જ્યાં હારનાર તરત જ બહાર નીકળી જાય — નોકઆઉટ.
words.usage_note: In a knockout, one loss means you are out of the competition.
words.memory_tip: 'Knock out' = બહાર ફેંકવું → knockout એટલે હારતાં જ બહાર.
examples: The tournament moves to the knockout stage tomorrow.
They were beaten in the first knockout round.
A single defeat ends your run in a knockout.
She reached the knockout stage for the first time.

words.english_meaning: A sports match arranged to take place on a particular date.
words.gujarati_meaning: ચોક્કસ તારીખે રમાનારી નક્કી થયેલી રમત — ફિક્સ્ચર.
words.usage_note: Fixture is common in British sport for a scheduled match.
words.memory_tip: 'Fix' = નક્કી કરવું → fixture એટલે નક્કી થયેલી મેચ.
examples: The next fixture is against our biggest rivals.
Rain caused the fixture to be postponed.
There are three home fixtures this month.
The fixture list was released yesterday.

words.english_meaning: An extra game or series played to decide a winner or a final ranking.
words.gujarati_meaning: વિજેતા કે અંતિમ ક્રમ નક્કી કરવા રમાતી વધારાની રમત — પ્લેઓફ.
words.usage_note: Playoffs decide the final winner after the regular season.
words.memory_tip: 'Play off' = વધારે રમવું → playoff એટલે વિજેતા નક્કી કરવા વધારાની રમત.
examples: Our team made it to the playoffs this year.
The playoff game went into overtime.
They lost the playoff by a single point.
A win secures a playoff spot.

words.english_meaning: A return to success after losing or falling behind in a game.
words.gujarati_meaning: રમતમાં પાછળ પડ્યા કે હાર્યા પછી ફરી સફળતા તરફ પાછા આવવું — કમબૅક.
words.usage_note: A comeback describes recovering from a losing position to win.
words.memory_tip: 'Come back' = પાછા આવવું → comeback એટલે હાર પછી ફરી આગળ આવવું.
examples: The team staged an amazing comeback in the second half.
Her comeback inspired the whole crowd.
Trailing by two goals, they made a stunning comeback.
After his injury, he made a successful comeback.

words.english_meaning: To stop someone from taking part because they have broken a rule.
words.gujarati_meaning: નિયમ તોડવાને કારણે કોઈને ભાગ લેવાથી રોકવું — ગેરલાયક ઠેરવવું.
words.usage_note: An athlete may be disqualified for cheating or a false start.
words.memory_tip: 'Dis' = નહીં + 'qualify' = લાયક → disqualify એટલે ગેરલાયક ઠેરવવું.
examples: The runner was disqualified for a false start.
They disqualified him for using banned substances.
Breaking the rules can disqualify the whole team.
She was disqualified after the protest.

words.english_meaning: A bat with a round frame and strings used in tennis, badminton, and squash.
words.gujarati_meaning: ગોળ ફ્રેમ અને દોરા વાળું બૅટ જે ટેનિસ, બૅડમિન્ટન વગેરેમાં વપરાય — રૅકેટ.
words.usage_note: Spelled 'racquet' in some sports, but the meaning is the same.
examples: She bought a new tennis racket.
He swung the racket and hit a perfect shot.
My badminton racket needs new strings.
A light racket is easier to control.

words.english_meaning: A hard hat worn to protect the head during a sport or activity.
words.gujarati_meaning: રમત કે પ્રવૃત્તિ દરમિયાન માથાનું રક્ષણ કરવા પહેરાતી કઠણ ટોપી — હેલ્મેટ.
words.usage_note: A helmet is essential safety gear in cycling, cricket, and many sports.
words.memory_tip: 'Helmet' = હેલ્મેટ → માથાનું રક્ષણ કરતી કઠણ ટોપી.
examples: Always wear a helmet when cycling.
The batsman put on his helmet before facing the bowler.
His helmet protected him in the crash.
Safety rules require every player to wear a helmet.

words.english_meaning: The special clothing and equipment needed for a particular sport.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ ખાસ રમત માટે જરૂરી ખાસ કપડાં અને સાધનો — ગિયર / સામગ્રી.
words.usage_note: Gear is an informal word covering all your sports equipment.
examples: Don't forget to bring your training gear.
Protective gear keeps players safe.
He packed all his gear into one bag.
Good gear can improve your performance.

words.english_meaning: Tight-fitting glasses that protect the eyes during swimming or skiing.
words.gujarati_meaning: તરવા કે સ્કીઇંગ વખતે આંખોનું રક્ષણ કરતા ચુસ્ત ચશ્માં — ગોગલ્સ.
words.usage_note: Goggles is always plural, like glasses.
examples: She wore goggles to protect her eyes in the pool.
His goggles kept fogging up.
Buy a good pair of swimming goggles.
Skiers wear goggles against the bright snow.

words.english_meaning: A machine with a moving belt that you walk or run on while staying in one place.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક યંત્ર જેના ફરતા પટ્ટા પર એક જ જગ્યાએ ઊભા રહીને ચાલવા કે દોડવાનું હોય — ટ્રેડમિલ.
words.usage_note: A treadmill lets you run indoors regardless of the weather.
words.memory_tip: 'Tread' = પગ મૂકવો + 'mill' → ટ્રેડમિલ એટલે દોડવાનું યંત્ર.
examples: He runs five kilometres on the treadmill daily.
The gym has ten new treadmills.
She prefers the treadmill when it rains.
Walking on a treadmill is good for beginners.

words.english_meaning: A short bar with weights at each end, lifted to build muscle.
words.gujarati_meaning: બંને છેડે વજન વાળો નાનો સળિયો, જે સ્નાયુ બનાવવા ઊંચકાય — ડમ્બેલ.
words.usage_note: Dumbbells come in pairs and in many different weights.
words.memory_tip: 'Dumb' = અવાજ વગરનું + 'bell' = ઘંટ → અવાજ વગરનો ઘંટ જેવો વજનનો સળિયો.
examples: He lifts dumbbells to strengthen his arms.
Start with light dumbbells if you are a beginner.
She added heavier dumbbells to her routine.
A pair of dumbbells is enough for a home workout.

words.english_meaning: A barrier of knotted threads used in sports like tennis, volleyball, and football goals.
words.gujarati_meaning: ગૂંથેલા દોરાનો અડચણ-પડદો જે ટેનિસ, વોલીબોલ અને ફૂટબોલ ગોલમાં વપરાય — નેટ / જાળી.
words.usage_note: In football, scoring is often described as finding the back of the net.
examples: The ball hit the net and bounced back.
She served the ball just over the net.
The striker found the back of the net.
Players adjust the net before the volleyball match.

words.english_meaning: A person who trains a sports team or player and plans their tactics.
words.gujarati_meaning: જે વ્યક્તિ ટીમ કે ખેલાડીને તાલીમ આપે અને રણનીતિ બનાવે — કોચ / પ્રશિક્ષક.
words.usage_note: A coach guides training and strategy, both on and off the field.
examples: The coach changed the team's tactics at half-time.
She thanked her coach after winning the medal.
A good coach motivates every player.
He was hired as the new head coach.

words.english_meaning: The leader of a sports team, chosen to guide the players during a game.
words.gujarati_meaning: ટીમનો નેતા, જે મેચ દરમિયાન ખેલાડીઓને દોરે — કૅપ્ટન / સુકાની.
words.usage_note: The captain often makes key decisions on the field.
examples: The captain won the toss and chose to bat.
She was made captain of the national team.
A captain must lead by example.
The captain encouraged his players after the loss.

words.english_meaning: A new player who has just started in a professional sport.
words.gujarati_meaning: વ્યાવસાયિક રમતમાં હમણાં જ શરૂઆત કરનાર નવો ખેલાડી — રૂકી / નવોદિત.
words.usage_note: Rookie is common in American sports for a first-year player.
examples: The rookie scored on his very first match.
She had an outstanding rookie season.
Even a rookie can learn fast with good coaching.
The team signed a promising rookie.

words.english_meaning: An experienced player who has taken part in a sport for many years.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઘણા વર્ષોથી રમતમાં ભાગ લેનાર અનુભવી ખેલાડી — અનુભવી / વેટરન.
words.usage_note: A veteran brings valuable experience to a young team.
examples: The veteran calmed the younger players down.
As a veteran, he has seen many big matches.
Her veteran skills guided the team to victory.
Veterans often become coaches after retiring.

words.english_meaning: A player who replaces another player during a game.
words.gujarati_meaning: મેચ દરમિયાન બીજા ખેલાડીની જગ્યાએ આવનાર ખેલાડી — બદલી ખેલાડી.
words.usage_note: A substitute comes on to replace a tired or injured player.
words.memory_tip: 'Sub' = બદલે + 'stitute' = મૂકવું → substitute એટલે બદલી ખેલાડી.
examples: The coach sent on a substitute in the last minute.
The substitute scored the winning goal.
An injured player was replaced by a substitute.
Every team is allowed several substitutes.

words.english_meaning: The person or team you play against in a game or contest.
words.gujarati_meaning: મેચ કે સ્પર્ધામાં જેની સામે તમે રમો છો તે વ્યક્તિ કે ટીમ — પ્રતિસ્પર્ધી.
words.usage_note: Your opponent is whoever competes against you.
words.memory_tip: 'Oppose' = વિરોધ કરવો → opponent એટલે સામેવાળો, પ્રતિસ્પર્ધી.
examples: She studied her opponent's weaknesses before the match.
Our opponents were stronger than expected.
He shook hands with his opponent after the game.
A skilled opponent makes you play better.

words.english_meaning: Physical harm or damage to the body, often caused during sport.
words.gujarati_meaning: શરીરને થયેલી શારીરિક ઈજા કે નુકસાન, ઘણીવાર રમત દરમિયાન — ઈજા.
words.usage_note: An injury may force a player to miss several games.
words.memory_tip: 'Injure' = ઈજા કરવી → injury એટલે શારીરિક ઈજા.
examples: A knee injury kept him out for months.
She recovered fully from her injury.
The team has several players with injuries.
Proper warm-ups help prevent injury.

words.english_meaning: The process of returning to good health or fitness after illness or injury.
words.gujarati_meaning: બીમારી કે ઈજા પછી ફરી સારી તંદુરસ્તી તરફ પાછા આવવાની પ્રક્રિયા — સ્વસ્થ થવું.
words.usage_note: Recovery includes rest, which is as important as training.
words.memory_tip: 'Recover' = સાજા થવું → recovery એટલે ફરી તંદુરસ્ત થવાની પ્રક્રિયા.
examples: Rest is essential for a quick recovery.
Her recovery from the injury took six weeks.
Good nutrition speeds up recovery.
The athlete made a full recovery before the season.

words.english_meaning: The food and substances a body needs to stay healthy and perform well.
words.gujarati_meaning: શરીરને તંદુરસ્ત રહેવા અને સારું પ્રદર્શન કરવા જરૂરી ખોરાક અને પોષક તત્ત્વો — પોષણ.
words.usage_note: Nutrition affects energy, recovery, and overall performance.
words.memory_tip: 'Nutri' = પોષણ → nutrition એટલે પોષણ, સારો ખોરાક.
examples: Athletes pay close attention to their nutrition.
Good nutrition improves performance and recovery.
A coach often works with a nutrition expert.
Poor nutrition can slow down your progress.

words.english_meaning: The act of giving the body enough water to stay healthy during exercise.
words.gujarati_meaning: કસરત દરમિયાન શરીરને પૂરતું પાણી આપીને તંદુરસ્ત રાખવાની ક્રિયા — પાણીની પૂર્તિ.
words.usage_note: Good hydration prevents tiredness and cramps during sport.
words.memory_tip: 'Hydro' = પાણી → hydration એટલે શરીરમાં પાણીની પૂર્તિ.
examples: Proper hydration is vital during long matches.
He carries a bottle to maintain hydration.
Poor hydration causes cramps and fatigue.
Coaches remind players to keep up their hydration.

words.english_meaning: Extreme tiredness caused by hard physical or mental effort.
words.gujarati_meaning: ભારે શારીરિક કે માનસિક પ્રયત્નથી થતો અતિશય થાક — થાક / ગ્લાનિ.
words.usage_note: Fatigue is more serious than ordinary tiredness.
examples: By the final lap he was struggling with fatigue.
Muscle fatigue set in after the long run.
Rest helps the body recover from fatigue.
Mental fatigue can affect your performance too.

words.english_meaning: The ability to move quickly and change direction easily.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઝડપથી હલવાની અને સહેલાઈથી દિશા બદલવાની ક્ષમતા — ચપળતા.
words.usage_note: Agility combines speed, balance, and quick changes of direction.
words.memory_tip: 'Agile' = ચપળ → agility એટલે ચપળતા, ઝડપથી હલવાની શક્તિ.
examples: A footballer needs great agility to dodge tackles.
Agility training improves your footwork.
Her agility helped her reach every shot.
Speed and agility are key for this sport.

mini_dialogues.title: Joining a Tournament
mini_dialogues.situation: Two friends discuss entering a local sports tournament.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Have you signed up for the badminton tournament next month?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Not yet. I'm still only an amateur, so I'm not sure I'll qualify for the knockout stage.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Don't worry. Even the underdog can win if their stamina holds up.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: True. I've been doing endurance training and a proper warm-up before every practice.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That's the spirit. With that kind of conditioning, you might surprise everyone.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: All right, I'll enter. Worst case, it ends in a draw and I learn something.

mini_dialogues.title: Before the Match
mini_dialogues.situation: A coach talks to the team captain before an important fixture.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: This fixture is crucial. The captain needs to keep everyone focused.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Understood, Coach. Should I bring on the substitute if anyone shows fatigue?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yes. And remind the rookie to study our opponent's weaknesses.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I will. The veteran has already shared some tips on their tactics.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good. If we win, we secure our spot in the championship playoffs.

mini_dialogues.title: At the Gym
mini_dialogues.situation: A trainer guides a beginner through a first workout session.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Start on the treadmill for a ten-minute warm-up at an easy pace.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Got it. After that, should I move on to the dumbbells?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yes, do twelve repetitions of each exercise to build strength.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: My flexibility is poor, though. Will that be a problem?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: We'll add stretching to improve flexibility and agility over time.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Great. I really want to boost my stamina and overall fitness.

mini_dialogues.title: The Comeback
mini_dialogues.situation: Two spectators react to a thrilling second half.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: What a comeback! I can't believe they scored three goals in the net.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: The crowd of spectators went wild. The referee added five minutes of injury time.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That late substitute changed everything with his speed and agility.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Definitely. The opponent looked exhausted from fatigue by the end.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: If they keep this up, they'll win the whole championship.

mini_dialogues.title: Recovery and Nutrition
mini_dialogues.situation: An athlete talks with a coach about staying healthy.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Coach, my recovery has been slow since the injury last month.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Recovery takes time. Focus on rest, good nutrition, and proper hydration.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I've been drinking more water and eating balanced meals for better nutrition.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Excellent. Once your endurance returns, we'll rebuild your conditioning slowly.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Thanks. I want to be ready for the next fixture without any fatigue.
